President Donald Trump may go to jail 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Président Donald Trump, 14/Jun/1946, 10:54 AM, hr 5 west, Jamaica, New York, USA, 
40N41, 73W48, KP Ayanamsa 23° 1' 10", Bal. Dasa: Mercury 2 Y, 3 M, 23 D. 


KP Rule for Imprisonment 

For imprisonment, judge the 12‘ cusp and find out whether the following three conditions 

are simultaneously satisfied:- 

1) The sub lord of 12‘ cusp should be Rahu: 

2) It should not be deposited in the constellation whose lord is retrograde, and 

3) It should be a significator of either 2"4 or 34 or 8t or 12th house. 

If any of these three conditions is not satisfied, one will not be imprisoned. For imprisonment 

all the above conditions must necessarily be satisfied simultaneously. 

Source: KP Reader II: Horary Astrology, pp 313-4 

Notes: 

1) 24 rule of retrogression is for horary analysis only. 

2) 3rd rule is not practically valid as only 19 out of 100 prisoner charts under study have Ra- 
hu as 12th cuspal sub lord. One can go to jail without having Rahu as 12th CSL. 

3) 27d house= negative effect on family; 3™4 = leaving residence; 

4) 8th = restriction; 12th = jail.

Question: Will BJP and alliance (NDA) win this election? 

Number. 141 (out of 249) 

Date of Judgment: 30-09-2020, Wednesday; Time of Judgment: 15:03:31 PM; IST 
Place of Judgment. Kankariya- Anmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00' 45”, 72° E 36’ 01” 
Aynamsha 24°.03”.23" 


Hint: 

If 10th (one’s position in politics) cusp lord signifies 10 (one’s reputation), 3 (one’s ability), 11 
(one’s reputation as a winner) during the joint period of the significators of 3-10-11, then 
success is assured. 


Cuspal Sub lord for BJP and alliance (NDA): 

10% Cusp (Virgo 17°.01’.29”): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Saturn. Saturn is in the star 
of Sun and sub of Jupiter. Saturn is occupant of 1 owner of 2-3. No planet in the star of 
Saturn and Saturn is CSL of 10. Star lord Sun is occupant and owner of 9. Sub lord Jupiter 
is occupant of 1, owner of 1-4. Thus 10‘ cusp sub lord Saturn is the significator of 1-2-3-10- 
9-4. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Cuspal Sub lord for opponent: 

10%: Cusp (Pisces 17°.01’.29”): The sub lord of the 10% cusp is Mercury. Mercury is in the 
star of Rahu and sub of Jupiter. Mercury is occupant of 4 owner of 1-4. Star lord Rahu is 
occupant of 12. Rahu is in Taurus sign, hence represent Venus. Venus is occupant 2, owner 
of 5-12. Sub lord Jupiter is occupant of 7, owner of 7-10. Thus 10 cusp sub lord Mercury is 
the significator of 4-1-12-2-5-7-10. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Joint period for BJP and alliance (NDA): 
On the day of election, (28th October 2020) the running joint period dasa is Jupiter-Ketu- 
Mercury-Moon. 


Dasa lord Jupiter is in the star of Venus and sub of Saturn. Jupiter is occupant of 1 owner of 
1-4. Star lord Venus is occupant of 8 owner of 6-11. Sub lord Saturn is occupant of 1 owner 
of 2-3. No planet in the star of Saturn and Saturn is CSL of 10. Thus dasa lord Jupiter is the 
significator of 1-4-8-6-11-2-3-10. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Bhukti lord Ketu is in the star of Mercury and sub of Saturn. Ketu is occupant of 12. Ketu is 
aspected by Mars. Mars is occupant of 4 owner of 5-12. Star lord Mercury is occupant of 10, 
owner of 7-10. Sub lord Saturn is occupant of 1 owner of 2-3. No planet in the star of Saturn 
and Saturn is CSL of 10. Thus bhukti lord Ketu is the significator of 12-4-5-10-7-1-2-3. 
Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Antra lord Mercury is in the star of Rahu and sub of Jupiter. Mercury is occupant of 10 
owner of 7-10. Star lord Rahu is occupant of 6. Rahu is in Taurus sign, hence represent 
Venus. Venus is occupant 8, owner of 6-11. Sub lord Jupiter is occupant of 1, owner of 1-4. 
Thus antra lord Mercury is the significator of 10-7-6-8-11-1-4. Hence, the wining in election 
is sure. 


Sookshma lord Moon is in the star of Jupiter and sub of Ketu. Moon is occupant of 3 owner 
of 8. Star lord Jupiter is occupant of 1, owner of 1-4. Sub lord Ketu is occupant of 12. Ketu

On November 8, 2020, the south Indian village of Thulasendrapuram in the state of Tamil 
Nadu was celebrating after waking up to the news that Kamala Harris will become the Vice 
President of the United States. Thulasendrapuram was the home of Harris’ maternal 
grandfather, diplomat P.V. Gopalan. It is a rural community of 350 people, located 215 miles 
south of the state capital, Chennai. 


Background 
Kamala Harris born of Jamaican and Indian immigrant parents — is making history as 
America’s first female, first Black and Jamaican-Indian American vice president-elect. 


Kamala Harris’s mother, Shyamala Gopalan, was born in India and came to the United 
States from Chennai, India, in 1960 to study at the University of California-Berkeley, where 
she met her Jamaican-born father Donald J. Harris. Kamala’s mother was a strong 
influence in her life, especially because her parents divorced when she was 7, and her 
mother raised her and her sister, Maya.

was not satisfied with his current job, I asked him to furnish any horary number between 1 
to 249. 

Date of Enquiry - 2-9-2019 


Horary no furnished - 222 [1 to 249] 
Time of Judgement - 9:21 PM 
Place of Judgement - Adelaide [Australia] 


Moon Reveals the Nature of Enquiry. 

Moon lord 6 in 8 and its starlord Mars in 6 lord of 3 and 10 and its sublord Saturn in 10 lord 
of 12 and 1 and Saturn aspect 5, Hence Moon signifies 6 and 10 [Job] 3,5 &12 change in job 
and change in job complex. 


Confirmation through Ascendant Sublord 

In the horary chart Ascendant indicates effort of querent. In this case Asc sublord is Jup in 
10 and its starlord Merc is in 6 lord of 5 and 8 and its sublord is Ven in 8 lord of 4 and 9. 
Hence Asc sublord signifies 6,10,5 and 9 which shows that effort of querent for change of job 
will be fulfilled. 


KP Rule For Change of Job 

As per KP sixth reader written by Sh KS Krishnamurti ji on page 296 and 297, the planets 
which are 6,8 and12 to any house do not contribute to the matter influenced by that house. 
Accordingly house 3,5 and 9 happen to be in 6,8 and 12 to the houses 2,6 and 10 of profes- 
sion or occupation. Consequently the planets signifying the house 3,5 and 9 would be con- 
ducive to change in present job during the joint period of significators of houses 3,5 and 9. 
Check 10th Cuspal Sublord for Change In Job, Here 10% cusp sub lord is Merc in 6 lord of 5 
& 8, starlord Ven in 7 lord 4 & 9 and its sublord is Jup in 10 lord of 2 and 11. Hence 10th 
cusp sublord signifies 5 & 9 which is conducive for change of job.

Background: 

A 44 years old person, a Telecommunication Engineer, an expert in mobile phone technology 
running his own workshop, was ceaselessly suffering from body pain, cold, fever, laziness , 
stress, stiff neck, back born pain with inability to move. If any staff member of his workshop 
is suffering from cold or fever, definitely he gets infected the same disease within a short 
time. Once he said that since he is handling mobile phones used by unknown people and 
those phones may be unhygienic with bacteria or viruses and infecting any disease is possi- 
ble. With this opinion he has used some hygienic precautionary measures to get rid of such 
infections. But he has failed and he could not refrain from suffering various ailments for the 
last six months or so. Finally he had consulted a physician and had undergone some medical 
tests. The result of one of tests called Anti Nuclear Antibody (ANA) was positive of nuclear 
patterns and Cytoplasmic patterns Negative and accordingly it has been decided that indica- 
tions of LUPUS are appearing. After medication for one month again he was asked to under- 
go the same test and result was negative. Then the doctor had decided that he is not at- 
tacked by Lupus. But still the person is weeping with various pains with discomfort. 

Note: ANA- Antinuclear antibodies are unusual antibodies, detectable in the blood, that have 
the capability of binding to certain structures within the cells and it indicates the possible pres- 
ence of Autoimmunity & provides, therefore an indication of Autoimmune illness) 

In this situation I decided to go through his horoscope to see the influences of disease mak- 
ing planets by comparing some actual LUPUS affected AA charts collected from ADB (now 


known as www.astro.com). 


First I wish to bring you an introduction to the disease "Lupus" as described in various medi- 
cal literatures. 

Lupus is a systemic autoimmune disease that occurs when the body's immune system at- 
tacks own tissues and organs. In other words Lupus occurs when the immune system at- 
tacks healthy tissue in the body (autoimmune disease). It's likely that lupus results from a 
combination of the genetics and the environment. Inflammation caused by lupus can affect 
many different body systems including joints, skin, kidneys, blood cells, brain, heart and 
lungs. Lupus can be difficult to diagnose because its signs and symptoms often mimic those 
of other ailments. The most distinctive sign of lupus is a facial rash that resembles the wings 
of a butterfly unfolding across both cheeks occurs in many but not all cases of lupus. Some 
people are born with a tendency toward developing lupus, which may be triggered by infec- 
tions, certain drugs or even sunlight. While there's no cure for lupus, treatments can help 
control symptoms. 

The signs and symptoms of lupus will depend on which body systems are affected by the dis- 
ease. The most common signs and symptoms include fatigue, fever, joint pain, stiffness and 
swelling, butterfly-shaped rash on the face, skin lesions that appear or worsen with Sun ex- 
posure (photosensitivity), fingers and toes that turn white or blue when exposed to cold or 
during stressful periods (Raynaud's phenomenon), shortness of breath, chest pain, dry eyes, 
headaches, confusion and memory loss. 

The above said native is having some of the above symptoms, with weak vision, but not yet 
attacked to the skin at all. 


Now let's go through the charts selected to see any common pattern of planetary influence for 
the disease.

Legendary Footballer Diego Maradona: 
Astrological Tribute 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 
PHREHREeEReEBEEAEEBEHEREREEREEHEEHEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEHEHEEHEHEEEHEHEEHEHEEHEEEHEEBEEEEEE & | 











Diego Maradona was an Argentinean footballer, who became world known soccer champion 
by scoring winning goals in the 1986 World Cup Game. Widely regarded as one of the 
greatest players of all time, Maradona and Pele were joint winners of the FIFA Player of the 
20th Century award. He is the only player to win the Golden Ball at both the World Cup in 
1986 and the Under-20 World Cup in 1979. 

After the 1982 world cup in Spain, he joined Barcelona and played in Spain for two seasons. 
In 1984 he joined Naples, Italy and won two Italian Championships in 1986-1987 and 1989- 
1990, a Coppa Italia (1987), an UEFA cup (1989) and a Supercoppa Italiana (1990). 





Maradona's career began a slow decline, when he failed a drug test in 1991 and was 
suspended from soccer. His international career lasted 16 years but ended when he was sent 
home from the 1994 World Cup after failing a drugs test. For the remainder of his soccer 
career, he played for Argentinean clubs. On 30 October 1997, he retired from football, aged 
37. 


On 2 November 2020, Maradona was admitted to a hospital in La Plata, supposedly for 
psychological reasons. A day later, he underwent emergency brain surgery to treat a 
subdural hematoma. He was released on 12 November after successful surgery. On 25 
November 2020, at the age of 60, Maradona died of a heart attack at his home in Tigre, 
Buenos Aires. 


Planetary Combinations of Great Footballer 
Maradona’s 3rd (footballer) and 5th (sports in general) cuspal sub lords (CSL) are the 
significator of 1 (vitality and self effort), 2 (10th from 5 = reputation for sports), 3 (main house 
for footballer, courage and skills), 5 (sports in general and performance), 6 (competition, 
benefit from sports as 2nd from 5 ), 7 (popularity), 10 (profession, success and fame) and 11 
(gain, foot) houses to become a great footballer.

Question 1: KP Ayanamsa or Stright Line Ayanamsa 
In KP-4.5 Astrology program (KPEZine using) 

He indicates 3- Ayanamsas 

KP Ayanamsa 

KP Strightline Ayanamsa 

KP Strightline Ayanamsa(Adjusted) 

When executed Sub-lords & Sub-Sub-Lords changes 
Which one is appropriate to use, Please Reply sir. 





Answer 1: 
In short, KP Ayanamsa is to be used. 


Why? 


KP original/old ayanamsa, recommended by Guruji KSK 

The KP original/old ayanamsa was presumed to be constant or flat for the full calendar year 
for easy manual calculation, in "KP Reader I: Casting the Horoscope", 1971, giving yearly val- 
ues in degree and minute for the years 1840 to 2001. The formula was not given but it is 
based on the "two KP figures", i.e. zero ayanamsa year 291 A.D. and Newcomb's annual pre- 
cession rate 50.2388475 sec. For years beyond 2001, the Newcomb’s annual precession rate 
is to be added per year to the ayanamsa value for 2001, i.e.23 deg 47 min. 


The KP new ayanamsa (2003) 

The KP new ayanamsa (2003) gives a formula with “two KP figures (291 A.D. base year A.D. 
& 50.2388475” Newcomb’s annual precession rate) for calculating the ayanamsa correct up 
to the value of seconds and for any date in the calendar year. 


KP New Ayanamsa = B + [T* P + (T*T * A)]/ 3600, where 
B = 22+1350/3600 = 22-22-30 @ 15 Apr 1900 
P = 50.2388475 (Newcomb’s annual precession rate) 
A = 0.000111 sec per year (annual precession rate adjustment) 
Note: 23 March, 291 A.D. is assumed as date of zero ayanamsa. 


There is not any significant difference between the values of KP original/old and new aya- 
namsas. For KP analysis the star lords and sub lords of cusps and planets will be the same, 
except in borderline cases and so the results also will be the same. 


The “KP Ayanamsa” in KPAstro 4.5 SW is the “KP new ayanamsa (2003)”. 


KP Straight Line Ayanamsa 

It was introduced by MC Khare in the "Astrology & Arthrishta" October 1978 issue, pages 6- 
8, using the “two KP figures” while there was a lot of discussion on the KP old ayanamsa by 
scholars like M.G.G. Nair with desire to make a correction for the Newcomb’s rate and K.M. 
Subramaniam of “Sublord Speaks" standing firm not to change these two KP figures given 
by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti. 


KP Straight Line Ayanamsa = T*P/3600, where 
T = Y- 291 (year of zero ayanamsa) 


KP Ezine December 2020 56 


Y= Calendar year for which ayanamsa is required 
P = 50.2388475 sec per year (Newcomb’s annual precession rate) 
Note: T = fractional/decimal year taking days between given date and 15th April.

The battle for the US Senate: Georgia Senate 
run-off elections on January 5 





ria. fi By: Tin Win 
EPSPS Email: tw853@yahoo.com 

('RaeREEREREEEREHEEEEEEEEEEEE EERE EREEHRE REE RRR EE 
In my opinion, the Democrats can win both Senate seats in the tight Georgia run-off elec- 


tions to gain control of the Senate according to the analysis of Joe Biden’s inauguration hor- 
oscope. (26 December 2020) 








0 Was 
REV. RAPHAEL 
WARNOCK 





Background 

The runoff elections in Georgia were called as none of the candidates won the state- 
mandated 50 per cent share of the last November vote to be declared victorious. Currently 
Republicans hold 50 seats in the Senate and Democrats hold 46, while the two independents 
who caucus with them bring them up to 48. To secure a majority, Democrats must win both 
seats, which would allow Vice President-elect Kamala Harris to cast the tie-breaking vote in 
the chamber. 


The run-off elections will determine whether Republican Sens. David Perdue and Kelly Loef- 
fler will keep their seats, or they'll lose them to Democratic challengers Jon Ossoff and the 
Rev. Raphael Warnock. The GOP only needs to win one of them for Mitch McConnell to main- 
tain control of the Senate majority and its ability to block the agenda of President-elect Joe 
Biden. The Democrats under the leadership of Chuck Schumer therefore have to win both 
seats in order to gain control of the Senate and thereby boost Joe Biden's ambitious legisla- 
tive agenda on taxes, immigration and the environment. 

In this regard, since the birth times of the above four competing senate candidates and 
Chuck Schumer are not available, the alternative approach is to check the capability of the 
Joe Biden’s presidency from the horoscope of his inauguration cast for noon on January 20, 
2021 in Washington, DC as the incoming president assumes the duties of the office at noon 
according to the US Constitution. The actual swearing-in time may be different within a few 
minutes only. 


The rules of Sahl 

The famous Arab astrologer, Sahl ibn Bishr (c. 786-845), known in Latin Europe as Zael, em- 
phasizes in his writings (The Astrology of Sahl b. Bishr — translated by Sahl Ibn Bishr) that 
the essence of the horoscope of assuming power comes down to an appropriate interpretation 
of the tops of corner houses and their rulers (and their mutual relations), which indicate: 

a) person (house J), 

b) office (house X), 

c) end of office (house IV) and 

d) enemies (house VII).

Death due to a small road accident 


By: Gunti Nagaraju 
KP astrologer (M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer) 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, 
Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27172206; 9490752371; 

Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 
EREREEREEBREBEEBREEBEEHEEEEEBEEEEEREREEREREERERE REE REESE EE GE 
The following birth details of the diseased native are furnished bellow--- 

DOB-04 OCTOBER 1971/ TOB—03-45-00 P.M/ POB-KALYANDRUNG, A.P. 











On 23 July 2020, he went to meet a customer on his official purpose, and while returning by 
his car, there was a problem with his vehicle. He parked his car onto the roadside and after 
checking, he managed to set-right his vehicle with help of his colleague who was also travel- 
ling with him. His colleague boarded the vehicle first and then he was trying to sit in the 
driving seat by opening the door. Just at the very fraction of that moment, suddenly a fellow 
who was coming on the opposite side of his car came driving his scooter, hit him and the 
door of the car and passed away. Next moment my cousin fell on the road and died instantly. 
Immediately his friend who was travelling with my cousin telephoned to a nearby hospital 
and took him to hospital with the help of an ambulance. The doctors at the hospital after 
checking thoroughly, confirmed his death by a road accident, which was due to the collusion 
of his head with the road 


Western astrologer CELESTE TEAL in his book “ PREDICTING EVENTS WITH ASTROLOGY” 
says (quote) “ When we speak astrologically of any road accidents in general, they are at- 
tributed to a combination of progressed and transiting aspects. They are likely to include af- 
flictions involving Mars, both in the progressions and the transits. Mars is considered a ma- 
lefic planet for good reasons. When prominent and afflicted, it reflects the potential for acci- 
dents, illness, and general conflicts. 

Uranus is often a prominent planet when risk and danger are near. It is frequently involved 
in afflicting aspects when accidents occur, especially when they come out of the blue or un- 
expectedly. Uranus acts in lightening speed. Uranus in affliction with Mars is the most dan- 
gerous aspect when trouble comes from unexpected directions. 

Traffic accidents or problems with vehicles might have Mercury or ruler of the third house 
involved, probably in affliction to Mars for a serious accident to occur, the natal Sun and the 
progressed angles of the chart would likely be seriously afflicted.” 


This can be agreed to some extent by KP followers if one reads the second reader of Sri Late 
K.S. Krishnamurthi, an astrology wizard of the 20t century, wherein he says- (See pages 298 
-302) (quote) “when the eighth house is occupied by the lord of Lagna or the planet in the 8 
happens to be posited in the constellation of the Lagna lord, or the lord of the 8 is in con- 
junction with the lord of Lagna, the indication is that the native himself will be the cause of 
his death...." 

And continues to say" if the 3™ house alone is connected, the death may happen during trav- 
el in a nearby locality. If the 12th house is connected, death may take place in an unknown 
place. If connected to the 9tt house in any manner, the native may likely die in a far-off place 
or while going on a long journey”. 


He further adds that if Uranus is connected with the 8th house in any manner, it may indi- 
cate strange and sudden death, death caused by an explosion. Neptune indicates a mysteri- 
ous death, death after being in a state of coma or unconsciousness, or due to over dosage of 
drugs or allergy etc. If it is connected with a watery sign, it may be by drowning, if with an 
airy house it may be due to an air crash. If Mars is connected with the 8th and fiery sign at 
birth and is the significator of death, then death may be by fire or violence, or by mechanical 
instruments.

Before proceeding with the analysis of the native’s natal chart on the accident, let me furnish 
what our KP system rules say on this- 


1) If the Ascendant cusp and the 8 cusp sub-lords signify 6-injury, ill-health due to acci- 
dents, 8-accidents, 12- hospitalization due to accidents or a fall, one may meet with acci- 
dents/fall during the conjoined period of the significations of the houses 4(end of every- 
thing including life)-6-8 and 12. (see May 2017 KP ezine) 

2) if Maraka and Badhaka houses are also signified or connected the accident may prove to 
be fatal. Death is indicated only by the significators of Maraka and Badhaka houses. (K.P. 
Reader 6 -—page 155, See Sri Chandrakanth R Bhatt-Nakshatra Chinthamani-page 31, 
Further Light on Nakshatra Chinthamani- Page35).

long journey happens to be the significator of houses 6 and 8 houses one will meet with 
an accident.

death are denoted by the sub-lord of the cusp of the 8 house. (KP Reader 3, page 171 
and 422).

houses, the serious accident will occur during the conjoined period of the significators of the

Hora- Time period results of the day for 2021 


By: KS Parthasarathy 
Emai: iyengarip@gmail.com 





‘REE EREREREREREEREREREREEEEEEEEEEREEEREREREEEEEEEE EH & 


In Hindu Astrology, a Day is made into 2-parts. From Sun-rise to Sun-set and Sun-set to 
next day Sun-rise. These 2-part’s periods are divided into 12 divisions each. These 24- 
Divisions of the day are called HORA . Each Hora period will be less or more than an Hour 
Each. Hora-period is ruled by 7 planets in cycle, Each Hora-period is Auspicious for some 
events and actions when executed. 

Taking Sun-rise & Sun-set time at point where Standard-Meridian of India (Long-82 O 30’-E) 
passes thro' tropic of cancer ( Lati- 23 O 30’-N )-[ Prayag-India], 24-HORA period- time for the 
year 2021 is calculated & tabulated as shown below. This can be used as ready reckoner to 
find out Auspicious time to execute an event on a particular Day of the month of the year 
2021. 


Ex: Signing a rent-agreement on 1 Jan. 2021 = In Jan- 

Chart, 1st Jan, Sun-Hora show before Sunset 

00:07 to 01:00 and 06:32 to 07:39 and after Sunset 02:21 to 03: 38: These 3-time periods 
are auspicious for that event. 


Since this is worked out for IST point , to check at other parts of India, leave 5 to 9 mins 
from border Times shown in chart : Ex: for Bangalore , for time shown 06:32 to 07:39, time 
06:38 to 07:33 will be safer to take. 


The results shown for a particular Hora-time will be constellation of the Hora planet or in the 
Planet’s more strong & beneficial If Moon Transit in own House during that Hora-time 
period.

Question 2: Do retrograde planets always give ill effects? 


Answer 2: 

No. Retrograde planets are neither good, nor bad. Just like other planets give good and bad 
results based on several factors of judgment as per system of astrology applied. 

Boxing champion Muhammad Ali (17 January 1942) has 6 retrograde planets Venus, Jupi- 
ter< Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto; American artist Frank Sinatra, Jr. (10 January 
1944) also 6 retro planets Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto; American Phi- 
losophy Professor Angela Davis (26 January 1944) 5 retro planets Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, 
Neptune and Pluto; American serial killer Ted Bundy (b 24 Nov 1946) has 5 retro planets 
Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus and Pluto but on the same day American Astrologer How- 
ard Burlington and American athlete J. Collins were born. 

In KP retrogression doesn’t matter in birth chart, and even in horary chart new trend is 
emerging not to consider retrogression. Choice is up to individual KP astrologer as evidence 
is showing both ways. BV Raman didn’t write anything about retrogression and of course he 
never applied it. 

e Saturn retrogrades for 140 days and remains stationary 5 day before and after. 

e Jupiter retrogrades 120 days is stationary 5 days before and after. 

e Mars retrogrades for 80 days and is stationary 3 to 4 days before and after. 

e Venus is retrograde for 42 days and is stationary approximately two days before and af- 
Ler. 

Mercury retrogrades for 24 days and is stationary one day before and after. 

Generally planets are strong when they are in retrograde motion, particularly in stationary 
time, as they are close to the earth but it doesn’t mean whether they are good or bad.

Book review-The Only Astrology Book You'll 
Ever Need 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 


BEEBE EERE RRR RRR 
The Only Astrology Book You'll Ever Need 
by Joanna Martine Woolfolk 

















This is still one of the best selling astrolamcal books (Western) published in the last 25 years. 
The title of this book is a mite ambitious as the subject of astrology is so vast that no book 
could possibly be the “only” book you'll need. While this book is not a thorough exploration of 
Astrology, it gives a decent foundation from which to begin a study of Astrology. 


The 21st century new edition (2010) of The Only Astrology Book You'll Ever Need is packed 
with updated information on Sun signs, Moon signs, Ascending signs, the placement of 
Planets in your Houses, and the latest astronomical discoveries. This book provides the 
compatibility between every sign (144 combinations) and dispenses advice about health, 
money, lifestyle, and romance, while also offering advice on dealing with the negative aspects 
of each sign. This edition also takes an even closer look at the inner life of the individual and 
the emotional needs that motivate a person. Chapters include a look back on the history and 
mythology of astrology as well as the newest developments in astronomy. 


Interpretations of the sun signs, moon signs, and the Ascendant, as well as health and love 
topics are some of the book’s stronger points. Synastry, the study of relationships, is touched 
upon, and a lot of attention is given to Astrology in history and legend. 

The author offers a “simplified” method of casting a birth chart — although rather accurate, 
we recommend using a free chart service on the web for an even easier, and more 
professional, method of obtaining your birth chart. 


For more information, user reviews, or to buy, follow this link:

Larry King, Iconic TV and Radio Interviewer, 
Dies at 87 






By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Larry King died in morning of 25 January 2021 at the Cedars-Sinal Mecical Center in Los 
Angeles after a weeks-long battle: with COVITII-19. He had several health scares in recent 
years, including multiple heart attacks, a lung cancer diagnosis and a stroke. 

King was best known for his two-and-a-half decade run as the raspy-voiced host of “Larry 
King Live,” CNN’s longest-running program and one of its most-watched. He won countless 
awards, including the Peabody Award for Excellence in broadcasting for both his radio and 
television shows. During his six-decade career King conducted an estimated 50,000 on-air 
interviews. In 1995, he presided over a Middle East peace summit with Palestine Liberation 
Organization Chairman Yasser Arafat, King Hussein of Jordan and Israeli Prime Minister 
Yitzhak Rabin. He welcomed everyone from the religious leader Dalai Lama to legendry 
actress Elizabeth Taylor, from well known Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev to former 
president Barack Obama, Microsoft founder billionaire Bill Gates to famous singer Lady 
Gaga.

Jupiter (9-1-3-12) and sub of Rahu (1) in sign Aquarius representing Saturn (1-2), signifying 
2-3-6-10 for success in making interview and money. (+ No planet is in the star of Mercury 
which is the CSL of houses 3 and 9.) 


2nd (speech, income and wealth) and 34 (interview) lord Saturn’s strongly occupation of 24 
house in his own sign makes him successful in doing interview and making money. In 
addition Rahu in Aquarius representing Saturn makes 24 and 3™ houses stronger. 

Viparita combination of 6 lord Venus, 8b lord Moon and 12 lord Mars in Lagna makes 
King to rose above personal tragedy, financial despair and half a dozen divorces to become 
one of the most revered and prolific interviewers in broadcasting.

Escaping life threat during accident 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com

K.P. Rules say that houses 4,8,12 deals with the accident. Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Kethu 
are the karakas of accident. If 8th or 12tn cuspal sublord signifies 8 or 12, accident may 
occur during the joint period of the significators of 4,8,12. Native faces life threat if the 
cuspal sublord is connected to maraca and badhaka significators. 


The native had met with accident on 6-7-2020 and his birth particulars are as follows: 
DOB: 24-8-1977 Time 1-24-28 am (rectified) Place: Nellore (Long 80-2’E Lat: 14-27’N) 


The native was born in Moola star with Gemini as ascendant. The 8 cuspal sublord is 
Rahu in the star and sub of Mars. Rahu is in 4 and the star lord Mars is in 12 lord of 6. 
Mars is conjunct with Jupiter, maraka and badhaka lord. As Rahu signifies 4, 6, 7, 12 it 
denotes accident. 


The 12‘ cuspal sublord is Jupiter in the star and sub of Rahu. Jupiter is in 1 lord of 7,8,11 
and the starlord is Rahu in 4 besides the portfolio of 8th CSL. As Jupiter signifies 4,7,8 it 


poses life threat to the native. 


The significators of accident are as follows: 


Cusp A B C D 
4 Jup , Sat, Ket Mer, Rah Mer Sun 
6 ---- Mon Mar, Rah Mar 
8 gees <== Ven Jjup 
12 Mar, Rah Mar ---- Ven 


On the date of accident the native was running the dasa, bhukthi,anthara of Mar-Mar-Ven. 
Dasalord and bhukthi lord Mars is in 12, lord of 6 in its own star and in the sub of Mercury 
in 4, lord of 1,2,5. Mars is conjunct with Jupiter in 1, lord 7,8,11 and aspected by Moon, 3"4 
lord. Thus Mars signifies 4,6,8,12 and also 2,7,1,3,5 and favourable for causing accident. 


The anthara lord Venus is in the star of Jupiter and sub of Mars. Venus is in 2, lord of 12 in 
the star of Jupiter in 1, lord of 7,8,11 and in the sub of mars, dasalord and bhukthi lord. As 
Venus signifies 8,12 and also 2,7,3,11 it is favourable for causing accident. 


So the accident had taken place on 6-7-2020 during the joint period of Mar-Mar-Ven which 
runs from 2-7-2020 to 27-7-2020 when the dasalord Mars is transiting in the star of 3,11 
significator Saturn (Uttarabhadra) in Pieces sign and anthara lord Venus is transiting in 12 
its own sign in the star of 3 lord Moon in Taurus sign. However the native escaped life 
threat as the DBA lords signifies 1,5,11.

Before Matching of a Couple 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan)

In Sept. 2011 a lady came to me, for a horoscope matching purpose for her daughter with a 
horoscope of a boy. As advised by the KP seniors and my Guru ji, it is my practical custom to 
check the chart of the opposite party of the consultant for several important matters like 
fortune of marriage, life span, general health, education, success of long term marriage life, 
possibility of separation or divorce etc. for suitability of adding as new member to the family. 
After checking the horoscope of the boy, I informed the said lady not to proceed the proposal 
of the boy and to see another person. This decision of mine was based on the following 
reasons found in the horoscope of the boy as below: 








Birth Details 

Name: Marriage, Gender: Male, Date: Thursday, 11/Jan/1979, Time: 04:05:54 AM, 
SID: 11:15:18, Place: Gampaha Dist. Gen. Hospital, Western, Sri Lanka, Lat: 07:05:00 
N, Lon: 80:00:00 E, TZ: +05:30 DST: 0.00, Ayanamsa: 23° 28' 27" Star: Mrigasira, Pada 
3, Lagna: Scorpio, Bal. Dasa: Mars 3 Y, 2 M, 1 D. 


Lagna lord Mars is the Lagna sub Lord as well as the sub lord of the 7 cusp for marriage. 
Mars is the lord of 1 & 6 and deposited in the sign of Sagittarius where the 2nd cusp is 
posited in conjunction with Sun the lord of 10. Mars is in the star of Sun and sub of own 
Mars. Mars is opposite to the Moon+ in Gemini at the end of 7th cusp. Moon is in 7 lord of 9. 
Thus Mars is a significator for 1, 6, 10, 2, 7 & 9, and is connected with two dual signs 
Gemini and Sagittarius. Accordingly Mars being the 7th cusp lord with its significations for 
2 & 7, can give the native a chance of marriage. 

Moreover the 11th cusp sub lord for pleasurable married life is Jupiter (R) the lord of 2&5 
in 8; in the star of Saturn and in the sub of Mars. Saturn being the star lord signifies 3,4,& 9 
and is connected with 7 & 12. Sub lord Mars as discussed above is a significator for a 
chance of marriage as well as detrimental indicator of marriage life. Hence it is sure the 
native will have to face a painful marriage life. 

Accordingly sub lords of 2, 7, 5 & 11 are playing the roles for having marriage and at the 
same time they present for the breaking of marriage. But according to the hunded times 
tested rules of KP for marriage, this native is not in an astrological decision to maintain the 
marriage tie for ever. The KP rules below witnesses for my decision are as below. 


Ref: KPEZine January 2016 
1)If 7th CSL be the significator of 2, 7 or 11 and 1, 4, 6, 8, 10 or 12, there will be the pos- 
sibility of both marriage & separation in life. 
2)If 7th CSL be the significator of 1, 6, 10 or 12, there will be separation of husband and 
wife. If 7th significators signifies 6, 9, wife will leave and if signifies 3, 12, husband will go 
away. 
3)Satisfied Multi Marriage Rules: (Statistical study done by Sri Kanak Bosmia the Editor of 
this magazine, under the guidance of Sri Raichur ji and Sri Tin Win ji) 
(a) MORE THAN ONE marriage is indicated if the BOTH following two conditions are simulta- 
neously satisfied: 
(i) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp OR its Star lord is deposited in a dual 
sign(Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces) 
OR 
if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury/Ju and 
(ii) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 or both. 
If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied.

Googly in Prediction

Mobile : +91-9868/748138 : Email : madhav.pti@gmail.com 











Former Indian captain and current BCCI president Sourav Ganguly is a very popular cricketer of our 
country. When he was hospitalised on 2nd January 2020 after chest pain, it was big news for sports 
lovers. Popularly known as 'Dada' among his fans, Ganguly was admitted to Kolkata's Woodlands 
Hospital after he suffered a 'mild cardiac arrest’. The BCCI chief was exercising on a treadmill at his 
home gym at that time. Later, the doctors performed an angioplasty on Ganguly and said that three 
blocks were found in his heart. They further said that he will need another angioplasty because of the 
"triple vessel disease but that depends on how his condition is". 


I am also a sports lover and fan of ‘Dada’ so I was worried regarding his health. Ganguly is a first 
cricket captain who gave killing instinct to Indian cricket team. Sourav Ganguly taking off his shirt 
and celebrating at the Lord's balcony still remains fresh in the memories of many. He is a real fighter, 
be it in cricket or in real life. So there is not an iota of doubt in my mind that Ganguly will not recover 
from this present health problem. But’ real question was of timing. 
Instead of reading much news about the health of Ganguly, I consulted the KP horary chart to know 
his well-being. My main question was when Dada will be discharged from the hospital? My horary 
number was 77. Moon was placed in 2nd house of chart and it was in Venus Nakshatra and Venus 
sub lord. Venus is 11th and 4th lord and placed in 5th bhava. If we have to see discharge of any 
patient from hospital, we also consult 11th house as it is 12th from 12th house. In these matters 5th 
house is also very crucial as it is 12th form 6th house. So Moon is representing the subject of our 
question at Nakshatra and sub lord level. 

We will see the significators of 4th, 5th and 11th house as they will help us to get the answer of this 
question.

Latitude- 28-40, Aynamasa- 24-03-14

Eleventh house: Rahu is placed in 11th house and no planet is placed in Rahu’s star. 11th lord is

So, common significators are Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu. As

DaReeRaeaeRaeeEReEReeBEeEHEREeHEEHEHEeHEeEHEHEHEEHEHEEHEHEEHEEHEHEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEBEEHEEHEEEEE EH&S 














This is a million-dollar question in the minds of the public at large, and everyone across the 
globe is eagerly awaiting for that blessed day. I would like to venture to answer this question 
through astrological analysis with the help of our KP system of astrology. 

Before proceeding further on the subject, I would like to furnish briefly hereunder the 
following information which is reflected in the media as expressed by WHO. 


Is there a vaccine for COVID-19? 

Not yet. Many potential vaccines for COVID-19 are being studied, and several large clinical 
trials may report results later this year. If a vaccine is proven safe and effective, it must be 
approved by national regulators, manufactured to exacting standards, and distributed. WHO 
is working with partners around the world to help coordinate key steps in this process. Once 
a safe and effective vaccine is available, WHO will work to facilitate equitable access for the 
billions of people who will need it. More information about COVID-19 vaccine development is 
available. 


There are many lingering questions in the minds of the common men on the Corona Virus 
vaccine. But our main concern is — 

When will COVID-19 vaccine be ready for distribution? 

What types of COVID-19 vaccines are being developed? How would they work? 

How will we know that COVID-19 vaccines are safe? 


In this regard, WHO categorically states that “We don’t yet know exactly when a safe and 
effective COVID-19 vaccine will be ready for distribution, but we estimate that it could be in 
early to mid of the next year ie:2021. Before COVID-19 vaccines can be delivered, several 
important challenges must be overcome:” 

The vaccines must be proven safe and effective in large (phase III) clinical trials. Many 
potential vaccines for COVID-19 are being studied, and some of the large clinical trials may 
report results in late 2020 or early 2021. 


A series of independent reviews of the efficacy and safety evidence is required, including 
regulatory review and approval in the country where the vaccine is manufactured, before 
WHO considers a vaccine product for prequalification. Part of this process also involves 
the Global Advisory Committee on Vaccine Safety. 


An external panel of experts convened by WHO, called SAGE, will analyze the results from 
clinical trials and along with evidence on the disease, age groups affected risk factors for 
disease, and other information, they will recommend whether and how the vaccines should 
be used. Officials in individual countries will decide whether to approve the vaccines for 
national use and develop policies for how to use the vaccines in their country based on the 
WHO recommendations. 


The vaccines must be manufactured in large quantities, which will be a major and 
unprecedented challenge - all the while continuing to produce all the other important 
life-saving vaccines already in use. As a final step, vaccines will be distributed through a 
complex logistical process, with rigorous stock management and temperature control. 


e WHO is cautiously optimistic that safe and effective vaccines for COVID-19 will be 


KP Ezine February 2021 35 


successfully developed. There is a robust pipeline of potential vaccines in development, 
and some have already advanced to large (phase III) clinical trials based on promising 
early data. 


e But for now, we can’t be certain if or when a COVID-19 vaccine will be available. That is 
why we must not rely on a future vaccine to fight this pandemic —- we must use all the 
tools we already have at our disposal, such as covid lock downs, testing, contact tracing, 
physical distancing, and the use of masks. 


e Scientists around the world are developing many potential vaccines for COVID-19. These 
vaccines are all designed to teach the body’s immune system to safely recognize and block 
the virus that causes COVID-19. Several different types of potential vaccines for COVID- 
19 are in the process of development, including the current ones, there is no evidence 
that any existing vaccines will protect against COVID-19. 


e However, scientists are studying whether some existing vaccines — such as the Bacille 
Calmette-Guérin (BCG) vaccine, which is used to prevent tuberculosis — are also effective 
for COVID-19. WHO will evaluate evidence from these studies when available. 


Will COVID-19 vaccines provide long-term protection? 

It's too early to know if COVID-19 vaccines will provide long-term protection. Additional 
research is needed to answer this question. However, it’s encouraging that available data 
suggest that most people who recover from COVID-19 develop an immune response that 
provides at least some protection against reinfection — although we're still learning how 
strong this protection is, and how long it lasts. 


It is also not yet clear how many doses of a COVID-19 vaccine will be needed. Most COVID- 
19 vaccines being tested now are using two dose regimens.

Postponement of marriage as dasa lord 
in transit not agreed 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-5000 18. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 











The parents of the native arranged betrothal ceremony of their son with the girl of the same 
town on 13-3-2020. On the day of betrothal ceremony they had also decided to celebrate the 
marriage on 17-4-2020 and fixed the marriage muhurtham accordingly. However marriage 
event could not taken place on the date fixed as the bridegroom is held up in a far away 
place on duty on account of lockdown due to covId-19. So we will find out the reasons 
astrologically for non-materialisation of the marriage event on the date fixed i.e. on 17-4- 
2020. The birth particulars of the native are as follows: 


DOB: 22-7-1986. Time: 8-09 pm. Place: Guntur 


As per KP the relevant houses of marriage are 2,7,11. If the cuspal sublord of 7th cusp 
signifies 2 or 7 or 11 the marriage is promised. The 7th CSL, in the chart of the native, is 
Kethu in 8 in the star of Mars in 11 lord of 3,10 and in the sub of Mercury in 6 lord of 5,8. 
Kethu being in the sign of Libra represents Venus in 7 lord of 4,9. As Kethu signifies 7,11 
marriage is promised. 


The significators for marriage are as follows: 


Cusp. A. Bs C. D 
Zz ---- Rahu Jup. Jup 
i. Ven, Mars. Ven. ---- sun 
11. Ket. Mars. Jup. Jup 


On the date of engagement (13-3-2020) the native is running the DBA of Jup-Ket-Sat. Dasa 
lord Jupiter is in 1 lord of 2,11 deposited in its own star and in the sub of sun in 6 lord of 7. 
The sublord Sun is aspected by Mars in 11 lord of 3,10. As Jupiter signifies 2,7,11,3 it is 
favourable for marriage negotiations and settlement. 


Bhukthi lord Kethu is in 8 in the star of Mars in 11 lord of 3,10 and in the sub of Mercury in 
6 lord of 5,8. The sublord Mercury is conjunct with Sun lord of 7 and also aspected by Mars 
in 11. Kethu is aspected by Dasalord Jupiter. Hence Bhukthi lord Kethu signifies 2,7,11,3,9 
and favourable for marriage negotiations and settlement. 


Anthara lord Saturn is a 3rd cuspal sublord in its own star Saturn (1,10,12) and in the sub 
of Venus in 7 lord of 9 which is only favourable for marriage settlement and not for 
conducting marriage as Saturn is not a significator of marriage. But betrothal ceremony had 
taken place as the DBA lords Jup-Ket-Sat are favourable for marriage settlement. 


Dasalord Jupiter in transit is not connected to 2,7,11 as Jupiter occupied 12th house 
Capricorn on 17-4-2020. Hence the celebration of marriage planned on 17-4-2020 had not 
taken place. 


Now we will analyse when the marriage will take place. The Jupiter in transit is in ret- 
rogression and enters its own sign Sagittarius, that is, 11th house of the native on 1-7-2020. 
On that date the DBA running is Jup-Ven-Ven. Dasalord Jupiter is favourable for conducting 
marriage as discussed above.

The “Option Theory” is based on the principle of ruling planets and the author has taken on- 
ly four planets viz: 


1. Ascenadant sign-lord/ 2. Moon star-lord/ 3. Moon sign-lord/ 4. Day-lord. 

Write down the Rasi numbers against each one of them, add the numbers and arrive at the 
total figure. If the total is more that the single digit, then add up the digits to make it a single 
digit number. Subtract the single digit number in multiples from the total options, till we get 
the reminder of a single digit. This reminder is the final choice which is indicated by the di- 
vine direction. 


In our query there four options of percentages of marks, out of which I want to know what 
percentage my grandson is likely to get--- 


Option No.1--65% to 70%. 


Option No.2--70% to 75%. 
Option No.3—75% to 80%.

An in-depth study of “What makes any astrologer a celebrity” and what are the KP Rules for 
any individual to become an astrologer and to be recognized as a celebrity astrologer”. (by 
Gunti Nagaraju) 

Astrology is the original science or a system of knowledge devised by our rishis and they are 
known as “Apourusheyas”(not written by human beings). So it is an integral part of our 
Vedas and so it is treated as a holy science. Astrology was the first cosmology through which 
the ancients comprehended the structure and movement of the universe. It was the science 
of fate or destiny, used for understanding events on earth, which were seen as originating in 
the heavens. Astrology was not only the original and foremost of the outer sciences, but it 
was also the most important of the inner or spiritual sciences. (David Frawley in his book 
‘Astrology of the Seers’) 

Sir Stephen Arroyo in his book ‘Astrology Karma & Transformation’ says “Astrology shows 
the language of cosmic energy, it helps us to understand all spheres of life. It is not a set of 
rules whereby one can mechanically interpret charts, but rather it is a guide to be used in 
unison with one’s intuition and personal experience. Specific rules may guide us in the first 
stages of our astrological studies, but they eventually must be left by the wayside as the 
Oneness and Love that transcends all our carefully devised rules and laws become more and 
more a living reality that illuminates each moment and each encounter with another human 
being’s mystery.” 

David Frawley sees astrology as “a means of converting all the universe into a symbol, a 
language for the development of the soul”. In this perspective, he proceeds with the amazing 
clarity to expound to use Jyotishya to grow in reverence for the Self and to move gradually 
towards Self-realization in one’s journey on the earth. 

I feel all our sacred sciences and Vedas are directed towards delivering the goals in helping 
us to achieve the fourfold objectives of life identified by our great Rishis of India. These are “ 
Dharma-Artha-Kama-Moksha”. Astrology as a branch of our sacred Vedas enables us to 
move towards these goals in an organized manner. 

As against the conventional views on astrology, the legendary astrologer of our times Sri K S 
KRISHNAMURTHY- an inventor of a new system called the “Krishnamurthy Padhdhathi” in 
astrology, brought out revolutionary changes with his “Sub-lord” theory and miracle “Ruling 
Planets” to show spellbinding results with unthinkable accuracy. 

Krishnamurthy Padhdhathi got its name from the inventor of this technique late Prof. K.S. 
Krishnamurthy (1908-1972), who developed this new technique of arriving at predictions. KP 
system is based on the stellar system of prediction and the ‘Sub Lords' the invention of 
which crowned Prof. Krishnamurthy and his followers with success. 

The stellar system was initially developed by two friends, Meena I (late R. Gopalakrishna 
Row) and Meena II (late N.V. Raghava Chary). 

The major difference between KP and traditional astrology lies in the METHOD of arriving at 
a prediction. The traditional system of astrology makes use of various charts and tables other 
than the birth (natal) or horary charts. The KP technique, on the other hand, uses only a few 
tools that remain constant in every situation. The basis of the KP technique lies in two 
fundamental tools: the Placidus House Division and the Sub-division of the constellation. 


In KP, the only system of house division followed is the Placidus (also called as the Semi-Arc) 
System of house division. In this system of house division, the birth or the horary chart is 
cast according to the precise latitude and longitude of the native or the place where the 
astrologer is sitting for analysis (if it is a horary chart). In the Placidus system of house

division, all the 12 houses may not be of equal length (longitude). It may so happen that

KP astrology interprets bhava or house results primarily based on the house cusp sub-lords 
and the sub lord's stellar or constellational significations. And the planetary effects are 
determined by the planets’ occupancy in a particular star and a subdivision within that star. 
These are explained in great detail in the subsequent chapters. Here we are only providing 
the fundamental differences in the modus operandi of arriving at a prediction through KP 
astrology vis-a-vis traditional astrology. So, according to KP, even though the cusp sub 
position is a very specific area demarcated by each of the 12 houses in the zodiac, these 
sub-areas are under the lordship of 9 planets. Therefore, to arrive at a concrete prediction, 
the signification of a house (through the cusp sub-lord) is taken into consideration through 
the 9 planets' house signification. 


Shri K. S. Krishnamurti also provided in his KP astrology a new tool called as the Ruling 
Planets (RPs). These RPs act as divine guidance when the astrologer needs some clarification 
or confirmation on certain issues that may be impeding him to arrive at a final judgment. 
These ruling planets are a master Key in the technique of KP and one must become adept at 
using these if one wishes to master this system of astrology. The use of RP in applied 
prediction is multifarious and infinite. The credit of the concept and its utility is solely 
attributable to the inventor of this system of astrology Sri K. S. Krishnamurty. 


Along with RPs, Sri K. S. Krishnamurty also provided us with a set of sub numbers from 1 to 
249. This set of 1-249 sub numbers has proved to be a very effective tool for analysis of 
horary or Prashna charts where certain specific queries are to be answered or where the 
birth time of the native is not known. To satisfy the curiosity of the readers at this point let 
us briefly say what these 1-249 sub numbers are. These sub numbers are the sub-divisions 
(and therefore, called as 'subs') of each of the 27 stars of the zodiac in the proportion of the 
Vimsottari Dasa system. Traditional astrology, however, has no such divisions of the stars of 
the zodiac. 

It is a common notion in the minds of many KP learners and practitioners that the inventor 
of KP System, late Prof. K. S. Krishnamurthy decried the traditional system of astrology as it 
is practised in India. Nothing is farther from the truth than this wrong notion. 

With these few lines of introduction on the previous and existing system of astrology, I would 
like to discuss the birth chart of an eminent and contemporary astrologer of our times Sri K

Question: Western Aspects in KP 


Is the BENEFICIAL and EVIL rule of the Western aspects between Dasa lord and Bhukti lord 
is applicable in KP? 

The Western sextile (60°) and trine (120°) aspects are clearly marked as BENEFICIAL and 
square (90°) and opposition (180°) as EVIL. 


Answer: 
The answer is NO. 


Because, in KP, no planet is wholly malefic or benefic which depends on occupation and 
lordship at the planet, star and sub levels. This KP basic rule cannot be reconciled with 
malefic or benefic by Traditional Vedic Western ideas and Western good and bad aspects. 


In addition, E grade significators by conj & aspect are weak and usually used as the last 
resort since all planets may be E grade significators in most cases as found in SW-print out 
of KP significators table. Moreover, only grade E significators aspected by grade A to D sig- 
nificators are to be considered. 


In p 113 of KP Reader I, Guruji KSK says "The Western system of aspects must be studied 
and used so as to arrive at accurate predictions. There is no shame in including the Western 
system where they have advanced and are correct." 


However, Hindu System aspect and conjunction are common in example charts of KP Read- 
ers as some are mentioned below;

degree even though not in the same sign;

Tiger Woods’ Survival from Serious Car Accident 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








~mERBEEEEEEEEBEEEEBREEREEEREERE EERE REE EERE EEE EE 


Brief Background 

Tiger Woods is considered one of the greatest golfers in history. He has won 82 tournaments, 
tied for the most in a career with Sam Snead, and he has won 15 major championships, 
second only to Jack Nicklaus. Woods' last tournament title was at the 2019 Zozo 
Championship in Japan. His most recent major victory was at the 2019 Masters. 








Tiger Woods' Genesis GV8O crashed and sustained "major damage" at 7:12 a.m. PT, 23 Feb 
2021, along a road in the Rancho Palos Verdes section of Los Angeles on Tuesday. 

Accidents are not uncommon in the area because of the downhill slopes and curves on the 
road. 


Images of the scene showed the sport utility vehicle on its side with its front end almost 
totally smashed apart. It's very fortunate that Mr. Woods was able to come out of this alive, 
because the interior of car was thankfully more or less intact, which gave him the cushion to 
survive. Otherwise, it would have been a fatal crash. Woods required lengthy surgery to a 
fractured leg and shattered ankle after the accident. Police have said there was no evidence 
that he was impaired by drugs or alcohol. 

Astrologically Tiger Woods has survived from car accidents because of promise of medium life 
and live saving significators of the joint dasa period lords. In addition there is not strong 
joint signification of badhaka, maraka and 4,8 and 12 houses for fatal accident. Because of 
life saving/ cure significators of 1,5,11 and 9, Tiger Woods is expected to be recovered soon. 


Indication of Serious Accident 

1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) Rahu+ (2) in Libra representing Venus (3-3), CSL of 1 (126 to 2),11 
having no planet in its stars; Rahu is in the star of Jupiter (7-4-7-8) and sub of Ketu+ (8), 
CSL of 4 having no planet in its stars, in Aries representing Mars (9-9), aspected by Saturn 
(11-5-6), signifying danger causing 7 (badhaka), 2 (maraka), 8 (accident), 6 (injury), 3 and 4 
(end of everything), along life saving 1 (12th to 2), 5 (12th to 6),11 (12 to 12) and 9 (good 
luck). 


It indicates medium life and danger to life by accident (8). So the 8t CSL is also checked as 
follows: 


8th CSL Jupiter (7-4-7-8) is in the star of Mercury (5-1-2-10) and sub of Sun (4-12), 
signifying danger causing 7,2,12,8, along life saving 1,5. It supports possible danger to life by 
accident. 

Danger to life by accident is confirmed but can be survived by life saving significators of 
1,5,11 and 9.

Marriage In the time of Corona 


By: Madhav Chaturvedi 
A-85 Shalimar Garden (Main) 
Shahibabad, Ghaziabad-201005 
Mob : +91-9868748138 ; Email : madhav.pti@gmail.com 











The native is an Engineer and he was unmarried up to 2019. His mother, who is my cousin 
sister, phoned me and asked about his marriage. She was very worried as native was her on- 
ly child and his marriage cannot me materialize due to various reasons. In KP there is no 
ambiguity as there are settled principals for every matter. To see the promise of marriage in 
any chart we consider seventh cusp sub lord. If seventh sub lord is connected with 2" or 7th 
or 11t house, there will be promise of marriage. 


Birth details: DOB-18/01/1989, TOB-13:17PM, POB- Lucknow, Ayanamsa- 23° 36' 50" 

In this case 7‘ cusp sub lord is Saturn. In Bhava chart Shani is 11 lord placed in 8 house 
with natural marriage karaka Venus. So there is strong promise of marriage in this chart. We 
know that Saturn is slow moving planet so generally it gives its result very slowly. In the pre- 
sent case we can clearly see this as native after completing three decades of his life, is still 
unmarried. 


Significators: we will determine the significators of 24, 7th and 11t house, who can materi- 
alize the wedding in their respective DBA. 


Second house: Sign lord of second cusp is Mercury. There is no planet situated in any con- 
stellation of Mercury. So Mercury is strong significator of second house. 


Seventh house: Sign lord of seventh cusp is Mars. There is no planet situated in any con- 
stellation of Mars. So Mars is strong significator of second house. 


Eleventh house: Like second and seventh house there is no planet in any constellation of 7th 
cusp sub lord Shani. 


When question was asked about the marriage of native, Jupiter Dasha and Saturn Bhukti 
was running. No doubt Jupiter is not included in the above significators. But Jupiter is as- 
pecting the seventh house and 2" lord Mercury. So Jupiter may give marriage in its Dasha. 
Now we will see whether Saturn can give marriage in its Bhukti? This is a tricky question for 
any astrologer as being seventh cusp sub lord Shani can give wedding but this will be decid- 
ed by the sub lord of Saturn. Venus is sub lord of Saturn. In Bhava chart Venus is lord of 
lagna so it will not help in marriage. Next Bhukti will be of Mercury which is a strong signifi- 
cator. Now only Mars was remaining. So I reached on this conclusion that marriage of this 
native will be performed In Jupiter Dasha Mercury Bhukti and Mars Antra which will run 
from 10 Nov 2020 to 28 Dec 2020. 


After telling the possible time to my cousin sister I forget about this matter. Last month in a 
telephonic conversation my cousin sister told me that marriage of this native was performed 
last year. I was very eager to know about marriage date so I called the mother of this native. 
When I inquired, she told me that due corona lockdown restriction she was unable to invite 
me in the wedding. The marriage was performed on Hariprabhodhini Ekadashi which was on 
25th Nov 2020. Knowing this I was very pleased as the event occurred within time frame 
which was given by me. On the day of marriage Sun was in the Mars’s sign Scorpio. Moon 
was in Pisces whose sign lord is Dasha nath Jupiter. At the time of marriage Moon was in 
Revati constellation whose lord is bhukti lord Mercury.

In my earlier article of “Child Birth / Denial of Child Birth / Delay in Child Birth (Part - J) I 
had written about the KP rules for Child birth. 


The 5t Cuspal Sublord (CSBL) should not be deposited in 4th house and it should not be 
connected with 6, 8 and 12. 


If 5th CSBL is deposited in 6 house then the chances of child issue is little. 
If 5th CSBL is deposited in 6t then there will be apprehension of disease. 
If 5th CSBL is deposited in 8 there will be defect in the child issuing organs. 


If 5th CSBL is deposited in 12‘ there will be excess sex desire but the chances of child is- 
sue is little. 

If 5th CSBL has connection with 2, 11 then there will be good position of progeny. 

Fertile Signs are Cancer (Kataka), Scorpio (Vrischika) and Pisces (Meena). 

Infertile or Barren Signs are Aries (Mesha), Gemini (Mithuna), Leo (Simha) and Virgo 
(Kanya). 

Indecisive Signs are Taurus (Vrushabha), Libra (Tula), Sagittarius (Dhanassu), Capricorn 
(Makara) and Aquarius (Kumbha). 


It is very difficult to judge on the basis of single dictum. 
But the DBAS will play a vital role in all life events. 


Analysis Points: Male (Husband): 


Delay in Child Birth in Male: (10.12.1976 @ 1.30 p.m. in Bangalore). Married in 
11.03.2007. 


5th and 11 CSBL is Venus and it is posited in 10 house but he is signifying 2, 5, 11 
through its Sub Lord Ketu (Ketu is conjoined with Jupiter and Jupiter posited in 24, 
Saturn is aspecting Ketu and Saturn is posited in 5‘ as well as Saturn is lord of 11. So, 
child birth is promised. 


But here the Venus is in Sun Star and Ketu Sub.

Question : Rasi and Bhava Chart 

In KP Reader III, 1971, p 135: 

“The sign is not very important. The house occupied by a planet should be judged, taking in 
which constellation the planet is posited. The role of the sign occupied by the planet is not so 
important, as that of the constellation.” 


In this regard, could you verify the role of Rasi and Bhava chart in KP. 


Answer: 

The South Indian ‘rasi chart’ gives the relative rasi positions with boundary lines of ‘rasi after 
rasi’ of Hindu zodiac for correct use of rasi-based Hindu aspects. By inserting the Placidus 
cusps and placing the planets in the Placidus houses, the house-based chart denotes the 
correct occupation and lordship of planets in finding KP significators. So it may be called the 
Rasi and Bhava chart. 


The Rasi chart is used to apply the Hindu aspect from rasi to rasi. The badhaka houses are 
determined by the rasi where the Lagna (cusp) is located. The dual signs(rasis) are used in 
determination of multiple cases like more than one marriage. The barren and fruitful signs 
are used in consideration of childbirth. The lord of sign where Rahu/ Ketu is located repre- 
sents Rahu/ Ketu. etc. 


The bhava chart is used for the determination of occupation of the planet as per the Placidus 
cusps. The occupied bhava of a planet is more important than bhavas owned by that planet. 
The constellation (star lord planet) is more important than the planet and the sub is more 
important than the constellation as a decider whether an event will be beneficial or not. 
Example Chart 


In this example chart, the 12‘ house starts from 12th cusp @Aquarius 4:59:26 and ends at 
1st cusp @Pisces 11:00; 1st house starts from 1st cusp @Pisces 11:00 and ends at 2™4 cusp 
@Aries 15:49:56; 224 house is from 224 cusp @Aries 15:49:56 to 3™4 cusp @ Taurus 14:20:17 
and so on. 


Fortuna @Pisces 00:39:55 is in the Lagna rasi but in the 12 house between 12 cusp and 
1st cusp. Rahu @Pisces 16:10:38 is also in the Lagna rasi, but in the 1st house between 1st 
cusp and 2™4 cusp. 

For “lordship” of a house, the lord of the rasi where the cusp falls should be taken: 

In this example chart, 1st cusp falls in Pisces rasi and so this rasi lord Jupiter is Lagna lord, 


which occupies 8 house; similarly 2.4 lord is Mars and 3" lord Venus. 


6th cusp falls in Leo rasi, and so this rasi lord Sun is the lord of 6 house; similarly 8 lord 
is Venus and 12‘ lord Saturn.

Rajinikanth to get India's highest film honour 


By: Tin Win 
;, Email: tw853@yahoo.com 
‘BREE EREEREEEEEEEREEREEEREREEEREEEEEEEEEEEEEEE EE & 
Indian movie superstar Rajinikanth, 70, will receive the Dadasaheb Phalke award, India's 
highest film honour. The award is given for lifetime contribution to Indian cinema and is 
named after Phalke, director of “Raja Harischandra” (1913), India’s first full-length feature, 
who is considered the father of Indian cinema. It carries a prize of INR 1 million (US$13,600). 
Announcing the 2021 award recipient on April 1st 2021, India's Information and Broadcast- 
ing Minister Prakash Javadekar said in a tweet that Rajinikanth is "one of the greatest actors 
in the history of Indian cinema" and that "his contribution as actor, producer and screen- 
writer has been iconic". 
Past winners of the Dadasaheb Phalke award include filmmakers Satyajit Ray, Adoor Gopala- 
krishnan, Mrinal Sen, Shyam Benegal and Tapan Sinha, actors Soumitra Chatterjee, Amit- 
abh Bachchan, Dilip Kumar, Rajkumar, Sivaji Ganesan, Akkineni Nageswara Rao and 
Shashi Kapoor, and musicians Manna Dey, Bhupen Hazarika, Lata Mangeshkar and Asha 
Bhonsle. 


























Born Shivaji Rao Gaekwad, Rajinikanth began his career in 1975 and has starred in 160 
movies, gaining fans at home and abroad. His new film, action drama Annaatthe, is due later 
this year. Rajinikanth began his career in 1975 with the Tamil-language film “Apoorva Raa- 
gangal.” Since then he has starred in more than 160 films across Indian languages and at- 
tained cult status. Rajinikanth is a phenomenon among South Indian stars. His popularity 
includes fan bases in the U.S. and Japan. In addition to acting, he has also worked as a pro- 
ducer and screenwriter. He has won many awards, including four Tamil Nadu State Film 
Best Actor Awards and a Filmfare Best Tamil Actor Award. The Government of India has 
honored him with the Padma Bhushan (2000) and the Padma Vibhushan (2016). 

Rajinikanth was paid 2260 million for his role in S. Shankar's Sivaji (2007), which made him 
the second-highest paid actor in Asia after Jackie Chan. His new film, action drama Annaat- 
the, is scheduled to release for the popular Diwali festival in November 2021.

Celebration of marriage held up due to 
non-agreement of transit 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
| Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 
‘EERE EEE EREEEEREEEREEREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE EE & 
In February 2020 a friend of my son told me that he has received a marriage proposal in 
which he got interest. But it is not successful though he is interested as nobody from bride 
side has come forward for settlement. In this connection he requested me to find out the 
reason astrologically and also the probable period of settlement and marriage celebration. He 
has furnished his details as under: 








DOB: 7-2-1993 Time: 1-03 am Place: Patancheroo 


K.P. Rule: Houses 2,7,11 deals with the marriage. If the cuspal sublord of 7th house signifies 
2 or 7 or 11 marriage is promised. If the 7t® CSL signifies 8,12 there will be some hurdles in 
the celebration of marriage or inharmonious relations between the couples after marriage. 


The 7th cuspal sublord in this chart is Rahu. Rahu is in 1 in the star of Mercury in 4 lord of 
8,11 and occupies its own sub. Rahu represents Mars being in the sign of Scorpio. Mars is 
in 8 lord of 1,6 in the star of Rahu in 1 and in the sub of Venus in 5 lord of 7,12. As Rahu 
signifies 7,11 marriage is promised but at the same time Rahu signifies 1,4,6,8,12 indicating 
inharmonious relations leading to separation. 


The significators for marriage are as follows: 


Cusp A B C D 
2 — — — Jup 
7 — Ket — Ven 
11 — Jup Mon, Rah Mer 


In February 2020 the native has been running the dasa, bhukthi of Venus-Rahu. 


Dasalord Venus is in the star of Saturn and sub of Jupiter. Venus is in 5 lord of 7,12 in the 
star of Saturn in 3 lord of 4 and in the sub of Jupiter in 11 lord of 2,5. As Venus signifies 
3,11,7 it is favourable for negotiations and settlement of marriage. 


The bhukthi lord Rahu is in 1 in the star of Mercury in 4 lord of 8,11 and in its own sub. 
Further Rahu as agent of Mars signifies predominantly negative houses 1,6,8,12 as stated 
above, it is not favourable for marriage negotiations. Hence the people from bride side could 
not come forward for negotiations of settlement of marriage as revealed by the native. 


However Rahu bhukthi ended on 13-10-2020 and Jupiter bhukthi commenced 
subsequently. Jupiter is in the star of Moon and in the sub of Venus. Jupiter is in 11 lord 
of 2,5 in the star of Moon in 9 and in the sub of Venus in 5 lord of 7,12. The starlord Moon 
is aspected by Saturn lord of 3. As Jupiter signifies 3,9,11,7 it is favourable for negotiations 
and settlement of marriage during its bhukthi period. 


As Jupiter has got positional status it can be considered as anthara lord for settlement of 


marriage negotiations. The conjoint period of Venus-Jup-Jup runs from 27-9-2020 to 4-2- 
2021 during which period the negotiations will be finalized.

period of Ven-Jup-Jup. But the marriage has not taken place during this conjoint period as 
the transit of DBA lords have not agreed for the event.

it is aspected by bhukthi lord Jupiter significator of 2,5,11. As Saturn assumes the role of 
Jupiter it is favourable for conducting the marriage. But the event may not take place during 
Saturn anthara as the transit is not agreed once again.

How Divorce proved by the DBAS 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 

















Once a gentleman came to me with his horoscope and asked me to see whether there is 
"Dhana Yoga" for him in near future. Further he said that several astrologers in Sri Lanka 
have mentioned that he will be a millionaire very soon and also said that it has not 
happened yet. 

If someone is lucky to be an ad libitum millionaire, he must be a winner of lottery at least, if 
not he should find a bag full of money lying on the road. However I checked the horoscope 
for the matter, but found nothing such a chance. But only one planet is capable of giving 
him amass wealth and to increase his bank balance through 2nd cusp. It is Venus, the 
lagna sub lord as well as his dasa lord at the birth. Venus dasa balance was O1 Y, 08 Mnth 
& 29 days. So he had finished birth dasa at his age of Ol year & 11 months. In this infantry 
age the native is not eligible to have amassed wealth. If any dasa lord in his earning age, is 
qualified to give him a big wealth, Venus can help in its bukthi or anthar for the said for- 
tune. But even in future not any Dasa Lord agrees with crorapathi significations. 

What I want to explain here is although anything is written in the planetary map; it will 
come to effect only in the perfect Dasa. This theory is furnished in detail under " KP for 
Beginners- Part 10 - Results to be Given by Dasa / Bhukti / Antara Lords" by Sri Tin Win ji, 
in the issue of KPEZine, Jan. 2009. 

Quotation: 


1."By occupation and lordship, the Dasa lord and its star lord indicate the houses, whose 
matters will be enjoyed during the Dasa period. The sub lord of the Dasa lord will indicate 
whether the results indicated by the Dasa lord and its star lord will be positive or negative. If 
the planet is conjoined with/ aspected by another planet, it will give the results indicated by 
another as the weak grade ‘E’ significators." 
2. "The same can be said about the Bhukti lord also. The Dasa lord is the most powerful 
commander. No Bhukti lord can offer a result, if the Dasa lord does not permit. What the 
Bhuktit lord can do is to obstruct the Dasa lord from giving results but he cannot alter the 
result. The Antaara and Sookshma lords can carry out the mandate of the Dasa/ Bhukti lords, 
if they have similar significations as the Dasa/ Bhukti lords. If not, the event cannot take place 
in their Antara or Sookshma and will have to wait for another Antara/ Sookshma periods 
when they can execute the results destined by the Dasa/ Bhukti lords. Planets form a cabinet. 
The prime minister is the Dasa lord. The Bhukti lords are the ministers and the Antara lords 
are deputy ministers." 
To prove this stable theory of KP with my experience, I would like to take you all back to 
past KPEZine, March 2020 and article published therein under the caption of "Potency 
vs Impotency = Family Dispute". In that article, I have deeply discussed the matter 
under study and have given my verdict as, " According to above significations of 

Venus, the second marriage is promised and the karmic effects in the chart writ- 
ten through the pressures of the planets are seemed to be with sufficient powers 
to loosen the marriage tie of this couple and may lead to divorce. 

As concluded it has come true and the court of law has given a fair judgment for divorce. 
Now I am trying to prove the unswerving KP rules for the incident step by step with the 
relevant DBAS and their roles for the matter.

A word about DBAS 

The DBAS lords give the timing of event when agree with transit. 
Hindu sages are the founders of this system of DBAS, calculated on the exact position of 
Moon at the time of birth and called the period of planets as "Dasas". Also they have adopted 
and advocated many dasdas, of which three are widely used. They are Vimsoththari Dasa, 
Astottara Dasa and Kalchakra Dasa. Of these Vimsoththari Dasa is found to be very simple 
and scientific. 
They have taken the seven planets, who rule the seven days of the week and also the nodes 
Rahu and Kethu. It is not yet known why they have recommended to follow a particular or- 
der of planets and also why they have allotted each planet a particular number of years, as 
we use today. This system is widely used in as iit works, 
My bow down headed Namaskar to our respected Guruji Sri K.S.Krishnamurti and to my KP 
Guru Sri Tin Win ji.

Marriage and compatibility from KP composite 
charts (KPCC) 


By: Sayantan Biswas

‘EERE EREEREEREEEREEEREEEEEEREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE EE & 
Firstly before starting I would like to thank my guru Kanak Sir for teaching me the tech- 
niques of KP Composite Charts. I used this technique in this case to find the marriage com- 
patibility of husband and wife in this example. There will be three part series. Next will be 
between two business partner and third between business owner and sub-contractor. 
Calculations for Bhawa and Planets-: 

1> These composite charts are calculated by adding the houses degree (bhawa) and 

then dividing it by 2. (Since I am finding midpoints of two charts so it is divided by 2. 

If it was 3 three then it will be divided by 3, if 4 then divided by 4 and so on) 

2> Same goes for planets. So by adding the degree of planets in the charts and then 

dividing it by 2. (Since I am finding midpoints of two charts so it is divided by 2. If it 

was 3 three then it will be divided by 3, if 4 then divided by 4 and so on) 


Calculation of Birth date and Dasha -: 

Birth date of composite chart calculated by adding the date of birth of two charts. This is on- 
ly done to find the Dasha and Bhukti. For the Dasha Bhukti moon deree and 

Prediction procedure-: 

In this example I am calculating marriage. So, the composite 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is for ex- 
ample planet “x”. Now what this planet “x” signifies, individually in the charts of both male 
and female is to be calculated. This will determine the compatibility between the two people. 
Same goes for dasha and bhukti. Suppose currently “A” dasha and “B” bhukti is running ac- 
cording to composite charts. Then what that “A” and “B” signify individually in both the per- 
sonal horoscope of boy and girl will determine the current condition of their married life. 


A client consulted me, to find out the quality of her married life. She has given details of both 
her and her husband’s

Short Background 

Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates and his wife, Melinda, have announced their divorce on 
Monday, 3 May 2021, ending a marriage of 27 years that launched an influential 
globe-spanning philanthropic and humanitarian empire. They have said, “We no longer 
believe we can grow together as a couple”. 

They first met in the 1987 when Melinda joined Bill’s Microsoft firm. They married in 1994, 
and have three children together, Jennifer, 25, Rory, 21, and Phobe, 18. The Gates worked 
out in advance how to separate their estimated $133 billion in net worth but not yet known 
for public. 

In 2000, they started the Bill and Melinda Gates foundation, a philanthropic organization 
that has spent $53.8 billion in its fight against “poverty, disease and inequity around the 
world”. The charity, which is considered one of the world’s largest, have invested more than 
$1.75 billion to fight COVID-19. They have said to continue to work together at the 
foundation. 





As per KP astrology of marriage and married life, the unhappy married life appears 
to be a reason of divorce of Bill and Melinda Gates. 

Cuspal Sub Lord Analysis 

According to the latest available “A” rated Astrodatabank birth time of Bill Gates:

of Venus+ (5-5). No planet is in the stars of Venus, and Venus is the CSL of 2-8. The 2 and 
7th significators indicate promise of marriage. The 5t significator shows love marriage. On 1st 
January 1994 he married his company general manager Melinda French. The 6, 10 and 8th 
significators denote separation and divorce. 


11th (relationships and married life) CSL Rahu is in 5, Scorpio sign representing Mars (4,11). 


Rahu is in the star of Mercury (4,4-12) and sub of Jupiter (2,6-10). The 2,5 and 11th 
significators are indicators for happy married life, and 4,6,10 and 12t significators for

Myanmar coup Analysis 








By: Kanakkumar B. Bosmia 
613- P.B. Parekh Tower, Nr. Diwan Ballubhai School, 
Kankariya-Ahmedabad: Pin: 380022 
Mobile : +91-9825131165: Email : kanakbosmia@yahoo.com; 


Short History 

A coup d'état in Myanmar began on the morning of 1 February 2021, when democratically 
elected members of the country's ruling party, the National League for Democracy (NLD), 
were deposed by the Tatmadaw—Myanmar's military— which then vested power in a 
stratocracy. The Tatmadaw proclaimed a year-long state of emergency and declared power 
had been transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Defense Services Min Aung Hlaing. It 
declared the results of the November 2020 general election invalid and stated its intent to 
hold a new election at the end of the state of emergency even though most of Myanmar's 
people are satisfied with the results of the election. The coup d'état occurred the day before 
the Parliament of Myanmar was due to swear in the members elected at the 2020 election, 
thereby preventing this from occurring. President Win Myint and State Counsellor Aung San 
Suu Kyi were detained, along with ministers, their deputies and members of Parliament. 


Myanmar coup
