(Data curtsy- Mr. Tin Win ji USA) 


Longevity 
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significator of the house 6-8-12 the life is short 
(about 33 years). 


If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significator of the house 1-5-9 the life is long 
(about more than 66 years). 


If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significator of the house 6-8-12 and 1-5-9, the 
life is medium (about 66 years). 


If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significator of the Badhaka and Maraka hous- 
es, the life is short. If the cuspal joint rulers (the sign lord, star lord and sub lord) of the As- 
cendant or the 8th cusp be the significator of the Badhaka and Maraka houses, their joint 
period is very critical for life. 


Ascendant (Scorpio 23°.12’.04”): The sub lord of the Ascendant is Moon. Moon is in the 
star and sub of Sun. Moon is occupant of 10, owner of 9. Star and sub lord Sun is occupant 
of 2. Thus Ascendant sub lord Moon signifies 10-9 (Badhaka)-2 (Maraka). Thus Ascendant 
sub lord indicates short life. 


Dictator or Military Ruler’s end 
Hint 
If 8th sublord (Secret work of enemy, in this case we can say Opposition Party) signifies 5 


(12th from 6 Dictator), 9t2 (12th from 10- Those in Power), 12» (loss), then the ruler faces trou- 
ble and the end of his government.

Comparative analysis of two late presidents of USA who 
have been assassinated by two culprits of the same nation 


By: Gunti Nagaraju 
KP astrologer (M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer) 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, 
Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27172206; 9490752371; 
Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 


‘BEER EEREEEEEHEEHEEEEEEEEEEEEHEEEEEEEEEEE HH 








The following are the list of "coincidences" that are commonly associated with the conspiracy, 
some of which are not true statements: 


1) "Lincoln" and "Kennedy" each have 7 letters.---yes—True. 


2) Both presidents were elected to Congress in '46 and later to the presidency in '60. 
---This is not true--- Mr LINCOLN became president in 1850 whereas Mr Kennedy became 
president in 1961. 


3) Both married women in their 20s while themselves in their 30s. 16 

--- This is not true—Mr. Lincoln married in his 33 year while Mr Kennedy married in his 
36th year. 

Both lost a son while living in the White House.|5| 

Both were shot in the presence of their wives. 


4) Both assassins, John Wilkes Booth and Lee Harvey Oswald were born in '39. 
---This is not true---Booth was born on 10 May 1808 and Oswald was born on 180CT1939. 


Both were known by their three names, composed of fifteen letters. Both ran from Ford's 
Theatre and was caught in a warehouse; Oswald ran from the Dealey Plaza warehouse and 
was caught in a theatre. Both presidents were runners-up for the party's nomination for 
vice-president in '56. Both successors were Southern Democrats surnamed Johnson; both 
were born in '08 and their first names contained six letters. The assassins were both 
Southerners. 

Both were particularly concerned with civil rights,[5] and made their views strongly known in 
'63. Lincoln signed the Emancipation Proclamation in 1862, which became law a year later. 
A century later, Kennedy presented his reports to Congress on Civil Rights, during the 
famous March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom that same year. 


Both presidents were shot in the head on a Friday and died at nearby locations (Lincoln at 
the Petersen House across the street and Kennedy at Parkland Memorial Hospital down the 
road). 

Lincoln was shot in a Limousine Car at Ford's Theatre. Kennedy was shot in a Ford car: 
Lincoln had a secretary named Kennedy who told him not to go to Ford's Theatre. Kennedy 
had a secretary named Evelyn Lincoln (whose husband Harold's nickname was Abe), and she 
warned him not to go to Dallas.!5! 

Both Oswald and Booth were assassinated before they could be put on trial.|5! 


Accuracy of statements 

True statements 

Both were elected to Congress in '46: Lincoln was elected in 1846 from Illinois, and Kennedy 
was elected in 1946 from Massachusetts. 

Both were elected to the presidency in '60: Lincoln was elected in 1860,/!1][12] and Kennedy 
was elected in 1960. 

Both have seven letters in their last names ("Lincoln" and "Kennedy"). 

Both were concerned with civil rights: 

Lincoln felt strongly that all slaves should be freed and issued the Emancipation

With this basic information on the similarities between the two major life and death events of 
notable presidents of the United States of America, I am attempting to tally the similarities of 
some of the major life events and how far they are justified astrologically. 


Astrological analysis of the natal charts of the presidents of the USA who died by 
Assassination--- 

Before proceeding with my analysis on the main topic of “assassination” let me briefly dis- 
cuss the accidental deaths/ unnatural and sudden deaths/ assassinated deaths. 

Mr CELESTE TEAL a famous western astrologer in his book “Predicting Event with astrology” 
explains the importance of the role played by Mars, Uranus and Pluto in such events of un- 
natural/sudden and accidental deaths. He explains by saying” In most of the cases of acci- 
dental or unnatural or assassinated deaths, Mars is considered as a malefic planet for good 
reasons. When prominent and afflicted, it reflects the potential for accidents, deaths, and un- 
expected and unforeseen acts. 

Uranus is often a prominent planet when risk and danger are near. It is frequently involved 
in afflicting aspects when accidents occur, especially when they come out of the blue or un- 
expectedly. Uranus acts at lightning speed. Uranus in afflictions with Mars is the most dan- 
gerous aspect when trouble comes from unexpected directions. It is a fiery and explosive 
combination, suggesting accident-prone tendencies. 


As per our KP system of astrology— 8 bhava, 12th bhava, ascendant along with Mars, Sat- 
urn, Uranus and nodes play a very vital role in such incidents. 

8th bhava tells about longevity, deaths and mode of deaths, misfortunes, prone to accidents, 
the density of seriousness of the accidents and its timing. If it is badly connected to the 8th 
one should predict that the native himself be the cause of death. If 12th is well connected to 
8th, it can be predicted that the place of death to be unknown or foreign. 

If Uranus and Neptune are connected to the 8t8 mysterious and sudden death may take 
place. Slow and long death is caused by Saturn. Peaceful and natural death will be given by 


KP Ezine May 2021 39 


Jupiter. Violent deaths, encountered deaths, by Mars, is with its cruel natured involvement. 
12th bhava speaks of final emancipation. It is a house of great sacrifice and unexpected trou- 
bles because of the secret inimical activity. One may be murdered or assassinated during the 
afflicted 12th house period. 


When the Prarabdha karma, which a human being carries with him through his birth into 
this physical world, gets diminished by its balance, only during the period of 12th bhava sig- 
nificator connected to 8th house, death may result during the period of any planet signifying 
12th along with Maraka and Badhaka houses. 


*While I was going through the old issue of the K.P. Astrology & Athrishta magazine of 1978 
November issue, wherein I happen to read an article “Eight House and Unnatural death” vurit- 
ten by Sri MGG Nayar (pages37-39). Some of the relevant excerpts are reproduced for the bene- 
fit of the readers. 


ase: There are quite a several yogas describing the unnatural deaths (Dur-Mrityu yogas) in 
traditional astrology. The astrologer first has to look for the presence of such yogas in the 
chart before deciding the longevity issue of the native. For the convenience of the reader, few 
such yogas are given hereunder. 


1. Sun in 10-(karma) and Mars in 4(Bandhu) is said to indicate death by the fall from the 
mountain top. Perhaps some of the Himalayan explorers who met death in this manner have 
this type of yoga in their charts. 


2. Moon in Mars sign (Aries or Scorpio) hemmed between malefic planets shows death from 
weapons or fire. 


3. Pisces ascendant with the Sun and the Moon in it is said to indicate death by drowning 
and so on. 


4.Place of Death 

If the 8th CSL signifies 1, 4, 10, the end will come in his place. 

If the 8th CSL signifies 3, the end will be on a journey mostly on returning. 

If the 8th CSL signifies 6, 8, 12 death is in a hospital, jail or unknown place. 

If the 8th CSL signifies 9, death occurs in a long journey and usually far-off place. 


K. P. Rules on Death-- 

1. "Death is indicated only by the = significators of Marakasthana and 
Badhakasthana." (KP READER  VI,1978 or 2002 p 155; also repeated in K. 
Hariharan: LONGEVITY,1986 pp 36/50). 

2. Quoted from the article "Life span and Badhakasthan", written by P. R. Gangaram, Dombivllt 
(W), Thane Dist, Maharashtra, and published in A & A of July 1977, 


//¥irst Stage 

Find out who rules the sub-portion of the Lagan and whose star this sub lord occupies. 
Wherever that star lord is posited, that Bhawa and other planets grouped therein by way of 
the signification of the Bhawa give the clue. 

In case the sub lord of lagna or the star occupied by the lagna sub lord is a node, you will 
have to see, whether this node is aspected by or conjoined with any planet, who is a 
significator of Maraka Sthana or Bdhaka Sthan. If the aspect is present or the conjunction is 
there, the node acts according to the planet with which it is conjoined or by which it is 
aspected. When both are not present, the node represents the lord of Rasi occupied by it. 
Therefore assume as if the node is occupying the star of the rasi lord and find out where that 
lord is placed. 

Second Stage 

Death can take place only during the conjoined periods of planets, signifying Marakasthana 
and/or Badhakasthana. They must have direct or indirect links among them. The direct link 


KP Ezine May 2021 40 


means, connection by occupation in each other's sign, star and/or sub, aspects and 
conjunctions between planets. 

Indirect links mean, two planets occupying in any of the stars and/or sub or sign of a third 
planet or the planet "A", by occupying the star of planet "B" and aspecting planet "C", thereby 
establishing the relationship between B and C through A or planet "A", by occupying the star 
of another planet and aspecting the planet "B", in whose star "C" is occupied, the connection 
between A & C is indirectly established. 

The significators of Marakasthana will qualify themselves for inflicting death during their 
periods if only their sub lords are significators of Badhakasthana. In other words, the death 
inflicting planets must have connection invariably with Badhaksthana by signification or 
occupying the sub of significator of that house. 


The third and final stage 

Among the planets connected with Badhakasthana, as explained above, find out who are all 
connected with co-rulers of the cusp, and what matters the sub lord of Ascendant strongly 
signifies. It will be found that this co-rulers of the cusp are invariably signifying 
Marakasthanas or Badhaksthana. If the co-rulers are themselves qualified for inflicting death 
due to their connection with Badhakasthana, the death take place during their periods and sub 
-periods, provided of course, they are signifying the house, which ts co-ruled by them. 

While selecting significators, the following information will be very useful. 

In some cases, the Dasa, Bukthi, Anthar and Shooksma are all ruled by one planet. To 
happen this way the same planet must be signifying all houses concerned with the matter 
with the due co-operation of its sub lord. Moreover, this way the same planet must occupy a 
dual sign well as the star of a planet either owning and occupying (Mercury and Jupiter only 
possible) a dual sign or occupying the star of another planet in a dual sign. For example take 
Venus(For marriage) as lord of 2nd occupying the star of Mer in Meena, 7th house and sub of 
Ju, when star-lord Mer occupies Kanya, in the star of Mo in conjunction and sub lord Ju 
occupies Me star in Kataka, 11th house. Sometimes this type of repetition will be limited to 
three times, when that planet in a dual sign occupies the star of Mercury or Jupiter in a dual 
sign, but not in their star or the star of a planet in a dual sign. Limitations to two will be 
there, when the planet, in whose period the event take place, is occupying the star or sub of 
a planet in a dual sign or the star of a dual sign planet. The same is the case when planet "A" 
while occupying a dual sign, in the star of "B"(not in a dual sign) but the star of a planet "C" 
in dual sign or occupies the star of another planet in a dual sign. In other words, the effect of 
"C" is passed on to A through B. 

If a node is placed in the star or sign of the planet under consideration, the node will 
represent the planet wholly or partially. ie. both the planets and the node concerned will be 
among the ruling planets of the periods. 

From this, we understand that the four dual signs and their lords and planets in dual signs 
show a multiplicity of events and effects. If we checkup the horoscope of individuals who 
have many children, we find that more planets are connected in the above manner and with 
the 5th house, mostly a dual sign. Similarly, if many planets are connected with dual signs 
or planets owning or occupying dual signs and at the same time, they strongly signify houses 
2, 6, 10 and 11, success will be in many ways and it will be certain. 

If none of these yogas is present in the natal chart, consider the strongest among the planets 
aspecting the 8th. The nature of that planet together with the nature of the sign-in which it is 
posited, and the part of the body indicated by the sign determines the mode of the death. If 
no planet is aspecting 8, consider the planet occupying the 8. If the 8th house is not aspected 
and unoccupied, consider the 8t lord of the lord of the 2224 Drekkana, whichever is stronger 
and so on. 

These yoga’s and rules very often do not give the results attributed to them when comes to 
litmus test especially in the cases of twins. 

The nature of the death is, no doubt, to be judged from the house of the 8th in the chart. But 
K.P. says that it is the lord of the minute sub of the 8t* cusp that affords the correct clue to 
the mode of the death. This method will be found to give correct results in the case of twins 
for obvious reasons. 

Apart from the sub-lord of the 8t cusp satisfying the required conditions, the sub-lord of the 


KP Ezine May 2021 41 


7th cusp should be deposited in the constellation of a planet signifying the Maraka sthana or 
Badhaka sthana and also of the 8th of the native, if he should meet death at the hands of the 
assassin. The ruling planets of the assassin will agree with the planets co-ruling the cusp of 
the 7th and those connected with them. 

With this brief introduction on the subject, I would be making an effort to analyze the two 
charts of late presidents of the USA, by applying the above KP rules, to reiterate the efficacy of 


the KP system of astrology and the importance of Sub-Lord theory.

Loss of father in childhood 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 


‘EERE EEREHEHEEREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE EH EH 








The birth particulars of a girl are communicated to me for examining her horoscope who has 
borne in Bilaspur (CG) on 5th December, 2007 at 10-40 pm. The native has borne in Chitra 
star (Libra sign) with ascendant Leo. 


At the time of birth the native has got the dasa balance of Mars of 7 months 18 days. 
Afterwards she entered the period of Rahu dasa. In her horoscope Rahu has occupied the 
Aquarius sign which is a badhakasthana to her father. Mars in Rahu star (Arudra) is 
aspecting 6th house. Mercury has occupied the sign Scorpio which is a 8th house to her 
father. Moon has occupied the sign Libra which is a marakasthana to her father. During 
the conjoint period of Rahu, Mercury and Moon the father of the native has to face life threat 
with serious health problems. 

Hence we will examine the horoscope of the father by rotating the native’s chart to 9th house 
Aries from the native’s lagna (Leo). So Aries sign will become the lagna of the native’s father. 


In the rotated chart dasa lord Rahu occupies badhakasthana 11th house in its own star and 
sub. Being in the sign of Aquarius Rahu not only represents Saturn but also aspected by 
Saturn. Saturn is in 5 lord of 10, 11 in the star and sub of Venus in 7 lord of 2,7. Jupiter 
12th lord from 8th house aspecting Saturn. Thus Rahu signifies badhaka, maraca and 8th 
house which denotes life threat to the native’s father. 


Planet Mercury, in the rotated chart, has occupied 8t» house lord of 3,6 in the star of Saturn 
who signifies 5,8,12,10,11 as discussed above and in the sub of Mars in 3 lord of 1,8. Jupi- 
ter in 8 is also aspecting Mars. So Mercury signifies in all 5,6,8,12,10,11 houses posing seri- 
ous health problems and indicating life threat. 


In the rotated chart Moon, aspected by badhaka lord Saturn, is in maraca house 7 lord of 4. 
Moon is in the star of Mars in 3 lord of 1,8 and in the sub of Sun in 8 lord of 4. Sun is con- 
joined with 6th lord Mercury. So Moon signifies maraca, badhaka and 6,8 houses indicating 
life threat with serious health problems. 


In the rotated chart Sun is afflicted by 6th lord Mercury and its sign Leo is afflicted by Saturn 
and Kethu. MHence the native’s father might have suffering with chronic heart disease and it 
is flared up in the conjoint period of Rah-Mer-Mon. The conjoint period of Rah-Mer-Mon be- 
tween 29-7-2017 and 14-10-2017 is a critical one and poses danger to the native’s father. It 
is learnt that the native’s father died of heart attack on 12-10-2017. 


TRANSIT: Dasalord Rahu was transiting in the star of bhukthi lord Mercury (Aslesha). 
Bhukthi lord Mercury was transiting in the sign of Libra, maraca house. Anthara lord Moon 
was transiting in the sign of bhukthi lord (Gemini). Sun was transiting in the sign of bhuk- 
thi lord Mercury (Virgo) 6th house. Thus the transit agrees with dasa.

By: Achintya Karmakar 


B/402/E Baishnabghata, Patuli, Kolkata 
Phone: 6291415841 ; Email: achintyakarmakar61127@gmail.com 














A lady client came to me and said that she has some problem regarding conjugal life. Moreover she 
was pregnant at that time, and I listened to all her problems in details and asked her to provide her 
date of birth details which are as follows 


Date of Birth- 24th May 1990 
Time of Birth- 08.50 pm 
Place of Birth- Panskura, West Bengal. 


RULE OF KP FOR HAPPY MARRIED LIFE 
Connection of 7t cuspal sublord and 11th cuspal sublord with 2,7,11/ 5,7,11 through its star lord 
and sublord. Then we can say that, native leads almost a happy married life . 


PREDICTION 

7th and 11» cuspal sublord is Ketu, positioned in 7 house (very close to 8t2 cusp). Ketu is located in 
sign Cancer representing Moon, occupant of 5th house and lord of 8 house. Ketu is in the star 
and sub of Mercury, occupant of 4th house, lord of 7 and 10 houses. So accordingly the cuspal 
sublord Ketu is connected to 5,7 positive houses and also 4,8,10 negative houses. 


So the Basic Prediction 
Lack of love and cordial relationship in conjugal life (48 is 12 to 5th - love) 


10th house negates 11th house (harmony, friendship, legal bonding). So, lack of friendship and dishar- 
mony in conjugal life is also seen. Her husband is also very stubborn in character. 


Because of 4th and 10th house signification there are high chances of DIVORCE / SEPERATION. 


Then I went through the current DASHA. 

According to the current DASHA running- Rahu Dasha, Sun Bhukti, Mars Antara. Rahu is in 1st 
house (very close to 24 cusp) of the KP chart. Rahu is in the star of Moon (occupant of 5t4 lord of 8), 
and sub of Saturn (occupant of 1, lord of 2 and 3). 


As 9 and 8 are connected, the husband and his mother physically torture the wife (mother is signified 
by Moon). 


Sun is in the star of Sun and sub of Venus. Sun is occupant of 5th house, lord of 9th house. Venus is 
occupant of 4th house lord of 11th house. 

As 9 (through bhukti lord), 3:4 house (through Dashal lord) are connected also with 4, 10, husband 
ran away leaving the wife alone on 26th January 2021 and was abundant till 8 February 2021. 

The husband was of such a character that he hid many things and information and situations from 
his wife and was not at all frank with his wife.

Medical astrology — Heart surgery- a detailed analysis of the natal chart of a lady who has 
undergone heart surgery very recently through our KP system 

by Gunti Nagaraju 

An office colleague of my wife has telephoned and asked how would be the prospects of 
recovery of her health after undergoing heart surgery. She has furnished her birth details 
which are appended bellow 


DOB-Gender: Female 

Date: Thursday, 08/Jun/ 1944

PRADESH, India

During her recent conversation with my wife, it seems she expressed her feeling that she had 
been experiencing deterioration in her routine health for the past few months. One fine day 
when she visited her regular doctor for the problem of congestion in her lungs, she was 
checked thoroughly and doctors noticed some major problems in her heart valves and lungs. 
Immediately she was admitted in the hospital and doctors conducted heart surgery. 

Before proceeding further on the main topic of heart surgery, I would like to write a few lines 
on the heart, lungs and valves and their problems in terms of the medical field. 

Due to prolonged ill-health process in the human body, the holes of the heart valves close 
and these closures of the heart holes prevent the smooth flow of the blood backwards after 
the regular blood flow to the heart is over. This sort of closures of the heart valves or getting 
narrowed is called “Stenosis” in medical terminology. This is also called as “Aortic valve 
stenosis or ‘aortic stenosis’. 

When the blood flow through the ‘aortic valve is reduced or blocked, our heart needs to work 
harder to ‘pump the blood to our body. As a result, this extra work for the heart causes 
pressure on the heart pumping mechanism which in turn causes symptoms as well as the 
possibility of weakening the heart muscles. 

This demands repair or replacement of the valves either through stents or surgery, when 
such repairs left unattended at the proper time may lead to serious heart attacks or 
problems or even collapse of the heart functioning system. 

Our body when faced such problems which cannot be easily noticed by the naked eye or in 
any external ways, then our body starts sending signs and symptoms indicating some 
serious lapses are occurring in our body especially in the heart region. 

Signs and symptoms of the aortic valve stenosis may include 


--abnormal heartbeat, 

--chest pain or chest congestion. 

--feeling of dizzy or fainting, 

--short breath especially in normal activities, 
--increased fatigue, 

--heart palpitation, 

--not gaining enough weight—mainly with youngsters,

And when we receive such signals from our body often, it needs to be medically attended

By: Tin Win

Question 1: Natal vs Horary 


Which result is to be taken when the results of natal analysis and horary analysis are 
different? 

A natal chart is calculated at the time of birth, and it is the same for the whole life. A horary 
chart is a chart cast for the moment that a specific question is asked and it is for one time. A 
horary chart is not a substitute for a true natal chart. However a horary chart can be used as 
a supporting tool when analyzing a natal chart. When the results are different the result of 
horary analysis can be preferred than the result of natal analysis because the time of horary 
chart is more accurate than the natal chart.

Fate of Myanmar Coup Leader 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Short Background 

A coup d'état in Myanmar occurred on the early morning of 1 February 2021, the day before 
the Parliament of Myanmar was due to swear in the members elected at the 2020 election, 
thereby preventing this from occurring. The military proclaimed a year-long state of 
emergency and declared power had been transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Defense 
Services Sr. General Min Aung Hlaing. President U Win Myint and State Counselor Daw 
Aung San Suu Kyi were detained, along with ministers, their deputies and members of 
Parliament. 





As the military crackdown on anti-coup protesters with lethal force continues, nearly 840 
people have been killed so far for 4 months, including three on May 30. The Assistance 
Association of Political Prisoners (AAPP) also informed that a total of 4,409 people are 
currently under detention as well. Military power grab appears to be uniting Myanmar people 
against a shared enemy, increasing the armed rebellion. In the country’s borderlands, where 
armed ethnic groups have been fighting for self-determination for decades, the situation is 
becoming increasingly unstable. 

Myanmar citizens have been facing an increasing shortage of cash and overall hikes in 
prices of goods and services as they are withdrawing their savings from banks due to 
concerns for their future, and economic woes since the February 1 military coup. Myanmar's 
currency Kyat has alarmingly depreciated.

Write down the RASHI Number against each one of them. Add the numbers and arrive at a total, and

digit number in multiples from total option, file the remainder single digit.

=5+5=10 

=1+0=1

Rules for Kidney Disease 
The kidney is ruled by Venus or Jupiter or Libra sign; also, 6 cuspal sublord’s connection with 
Venus or Jupiter and Maraka, Badhaka house. 


2nd, ‘7th houses are Maraka houses. 

11th house is Badhaka house for Movable Ascendant. 
Oth house is Badhaka house for Fixed Ascendant. 

7th house is Badhaka house for Dual Ascendant. 


Libra sign rules over kidney, loin, uterus, lumbar region, vertebrae, prostate and pineal gland. 

When malefic Jupiter or afflicted Moon influences the 7 lord or 7th house then the disease of kidney 
surfaced in native chart. 

If 6th cuspal sublord is connected with 8th house and specifically Venus, then it indicates kidney 
disease. 

A weak or afflicted Venus or Moon is always bad for kidney. 

Strong Saturn in Libra sign also rules the kidney disease. 

Connection of 7th cuspal sublord or 7 lord or 7 house with afflicted Saturn indicates kidney 
diseases. 

Sun in Libra sign causes various kidney disease like Nephritis. 

When Venus is 6th cuspal sublord and connected with Mars and Marak-Badhak house then it is 
negative for kidney, and it indicates kidney inflammation. 

Venus in Libra and through it’s starlord and sublord is connected with 1,6,8 and Badhak house. 
Dasha, Bhukti, Antara and 1st cuspal sublord (for general longevity) also should be checked.

Government Job Part 1 








By: Sri. Raghavendra Rao Desai 
S. N. Ventures, # 1034/39, 6th Main, 34 Cross, 
Gokula, Bengaluru - 560 054, 
Mob: +91 9591739522; Email: vanitharrao@gmail.com 





In this article I am explaining about Government job. It is the dream or aim or ambition for 
every person. In modern days IT, BT and Multinational companies are dominating the 
society still peoples prefer for the government job, because it gives job security for the native. 


For profession in vedic astrology we will see D1 (Lagna Chart) and D10 (Dasamsa Divisional 
Chart). As per Vedic astrology if the Sun is in 10th house gives government job. But Sun 
alone is not enough for the government job also along with Sun we have to consider other 
plants also. If Sun is posited in 10th house and if that 10t8 house is Leo Sign then to some 
extent we can consider it for government job. 


I have seen few horoscopes where Sun is in Libra Sign (here Sun is debilitate as per vedic 
astrology) who are doing government job. Because as per rule Libra Sign is a Male Sign. 


Now, we will see what are houses, planets and signs are responsible or important for the 
government job. I will present all the related information in this article. 


Houses 2, 6, 10 and 11 houses are considered for employment and services because, 


2:4 House: It denotes money matters, profit and gain, one can earn, financial prosperity, 
bank position. 


6th House: It denotes Job / Service / Day- to - day attendance. 
10th House: It denotes Profession / Occupation / Name & fame / Power & Prestige. 
11th House: It denotes Desires, hopes, aspirations & their realization. 


KP gives rules clearly that — 11th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or 
Sublord of 274 or 6th or 10th or 11t house. Or 


6th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sublord of 224 or 10 or 11 lord Or 


10th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sublord of 24 or 11t or 6th house 
lord. 


Permanent or Temporary job: If the Sublord of the 6 house becomes the significator of 2, 
10 and 11 houses through its Starlord or Sublord then it shows permanent job but if it 
becomes significators along with houses of 5t or 9th house also denotes temporary job or 
native is not likely to stick to one job. 


If the 10th Sublord is significator of 6 house through Starlord and 7th house through 
Sublord it indicates private job. Venus is planet for private job as well as for business. 


Change of place: Whether the native will get the promised job at the place or at a different 
place. It should be judged from the Dasa period running at the time of joining the job. If the 
Bhukti / Antar lord / Pratyanter lord becomes the significator of 2, 6, 10 and 3 or 12 houses 
it shows the job will be at changed place.

Case Study related to Heart Disease 


By: Achintya Karmakar 


B/402/E Baishnabghata, Patuli, Kolkata 
Phone: 6291415841 ; Email: achintyakarmakar61127@gmail.com 











General Rules for Heart Disease 

From 64 cuspal sublord, we see all type of diseases. 

If the 6th cuspal sublord is connected with 8t house or watery sign (with Maraka/ Badhaka 
house). 

If the 6 cuspal sublord / 6 house / 6th house lord is connected with Earthy sign then it 
indicates serious disease. 

Cancer rashi in kalapurush chart represents heart, so 4th house is also very important for 
heart. 

If the Ascendant, 4th cusp (heart), 8t cusp (cancer, heart), 12th cusp (hospitalization) falls in 
watery sign, then it indicates problem in circulatory system. 

Afflicted Moon and affliction of planet in Cancer sign indicates heart disease. 

Longevity through 1st cuspal sublord also needs to consider. If the 1st cuspal sublord is 
connected with Maraka / Badhaka and 8t house, then it will create some obstacles of 
longevity period. 

Also, Dasha-Bhukti-Antara are very important for seeing longevity. The joint significators of 
dasha, bhukti, antara lords also must signify the Maraka / Badhaka and 8,12 houses for 
death. 


Case Study of Horoscope with Heart Disease 
Birth Date : 11th August 1994 

Birth Time : 14:50 PM 

Birth Place : Patna, Bihar (India) 

Gender : Male 


Analysis of the Chart 

This boy’s ascendant cusp sublord is Saturn. Saturn’s sublord is Venus. The 1st cuspal 
sublord Saturn through its sublord signifies 6th and 7th house, where 6‘ house is related to 
disease and 7th house is Maraka house. 

6th cuspal sublord Mercury is occupants of 8 house, in its own star, thus signifying 8th very 
strongly. Mercury is in rapt conjunction with Sun, which also signifies 8th. So, the 6 cuspal 
sublord signification of 8 indicates dangerous / serious disease. 


6th house is in Taurus, which is an earthy sign indicating serious disease. The 6t lord Venus 
signifies 10th which is not good for longevity. Starlord of 6t* cusp is Sun signifying 8t) also. 


The ascendant, 4th cusp (heart), 8t8 cusp (cancer, heart) and 12t cusp fall in watery sign 
which indicates blood circulation problem. 


The boy was born in Moon mahadasha. Moon is in the star of own Moon lord of 8, in sub of 
Saturn lord of 2, signifying 224 and 8 houses, which are not good for health, and 8th house 
is in Cancer sign (represents circulatory system). He was dead during Moon-Ketu joint dasa 
period (26-Jul-1996 to 24-Feb-1997). Ketu is in 5th house (ruler of heart), in Aries sign 
representing Mars in 7+, lord of 12th (hospitalization), in the star of Venus lord of 6th and 7+h, 
and sub of Mercury in 8 house. 


Actual Outcome: He was dead on 28th January 1997. He had a heart hole problem from his 


birth.

This time my article is on 7 house. In astrology the 7th house is the house of Partner or 
Spouse. It is a primary house for marriage. The 7th house represents legal bondage. 


The 7th house indicates Marital life, Sexual pleasure, Husband and Wife, Wife’s wealth, Di- 
vorce etc. 


If the 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 2 or 7 or 11 and Karaka Venus then the marriage is 
promised and the same fructifies in the conjoined Dasa period of the significators of 2, 7 and 
11. 


If the houses 2, 7 and 11 connected with benefic planets either association or by aspect de- 
note that the partner in life will come of a respectable family, will be virtuously disposed and 
will possess good qualities to enable one to lead a happy and harmonious wedded life. 


Now the question is that is it possible to know well before or identify to whom he/she will 
marry. Is it possible to Know in advance that of which Sign (Rashi), which Ascendent 
(Lagna), Moon and 7‘ lord of the Bride or Bridegroom will marry. 

Guruji KSK has given more and more information about 7th house they are (a) Age difference 
between Spouse/Partner (b) Spouse / Partner from where (through relations or place) (c) Will 
spouse/partner is employee (d) Sexual Desires and Behaviours and so on. 

The Astrology says yes to maximum extent. Then how find it. 

In natural zodiac except Sun and Moon all Five planets owns Two Sign each. (Mars: Aries 
and Scorpio; Venus: Taurus and Libra; Mercury: Gemini and Virgo; Jupiter: Sagittarius and 
Pieces; Saturn: Capricorn and Aquarius) 


Bride and Bridegroom Lagna/Lagna Lord and its two rashis. 7 house/7th Lord and its two 
rashis. Moon/Moon Lord (posited) and its two rashis plays a vital role in both the horo- 
scopes. These above combinations will be interlinked or will exchange or signify each other 
in couples horoscopes 


You can see interlinks in the chart to understand it clearly.

Questions & Answers 





an | By: Tin Win 
r4 fsb Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Question 1: Litigation and Government Job 

Sir, I have two small questions for your clarification. 

1. A person came to me and said a vedic astrologer have told him that he will be involved in 
court case. 

Is there any combination from where we can see if a person will be involved in court case. If 
yes, then during which DBA? 

2. What is the combination for getting government job. I have asked many astrologers but all 
are saying that there is no full proof rules. What according to your experience is the combi- 
nation? 


Answer 1: 

Litigation: 

a. According to KP, the 6th house represents litigation, and the 7th house indicates the op- 
ponent in litigation. 

b. Therefore, litigation would be imminent whenever the significators of the 6th and 7th 
houses are operating in life. 

c. The cause of the litigation is represented by the planets connected with - or associated 
with - the 6th house or its lord. 

d. Success in litigation is promised by the lord of the 11th house or planets in the 11th 
house. Success is also ensured if the 6th and the 7th houses come under the influence of the 
lords of the stars or the occupants of the 1st, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 10th and 11th houses. 

e. If the lord of the 6th house is connected with the 11th house, or the 11th house is con- 
nected with the lord of the 6th house, success in litigation is realized. 

f. The above (#e) also suggests that the connection of the lords of the 12th and Sth houses 
will cause failure in absolute terms. 

g. If the sub lord of the 6t* cusp (status) be the significator of 7 (court proceedings), 8 
(disgrace) or 12 (crimes), the native will be involved in 

court proceedings and will be inflicted with punishment, during the joint 

dasa period of the significators of 7, 8 and 12. 


Government Job 

General rule for getting job: If the cuspal sub lord of the 6th or 10th is the significator of the 
2nd, 6th, or 10th, service or earning ability is promised during the joint period (dashas) of 
the significators of the 274 , 6th , and 10th houses. 

If the above CSL is connected with Sun (karaka for government) through planet, its star or 
sub, it may be an indication of government job but it isn’t full proof as said by others. 


Question 2: 

Hello . I noticed in the Myanmar coup analysis (KP-Ezine May 2012, pages 7-9) that there 
was a 6 fold significator table. I see what’s being done, but could you explain the difference 
between owner and owning? Thanks 


Answer 2: 


Here “Owning” means “occupant” of a bhava (house) and “Owner” means “owner” of a bhava 
(house) as follows: 


A - Planets in the sub of Bhava Occupant (In the sub of owning) 
B - Planets in the stars of Bhava Occupant (In the star of owning) 


KP Ezine June 2021 62 


C - Planets in the Bhava (owning) 

D - Planets in the sub of Bhava Lord (In the sub of owning)

A New Method: Timing of Events Using Nadi Nakshatras is a first attempt in making timing 
of events in astrology a very simple exercise. In Nadi astrology specific ages when events 
would happen are significant and this is used through combinations of planets or single 
planets but in this book we have used only nakshatras. Each Nakshatra gets activated ata 
particular age so any planet which is in any nakshatra in turn gets activated at that age and 
gives the event. This book is on purpose not exhaustive and only gives small number of ages 
per nakshatra so that all can remember it and use it. 


Step 1: Position of Planet 
This natives Mercury is in Swati Nakshatra in 6H and Mercury is dispositor of Ketu and Sat- 
urn Retro thus bringing with it malefic influences to the 6H of diseases and accidents. 


Step 2: Aspects on the Said Nakshatra 
12" lord of hospitalisation Mars who is also the 7th lord (thus being a malefic for Taurus Asc) 


is aspecting this Mercury who is placed in Swati 


Step 3: Nakshatra lordship and its conjunctions 
Swatis nakshatra lord is Rahu who is placed in the 8th house of mishaps and super acci- 


KP Ezine June 2021 64 


dents and death and it is conjunct Venus who is 6L of accidents and also lagna lord thus in- 
volving body and both of these is aspected in return by Retro Saturn and Ketu 


All these combinations guarantee a thought that something bad might happen in the 3 rd 
year either to him or to any of his relatives (since Swati is in 6H) but with involvement of Ve- 
nus (lagna lord) it could be him. Incidentally native met with an accident at 3.5 years of age 
from a truck. (Little bit after 3 rd Year) 


Thus you can see that the event did not happen exactly in the 3 rd year as per the dictum 
but few months later which to some astrologers would be still acceptable and some would 
create a big fuss about it. I leave it to the readers but the western readers should especially 
note how we Indians talk about age and how we calculate our age. When a nadi reading says 
in the 1 st year so and so event would happen it does not mean AFTER the first birth date 
but it means the 1 st year is from the day a child is born to 365 days, that's his first year of 
life

Former President Jimmy Carter’s 75 Wedding 
Anniversary 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Former president Jimmy Carter, the longest living president, has accaomplished a lot in his 
96 years, but his longest-running accomplishment is his marriage to former first lady 
Rosalynn Carter, 93. The couple will celebrate their 75th anniversry on July 7 — marking 
nearly eight decades of philanthropy, travel, family and love.

i 
’ 
~ \ 

‘ 4

|

Marriage and Married Life 

Jimmy and Rosalynn married on 7 July 1946 (Saturn/ Venus/ Venus/ Rahu DBAS for 
Carter). 

Dasa lord Saturn+ (1,4-5) is in the star of Rahu+ (10), the CSL of 2,5 houses having no plan- 
et in its stars. Rahu is aspected by Jupiter (2,3-6) and Saturn+ (1,4-5); in Cancer sign repre- 
senting Moon (1,10). Saturn is in the sub of Jupiter (2,3-6). Dasa lord Saturn is signifying 
house 2 for marriage. 

Bhukti and Antra lord Venus+ (10-1-8) is the CSL of 1,9,12 houses having no planet in its 
stars. Venus is in the star and sub of Ketu (4), which is in Capricorn sign representing Sat- 
urn+ (1,4-5), not signifying any marriage house but Venus (karaka for marriage) is conjoined 
with Mercury in marriage house 11. 

Sookshma lord Rahut+ (10) is the CSL of 2,5 houses having no planet in its stars. Rahu is as-

MAGIC, which encompasses the subgenres of illusion, stage magic, and closes up magic, 
among others, is a performing art in which audiences are entertained by tricks, effects, 
or illusions of seemingly impossible feats, using natural means. It is to be distinguished 
from paranormal magic, the effects of which are claimed to be created 
through supernatural means. It is one of the oldest performing arts in the world. 
Modern entertainment magic, as pioneered by 19th-century magician Jean-Eugéne Robert- 
Houdini, has become a popular theatrical art form. The performance of tricks of illusion, or 
magical illusion, and the apparent workings and effects of such acts have often been referred 
to as "magic" and particularly as magic tricks. 








Types of magic performance----Magic is often described according to various specialities or 
genres. 


A mentalist on stage in a mind-reading performance, an Amateur magician performing 
"children's magic" for a birthday party audience. 

Stage illusions are performed for large audiences, typically within a theatre or auditorium. 
This type of magic is distinguished by large-scale props, the use of assistants and often 
exotic animals such as elephants and tigers. Famous stage illusionists, past and present, 
include Harry Blackstone, Sr., Howard Thurston, Chung Ling Soo, David Copperfield, Lance 
Burton, Silvan, Siegfried & Roy, P.C. SARKAR and Harry Blackstone, Jr. 

Parlour magic is done for larger audiences than close-up magic (which is for a few people or 
even one person) and for smaller audiences than stage magic. In parlour magic, the 
performer is usually standing and on the same level as the audience, which may be seated 
on chairs or even on the floor. 

Close-up magic----(or table magic) is performed with the audience close to the magician, 
sometimes even one-on-one. It usually makes use of everyday items as props, such 
as cards (see Card manipulation), coins (see Coin magic), and seemingly ‘impromptu’ effects. 
This may be called "table magic", particularly when performed as dinner entertainment. 
Escapology----- is the branch of magic that deals with escapes from confinement or 
restraints. Harry Houdini is a well-known example of an escape artist or escapologist. 
Pickpocket magic----- magicians use magic to misdirect members of the audience while 
removing wallets, belts, ties and other personal effects. 

Entalism---- creates the impression in the minds of the audience that the performer 
possesses special powers to read thoughts, predict events, control other minds, and similar 
feats. 

Séances----Theatrical séances simulate spiritualistic or mediumistic phenomena for 
theatrical effect. 


Children's magic---is performed for an audience primarily comprised of children. It is 
typically performed at birthday parties, preschools, elementary schools, Sunday schools or 
libraries. This type of magic is usually comedic and involves audience interaction as well as 
volunteer assistants. 

Online magic-----Online magic tricks were designed to function on a computer screen. The 
computer essentially replaces the magician. Some online magic tricks recreate traditional 
card tricks and require user participation, while others, like Plato's Cursed Triangle, are 
based on mathematical, geometrical and/or optical illusions. 

Mathemagic----is a genre of stage magic that combines magic and mathematics. It is

commonly used by children's magicians and mentalists. 

Corporate magic------ Corporate magic or trade show magic uses magic as a communication 
and sales tool, as opposed to just straightforward entertainment. Corporate magicians may 
come from a business background and typically present at meetings, conferences and 
product launches. They run workshops and can sometimes be found at trade shows, where 
their illusions enhance an entertaining presentation of the products offered by their 
corporate sponsors. 

Gospel magic----Gospel magic uses magic to catechize and evangelize. Gospel magic was 
first used by St. John Bosco to interest children in 19th-century Turin, Italy to come back to 
school, to accept assistance and to attend church. 

Street magic----- Street magic is a form of street performing or busking that employs a 
hybrid of stage magic, platform and close-up magic, usually performed ‘in the round’ or 
surrounded by the audience. Unlike traditional street magic, this style is almost purely 
designed for TV and gains its impact from the wild reactions of the public. 

Bizarre magic----Bizarre magic uses mystical, horror, fantasy, and other similar themes in 
performance. Bizarre magic is typically performed in a close-up venue, although some 
performers have effectively presented it in a stage setting. 

Shock magic----- Shock magic is a genre of magic that shocks the audience. Sometimes 
referred to as "geek magic", it takes its roots from circus sideshows, in which 'freakish' 
performances were shown to audiences. Common shock magic or geek magic effects include 
eating razor blades, needle-through-arm, string through neck and pen-through-tongue., 


Comedy magic----- Comedy magic is the use of magic in which is combined with stand-up 
comedy. 
Quick change magic----- Quick change magic is the use of magic that is combined with the 


very quick changing of costumes. 

Camera magic----Camera magic (or "video magic") is magic that is aimed at viewers watching 
broadcasts or recordings. It includes tricks based on the restricted viewing angles of cameras 
and clever editing. Camera magic often features paid extras posing as spectators who may 
even be assisting in the performance. 

Classical magic------ Classical Magic is a style of magic that conveys feelings of elegance and 
skill akin to prominent magicians of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. 

Mechanical magic----Ambigram Magic / Dream with a handheld pattern giving a reversed 
shadow by mirror symmetry. "It's all done with smoke and mirrors", as we say to explain 
something baffling. 

Magic, a concept used to describe a mode of rationality or way of thinking that looks to 
invisible forces to influence events, effect change in material conditions, or present 
the illusion of change. Within the Western tradition, this way of thinking is distinct from 
religious or scientific modes; however, such distinctions and even the definition of magic are 
subject to wide debate. 

Nature and Scope----Practices classified as magic include divination, astrology, 
incantations, alchemy, sorcery, spirit mediation, and necromancy. The term magic is also 
used colloquially in Western popular culture to refer to acts of conjuring and sleight of hand 
for entertainment. The purpose of magic is to acquire knowledge, power, love, or wealth; to 
heal or ward off illness or danger; to guarantee productivity or success in an endeavour; to 
cause harm to an enemy; to reveal information; to induce spiritual transformation; to trick, 
or to entertain. The effectiveness of magic is often determined by the condition and 
performance of the magician, who is thought to have access to unseen forces and special 
knowledge of the appropriate words and actions to manipulate those forces. 

Phenomena associated or confused with magic include forms of mysticism, medicine, 
paganism, heresy, witchcraft, shamanism, Vodou, and superstition. Magic is sometimes 
divided into the "high" magic of the intellectual elite, bordering on science, and the "low' 
magic of common folk practices. A distinction is also made between "black" magic, used 
for nefarious purposes, and "white" magic, ostensibly used for beneficial purposes. Although 
these boundaries are often unclear, magical practices have a sense of "otherness" because of 
the supernatural power that is believed to be channelled through the practitioner, who is 
a marginalized or stigmatized figure in some societies and a central one in others.

Traditional astrology considers magic to be a function of Saturn and Mercury. 

It is a form of applied philosophy requiring the concentration of Saturn and the ingenuity of

tion, and flexibility as well as all of those conditions that show the edges or boundaries. 
These planets are always important in considerations of magic but the kinds of magic. 

Not surprisingly, Saturn generally functions as the greater malefic and Mercury tends to am-

often malefic although they do have their beneficial aspect. 


Traditionally the 6th,8th and 12th houses are considered unfortunate and associated with 
the main kinds of magic. Depending on the planets ruling and in them, these houses may 
show an aptitude, sympathy, or antipathy. 


The 6th House pertains to practical magic and corresponds to the sign Virgo in the natural 
order of the signs and is ruled by Mercury where he also finds his exaltation. Neptune in Vir- 
go adds an air of mystery. Traditionally Virgo is earthy, cold, melancholy, barren, feminine, 
nocturnal, and mutable (according to Lilly). This sign also indicates scholar, healers, techni- 
cians. The practical magician is therefore a technician and a scholar. One who is concerned 
with application and instruction. He or she is likely also a perfectionist, possessed of a mysti- 
cal streak, and detail-oriented. Both the magician and the artisan have signatures associated 
with this house. Generally malefics ruling or in this house if ill dignified or afflicted show dif- 
ficulties with detail and small aptitude and possibly an antipathy for practical magic. 
Benefics or perhaps better, well-dignified malefics tend to show an aptitude for these practi- 
cal arts. The tendency will be stronger with a bright star connected especially if its nature 
shows an interest in these arts or is compatible with the planets connected with the house. 


The 8th House pertains to sorcery and psychism and corresponds to Scorpio in the natural 
order of the signs and is ruled by Mars with the modern co-ruler of Pluto who is also exalted 
in this sign. Uranus adds a note of eccentricity and unpredictability for his quadruplicity 
here. Traditionally Scorpio is cold, watery, phlegmatic, feminine, and fixed. This house is as- 
sociated with death, legacies, estates of the deceased, dowries, fear and anguish of mind, and 
more modernly, credit and taxes. It also has some affinity with vultures and birds of prey. 
The sorcerer then is often obsessed with ancient and hidden things (Uranus, Scorpio, and 
Pluto). One who seeks to understand the foundations of the world and himself. He is addict- 
ed to power and though scrupulous, operates by his own rules. As the 8th house suggests he 
may seek the hidden legacies of long-vanished principalities. Generally malefics ruling or in 
this house if ill dignified or afflicted show difficulties with sorcery and small aptitude with 
possible antipathy to sorcery and psychism. Benefics or perhaps better, well-dignified malef- 
ics tend to show an aptitude for these arts. The tendency will be stronger with a bright star 
connected especially if its nature shows an interest in these arts or is compatible with the 
planets connected with the house. 


The 12th House pertains to witchcraft, mysticism and spiritualism and corresponds to the

and mutable. Deception, celebrity, glamour, and illusion are hallmarks of the sign and the

Calculations for Bhawa and Planets-: 

1> These composite charts are calculated by adding the houses degree (bhawa) and then dividing it 
by 2. (Since I am finding midpoints of two charts so it is divided by 2. If it was 3 three then it will be 
divided by 3, if 4 then divided by 4 and so on) 

2> Same goes for planets. So by adding the degree of planets in the charts and then dividing it by 2. 
(Since I am finding midpoints of two charts so it is divided by 2. If it was 3 three then it will be divided 
by 3, if 4 then divided by 4 and so on) 


Calculation of Birth date and Dasha -: 
Birth date of composite charts is calculated by adding the date of birth of two charts. This is only done 
to find the Dasha and Bhukti. Also composite Moon degree is used for calculation. 


Prediction procedure-: 

In this example I am calculating business partnership. So, the composite 7th Cuspal Sub Lord for ex- 
ample is planet “x”. Now what this planet “x” signifies, individually in the charts of both partner 1 and 
partner2 needs to be calculated. This will determine the compatibility between the two people. 

Same goes for dasha and bhukti. Suppose currently “A” dasha and “B” bhukti is running according to 
composite charts. Then what that “A” and “B” signify individually in both the personal horoscope of 
partner 1 and partner 2 will determine the current condition of their business partnership.

Now calculation of Date of Birth of the composite chart is done by adding two date of births and then 
dividing it by 2. 


YYYY MM DD 
199708 14 
+ 

199005 O02 


Date adding 14+2 = 16/2 = 8 day 


Month adding 8+5 = 13 /2 = 6 and remainder is 1 month which is equal to 30 days. 

This remainder 30 days is to be added to the day. Half of 30 day is 15 + the previous 8 = 23 Days 

For year 1997+1990 = 3987 /2 = 1993. Remainder is 1 year which is 12 months. 

This remainder 12 months is to be added to the month. Half of 12 months is 6 + the previous 6 
months is equal to 12. 

So finally we are getting 23/12/1993 as the composite chart birth date.

Case Study about Love Relationship or Love Affair 


By: Achintya Karmakar 


B/402/E Baishnabghata, Patuli, Kolkata

General Rules for Love Relationship or Love Affair: 

If the 5th cuspal sublord through its starlord and sublord signifying 5th, 7th, 11th house, then 
it indicates successful love affair. 

If the 7th cuspal sublord indicates 24, 5th, 11th house with 7th house then it indicates suc- 
cessful love marriage. 


Case Study : 

Birth Date  : 18th May 2002 

Birth Time : 11:29am 

Birth Place : Kolkata, West Bengal (India) 
Gender : Female 


Analysis of the Chart : 

oth Cuspal Sublord 

oth cuspal sublord is Moon, occupant of 12th house. 12th house is in Cancer and Watery sign. 
So native is very emotional and has a little bit insecurity complex. Moon’s star lord is Saturn, 
occupant of 10t house (negative to 11t* house of long term friendship), lord of 6th and 7th 
houses. The 6th and 108 houses represent separation here. Moon is in sub of Rahu, 
occupant of 10t8 and agent of Venus, signifying 3™4, 10th, 11th houses. 

The 5th cuspal sublord Moon is under Poonarphoo dosha, as Moon starlord is Saturn. 


7th Cuspal Sublord 

7th cuspal sublord Venus signifies 34, 10th and 11th houses. Venus is in the star of Mars 
which signifies 4th, 9th, 10th houses. Venus is in sub of own Venus. 

My Conclusion: 

Love marriage is promised for her as 5th cuspal sublord signifies 7t house. Her husband will 
be good looking (as Venus is 7t® cuspal sublord). 

But, in marriage cordial relationship will be disturbed (as 4, 10 are connected). 

If she is engaged in any love relationship, then it will break and she will be in depression 
(due to Poonarphoo dosha effect), and pre-marital sexual indulgence or something which is 


unethical in society, as 5th cuspal sublord Moon is also 8t cuspal sublord 


Most of the time, native may break the relationships because 10t signification by 5th and 7th 
CSLs. 


Actual Outcome: She already has several breakup issues till now.

One of my clients asked me “Is there any second child for me? If so, when?” Then I asked 
him to give me a number within 249. Immediately he gave me 121/249. Immediately the 
chart is erected and it’s details are given below:- 

Horary No. 121/249; DOJ:-04-05-2021; TOJ:-04-00-00 PM; POJ:-KURNOOL (AP); 


Genuineness of the query:- Moon indicates the mind of the querent. 


Moon (5-11) is in the star of Mars (9-3,8) and in the sub of Jupiter (5-4,7). Here 5th from 5th 
is 9th, So 9th is also good in the matter of progeny. The related houses for second progeny are 
9-11-9-7. These are all signified by Moon. So we can say that there is genuineness of the 
query. OK. 


K.P. Rule for Second Child birth:- If the 5th cusp sublord signifies 2, 5, or 11 along with 7 
mainly, then the second child birth is promised. 

“Whether second child is promised to me or notP Query is put by a male client. So we have 
to consider the 11t* cusp sublord. 

In this natal chart, 11th cusp sublord Moon (5-11) is in the star of Mars (9-3,8) and in the 
sub of Jupiter (5-4,7). Here 5th from 5th is 9th, So 9th is also good in the matter of progeny. 
The related houses for second progeny are 5-11-9-7. These are all signified by Moon. There- 
fore, second child birth is promised.

Cheque bounce cases have become more common these days. There are approximately 35 
lakh cheque bouncing cases across India. Dishonoring of cheque is a criminal offence and is 
punishable by imprisonment up to two years or monetary penalty or both. Sometimes 
cheques bearing large amounts remain unpaid and are dishonored. However, if the cheque 
issuer fails to pay back, then the lender has right to prosecute the issuer legally. The lender 
may legally sue the defaulter for dishonor of cheque under section 138. 


A person Known to me with an intention of helping his friend in dire need of money has lent 
huge money. The friend has promised him to pay back the money within six months 
including simple interest. However, while lending the money, a cheque signed by the 
borrower has been taken with the borrowed amount written on it as security. The promise 
kept fading and the friendship also got dissolved. 


The person could wait no longer and has presented the cheque in court of law for justice on 
20/09/2020 under section 138. He asked me to look into the case from astrological point of 
view.

KP Ezine July 2021 47 


Solving a problem with the help of ruling planets 


By: Manoj Kumar 
Khasra No-323/268, Gali no-9/6 
Mukund Pur Part-2,Delhi- 110042 
Mobile-9650132874 


Email ID-mr.manojmorya@gmail.com 








This incident is of my office. It is a pharmaceutical distributor. I used to enter the purchase data of 
medicines here and I also make the sale bill of invoice. Today I solved a problem with the help of as- 
trology. Where I work, the goods came from a party whose entry had done in the computer but there 
was a difference of about 230.63 Rupees, which means that either the number of items is short or 
the rate of an item is wrong. The total item came was 253 which could take about 2 hours to do tal- 
ly. Then I got the idea that why not take the help of numerology. That's when I made the horoscope 
of that time. 


Date 12-09-2020, Time: Night 12:22 a.m., Place: Delhi 
The ruling planets were as follows : 


Ascendant Owner- Mercury 

Ascendant star - Rahu (in the zodiac sign of Mercury) 
Chandra Swami- Mercury 

Chandra Nakshatra- Rahu (in the zodiac sign of Mercury) 
Day Lord -Venus 

Mer- 3-6 = 9 

Rahu (Mercury) -3,6 = 9 

Mer- 3,6 =9 


Rahu (Mercury) - 3,6 = 9 
Venus- 2,7 =9 


Now we will take the numbers of all the planets. 
Sum of all digits is 45. Now the single number of 45 = 4+ 5 =9 


Everywhere 9 is coming. Then I thought that this mistake is only related to the number 9. Then I 
looked in the 9th line and marked in a multiple of 9 followed by 9 followed by 18 then 27. On the 27th 
line, I found the item in which the items came 10 pieces but only 1 entered. 


Here only the difference is 9 coming. If 27 is made alone by adding a number, then 2 + 7 = 9 
The value of the number was inserted 18.11. 


Then I added 9 to the quantity of item instead of 1 and made it 10. There was also a difference of 9 
on this. Now its value increased to 18.11 x9 = 162.99. 


If we add these numbers together 1+6+2+9+9=27, 2+7=9 then the number 9 will come. 


This is how my invoice was tallied. In this way, with the help of astrology, I finished my two-hour 
work in just two minutes.

This is continuation of earlier article about Government job (Part-I). It is the dream or aim 
or ambition for every person. In modern days IT, BT and Multinational companies are

rity for the native. 


For profession in Vedic astrology we will see D1 (Lagna Chart) and D10 (Dasamsa Division- 
al Chart). As per Vedic astrology if the Sun is in 10th house gives government job. But Sun 
alone is not enough for the government job also along with Sun we have to consider other 
plants also. If Sun is posited in 10t8 house and if that 10th house is Leo Sign then to some 
extent we can consider it for government job. 


As I wrote in my previous article the Sun is in Libra Sign (here Sun is debilitate as per Ve- 
dic astrology). Because as per rule Libra Sign is a Male Sign. So, just don’t go blindly on 
the basis of dictums. Try to think in all angles that why it has taken place. So, analyse 
horoscope in different angles also. Because theory is different from practical. So, “Leave no 
stone unturned”. 


Now, we will see what are houses, planets and signs are responsible or important for the 
government job. I will present all the related information in this article. 
Houses 2, 6, 10 and 11 houses are considered for employment and services because, 


2.4 House: It denotes money matters, profit and gain, one can earn, financial prosperity, 
bank position. 


6th House: It denotes Job / Service / Day- to - day attendance. 
10th House: It denotes Profession / Occupation / Name & fame / Power & Prestige. 
11th House: It denotes Desires, hopes, aspirations & their realization. 


Karaka Planets for Profession is Saturn and Digbala planets for 10t# house is Sun and 
Mars 


KP gives rules clearly that —- 11th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sub- 
lord of 254 or 6th or 10th or 11th house. Or 

6th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sublord of 274 or 10 or 11th lord 
Or 

10th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sublord of 274 or 11th or 6th 
house lord. 


Permanent or Temporary job: If the Sublord of the 6th house becomes the significator of 
2, 10 and 11 houses through its Starlord or Sublord then it shows permanent job but if it 
becomes significators along with houses of 5t* or 9th house also denotes temporary job or 
native is not likely to stick to one job. 


If the 10th Sublord is significator of 6 house through Starlord and 7 house through Sub- 
lord it indicates private job. Venus is planet for private job as well as for business.

Legendry actor Dilip Kumar 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Short Biography 

Veteran Bollywood actor Dilip Kumar, 98, died on 7 July 2021 at 7:30 am. at Hinduja Hospital, 
Mumbai, where he was admitted for breathing and age-related issues. He had been suffering from 
prostate cancer. The Government of Maharashtra approved his burial with state honours at Juhu 
Qabrastan on 7 July 2021. Indian film actor known as Tragedy King, and described as "the ultimate 
method actor" by Satyajit Ray. He debuted as an actor in the film Jwar Bhata in 1944 produced by 
Bombay Talkies. His career has spanned over six decades and with over 60 films. 


The Government of India honoured him with the Padma Bhushan award in 1991 and the Dadasaheb 
Phalke Awardin 1994 for his contributions towards Indian cinema and nominated him to Rajya Sa- 
bha, the upper house of Indian parliament for a term. He is the first recipient of Filmfare Best Actor 
Award (1954) and still holds the record for the most number of Filmfare awards won for that catego- 
ry with eight wins. Critics acclaimed him among one of the greatest actors in the history of Hindi 
cinema. In a blog post, Amitabh Bachchan has described Dilip Kumar as the greatest actor ever. 





Planetary Combinations for Legendry Actor 

oth (film actor/ performance) cuspal sub lord (CSL) Ketu+ (9) is in the star of Jupiter (4,6-9) and sub 
of Rahu (3), conj. Saturn+ (3,7-8), aspected by Mars (8,5-10), in Virgo sign representing Mercury (5,3 
-12), signifying favorable 3 (ability), 5 (performance), 6 (gain), 7 (line art/ popularity) , 9 (higher 
knowledge/ luck), 10 (profession/ name/ fame) houses, being connected with Venus (karaka for film 
actor), Mercury (power of the word and thinking) and Jupiter (knowledge). This is the contributory 
factor of the making of a ‘Tragedy King’. 


The 214 lord Sun, 34 & 12th Mercury and 4th & 11th lord Venus are conjoined in the 5th house of film 
actor and performance. The connection of 2,5,11 houses by conjoined Sun, Mercury and Venus is 
one of the contributory factors for his brilliant acting skills. These conjoined planets are aspected by 
7h lord Saturn. It’s also supported by connection of 5th & 10t lord Mars and Ascendant lord Moon 
by mutual aspect. 

10th CSL Venus (4,4-11) is in the star of Jupiter (4,6-9) and sub of Rahu (3), conj. Saturn+ (3,7-8), 
aspected by Mars (8,5-10), in Virgo sign representing Mercury (5,3-12), signifying favorable 
3,5,6,7,9,10,11 houses to become a legendry actor. 6 & 9th lord Jupiter’s aspect on house 10 is 
complementary in this regard. All above planetary positions made him the most versatile actor of 
Indian film industry.

Horary No _ : 99 (out of 249)

One of my known persons got an offer of bitcoin (online trade currency) from an unknown 
person. He asks me whether it is favourable or not. I proceeded the query through horary 
chart. 


Rule :- 

1) If the 11 cuspal sublord through its starlord and sublord signifies 1,2,3,6,10,11 houses 
along with Dasha, Bhukti, Antara period, then the offer is good. 

2) If the 11 cuspal sublord signifies 4,5,8,9,12 houses then it is fraud offer or it is just like 
a trap.

In this horary chart 11t* cuspal sublord is Saturn. Saturn is in the star of Moon and sub of 
Mercury. 

Saturn occupies 7th house, lord of 8th and 9th houses. Saturn is untenanted, here no planet 
is in Saturn star. 

Saturn’s starlord Moon occupies 2"4 house. Saturn’s sublord Mercury is in 12th house, lord 
of 4th and 1st houses.

At present time Venus Dasha, Venus Bhukti, Rahu Antara are going.

Venus occupies 11th house, lord of 52 and 12th houses. Venus is in star of Moon, Moon is in 
2nd house, lord of 274 house. Ketu is in 5th house, agent of Venus, signifying 5th, 11th, 12th 
house. 


Bhukti Lord — VENUS:- 
Venus is already discussed as above. 


Antara Lord — RAHU:- 

Rahu is in 11th house. Rahu is the agent of Mars in 12th house, lord of 11t and 6t houses. 
Rahu is in star of Moon, signifying 274 house. And Rahu is in sub of Saturn, occupying 7th 
house, lord of 8th and 9th houses. 


My Conclusion :- 
The offer is not favourable.

Who will Marry Whom? (Part - II) 








By: Sri. Raghavendra Rao Desai 
S. N. Ventures, # 1034/39, 6th Main, 34 Cross, 
Gokula, Bengaluru - 560 054, 
Mob: +91 9591739522; Email: vanitharrao@gmail.com 





This is continuation of my earlier article of the same topic. I am retaining all the 
information of earlier article, just for readers reference. 


This time my article is on 7th house. In astrology the 7t* house is the house of Partner or 
Spouse. It is a primary house for marriage. The 7th house represents legal bondage. 


The 7th house indicates Marital life, Sexual pleasure, Husband and Wife, Wife’s wealth, 
Divorce etc. 


If the 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 2 or 7 or 11 and Karaka Venus then the marriage is 
promised and the same fructifies in the conjoined Dasa period of the significators of 2, 7 
and 11. 


If the houses 2, 7 and 11 connected with benefic planets either association or by aspect 
denote that the partner in life will come of a respectable family, will be virtuously disposed 
and will possess good qualities to enable one to lead a happy and harmonious wedded life. 


Now the question is that is it possible to know well before or identify to whom he/she will 
marry. Is it possible to know in advance that of which Sign (Rashi), which Ascendant 
(Lagna), Moon and 7‘ lord of the Bride or Bridegroom will marry. 

Guruji KSK has given more and more information about 7t* house they are (a) Age 
difference between Spouse/Partner (b) Spouse / Partner from where (through relations or 
place) (c) Will spouse/partner is employee (d) Sexual Desires and Behaviours and so on. 
The Astrology says yes to maximum extent. Then how find it. 

In natural zodiac except Sun and Moon all Five planets owns Two Sign each. (Mars: Aries 
and Scorpio; Venus: Taurus and Libra; Mercury: Gemini and Virgo; Jupiter: Sagittarius 
and Pieces; Saturn: Capricorn and Aquarius) 


Bride and Bridegroom Lagna/Lagna Lord and its two rashis. 7s house/7t Lord and its two 
rashis. Moon/Moon Lord (posited) and its two rashis plays a vital role in both the 
horoscopes. These above combinations will be interlinked or will exchange or signify each 
other in couples horoscopes 


You can see interlinks in the chart to understand it clearly. 


Husband: 03.01.1966 @ 09:34:46 Hrs, Raichur, Karnataka. Longitude: 77° 21' 27" E, 
Latitude: 16° 12' 12"N. 


Chart Analysis: 

Lagna: The lagna is Aquarius. The lagna lord is Saturn and Saturn is lord of Capricorn 
and Aquarius Sign. 

Moon: Moon is posited in Aries. The lord of Aries is Mars. And Mars is lord of Aries and 
Scorpio. 

7th House: 7th House is Leo. The lord of Leo is Sun. 

Conclusion: Wife’s lagna is Libra. The lord of Libra is Venus. Also the Venus is lord of 
Taurus. So, Husband Moon is in Aries Sign and the same Aries is Wife’s 7th house.

Questions & Answers 


By: Tin Win 


Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Question 1: Retro RPs 

Please guide me about Retrograde Ruling Planets. In certain parts of every year more than 
three or four planets become Retro. When most RPs have Retro Star lord or Sub lord, how 
to proceed in horary or natal chart? 


Answer 1: 

Retrogression doesn’t matter in analysis natal chart. Even in horary analysis, the emerging 
trend is neglecting retrogression as it has been found not hinder the event happen in so 
may cases. So retrogression can be neglected in natal as well as horary analysis as done by 
many KP astrologers including late Sunil Gondhalekar, Kanak Bosmia. 


Question 2: Significator of rank E 

Sometimes what happens the dasha lord in birth horoscope is in star and sub of own and 
is not showing any job giving houses still the person got job. How to judge such cases?. Do 
we have to then look into aspects or something like that? 


Answer 2: 

Whenever significators of rank A, B, C, D, as shown in KP SW printouts, are not available 
the significator of rank E, which is the significator conjoined or aspected by significators of 
rank A,B,C,D. 


Question 3: Ketu in star of Ketu 
When Ketu is in the own star of Ketu, whether star lord Ketu will give the result of lord of 
the sign occupied by Ketu?P 


Answer 3: 

Rahu/Ketu gives the results of: (Rahu/Ketu Rules in KP, in KPE-Zine, May 2007 issue) 
1) House occupied by Rahu/Ketu, 

2) Planet in conjunction with Rahu/Ketu, 

3) Planet in aspect to Rahu/Ketu, 

4) Star lord of Rahu/Ketu and 

9) Lord of sign occupied by Rahu/ Ketu. 


Yes, star lord Ketu will give the result of lord of the sign occupied by Ketu when Ketu is in 
the own star of Ketu. 


Since the example chart with Ketu in the star of Ketu is not available in the six KP Readers, 
a prisoner chart with Ketu in the star of Ketu is attached. 

In some KP SWs Ketu is indicated as agent of Ketu, which is not reasonable, and so such 
indication isn’t used in the KPastro SW. 


In the attached chart Ketu is in the sign of Aries representing Mars in house 7, lord of 
houses 2,7, which is given by Ketu as planet and also as star lord. 

Please see the example charts where star lord Ketu gives the result of lord of the sign occu- 
pied by Ketu in KP Reader III, pp 85,111,142; KP Reader IV, pp190, 225; KP Reader V, p 
200; KP Reader VI, p 190.

PARTHA SARATHI ROUT 





“Nakshatra Exploration” is written with the sole objective of enabling the readers to master 
the true concept of Predictive Stellar Astrology, what Guruji KSK wanted to interpret in his 
various monumental work. In the present research work on the KP system, the author has 
established so many rules with practical examples, enabling him to grasp the logic in 
applying the original methodologies of KP principles, by his extensive research in this field 
for a decade. Apart from giving a detailed method to study the horoscope, the author has 
compiled 125 significant KP rulings, 26 prime Muhurath rulings and a detailed KP house 


grouping along with 44 most comprehensive know-how which bears witness to the author's 


knowledge in the field of KP astrology. Another noteworthy point is that, through a few 
practical examples written at the end of the Practical Stellar Astrology section of this book, 


the author sheds light on his researched ‘Modified KP (MKP)’ principles. 


In the chapter Part-IV of this book the author sheds light on his research based “Modified 
KP (MKP)” principles. The concept is little different from the conventional application 
method of KP astrology. Basic foundation of this principles are, in astrological prediction, it 
is important to examine nature (Karakatwas) of a planet, combination and their 
constellation lords and virtues (Gunas) and strength obtained by them. Therefore, some KP

rulings and few practical examples charts at the end of “Practical Stellar Astrology” section of 
this book, have been complied, written and analysed based on those principles.

Natal Analysis vs Horary Analysis of Medical 
Exam Score 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 
PP ReeaeneaeHReHEeHEHEHEHEHEHEHEHEEHEHEHEEHEEHEEHEHEEHEEHEEHEEEHEEEEEEE HH Hi 








In August 2021 a lady gave me her birth details and asked me whether she could pass and 
get high sore in the American medical exam to be held in early September 2021. 

After analyzing her natal chart I told her that she could pass the medical exam but not with 
high score. 

She asked me to check her query again by horary analysis by giving the horary number 158 
as horary analysis has given her better results before. 

The horary analysis shows that the native could pass the medical exam with high score. 

In fact she passed the medical exam with high score. 

Therefore if the results of natal analysis and horary analysis are different, then the result of 
horary analysis could be taken as the birth time is more accurate in horary analysis than na- 
tal analysis. 


KP Rule for Exam Results of Higher Study 

If the 9th (higher education) and 11 (gain and fulfillment of desire) cuspal sub lords (CSL) be 
the significator of 4 (basic education),9 or 11, then one will pass the exam of higher study in 
the conjoint dasa period of significators of 4,9,11. 


Natal Chart Analysis 
Female, 07 Mar 1985, 11:58 PM, h6:30e, 25N23, 97E0O1, Myanmar 


The joint running dasa period at the time of examination, early Sept 2021, would be Rahu/ 
Moon/Saturn/Saturn DBAS (27 Aug to 10 Sept 2021) 

Dasa lord Rahu+ is in 6 and the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of 6-7-10 having no planet in its stars. 
Rahu is in the sign of Aries representing Mars+ in 5, lord of 1-6. Rahu is in the star of Sun in 
4, lord of 10, and sub of Moon in 10, lord of 9. Dasa lord Rahu_ signifies favorable 4-9 for 
passing the medical exam. 

Bhukti lord Moon is in 10, lord of 9, in the star of Sun in 4, lord of 10, and sub of Jupiter in 
2, lord of 2,5, signifying favorable 4-9 for passing the medical exam. 

Antra and Sookshma lord Saturn is in 12, lord of 3-4, in the own star and sub of Saturn, sig- 
nifying favorable 4 for passing the medical exam. 

Thus natal analysis indicates that the native would pass the medical exam by the significa- 
tion of 4-9 but not with high score due to lack of signification of 11. 


Horary Chart Analysis 

Name: Female 

Question: Can I get high score in medical exam to be held in early Sept 2021? 
Horary number: 158/ 249 

Date of judgment: 18 August 2020, 02:13:45 PM DST, how 

Place of judgment: Maryland, USA, 39N0O5, 77W09 

Ayanamsa: 24:03:18 (New KP) 


9th CSL Saturn+ is in 2, lord of 3, the CSL of 3-4-7-9-10 having no planet in its stars. Saturn 
is in the star of Sun in 9, and sub of Jupiter+ in 2, lord of 2-4. Thus 9th CSL Saturn signifies 
favorable 4-9 for promise of passing exam.
