Delay in marriage due to non-negotiations 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 


[EERE EEREEREEEEEREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEHEEEEEEEE EH HH 








As per K.P. the relevant houses of marriage are 2,7 and 11. Marriage is promised if the 7th 
cuspal sublord signifies 2 or 7 or 11. Successful negotiation of marriage is a pre-requisite for 
celebration of marriage. Negotiation of marriage will be successful if the DBA lords are 
connected to 3,9,11. 
EXAMPLE 1: A client has approached me on 17th October 2018 at 12-29 p.m. (Wednesday) 
with the birth details of the girl to know the probable period in which the marriage will takes 
place. The birth details are as under: 

DOB: 7-10-1991 Time: 9-09-06 am _ Place: Chilakaluripet (Long: 80-10E 
Lat: 16-5N) 
The native has borne in the star of Moon (Hastha) with ascendant Scorpio. Rahu represents 
Jupiter and Kethu represents Mercury. 
In this chart the 7t8 cuspal sublord is Saturn in 3 lord of 3,4. Saturn is in the star of Sun 
in 11 lord of 10 and in the sub of Mercury in 11 lord of 8, 11. No planets occupy the stars of 
Mercury. As Saturn signifies 11t house marriage is promised. The significators for the 
marriage are as follows: 


Cusp A B C D 
2 — Rahu Ket Jup 
7 — — Rah Ven 
11 su, Mo ,Me ,Sa ,Ma “Mo, Su, Ma, Me — Mer 
3 — sat — sat 
9 — — Me, Su, Mo Mon 


The dasa, bhukthi and anthara running currently on the date of analysis is Rah-Mer-Sat. 
The dasa lord Rahu is in 2 in the star of Venus in 10 lord of 7, 12 and in the sub of Jupiter 
in 10 lord of 2,5. As Rahu signifies only 2, 7 it is not favorable for negotiations of marriage. 
The bhukthi lord Mercury is in 11 lord of 8,11 in the star of Moon in 11 lord of 9 and in the 
sub of Venus in 10 lord of 7,12. Though Mercury signifies 7,9,11 but its connection to 8,12 
houses negotiations of marriage were not come up for settlement. 


Kethu is not a significator of marriage negotiations and hence it is rejected as bhukthi lord. 
Venus, running its bhukthi up to 6-3-2023, is also not a significator for settlement of 
matriage. 

Though the marriage is promised the relevant DBA lords for the settlement of marriage, are 
not running their period and hence the native remained unmarried resulting in delay in 
materialization of marriage. 


EXAMPLE 2: The birth details of the native are as under: 

DOB: 14-7-88 Time: 20-29-39 Place: Vijayawada 
The native has borne in the star of Saturn (Pushyami) with an ascendant of Capricorn. 
In this chart the 7t* cuspal sublord is Saturn in the star of Kethu and sub of Moon. Saturn 
is in 11 lord of lagna in the star of Kethu in 7 and in the sub of Moon in 6 lord of 7. As 
Saturn signifies 7, 11 marriage is promised. The significators of marriage are as follows: 


Cusp A B C D

3 Sun, Rah Jup — Mar

Question :- Marriage related issues 

It is a case study of a marriage done by me. I furnished the following birth details. 
Date : 23rd October 1983 

Time : 20:45:00 pm 

Place : Bangalore, Karnataka State 


Rules for Marriage: 

If the 7t cuspal sublord (CSL) signifies house 2, 7 or 11, then marriage is promised during 
the joint dasa period of significators of houses 2,7 or 11. If 5th CSL signifies house 7 or 7th 
CSL signifies house 5, then it indicates promise of love marriage. 


Analysis of 7‘ Cusp: 

Here, 7th cuspal sublord is Venus, occupant of 4, lord of 1 and 6. Venus is in his own star, 
and sub of Jupiter in 6, lord of 8 and 11. 

Here, the 7th cuspal sublord is connected with 11th house. So generally marriage is prom- 
ised. But it is also connected with 8th (house of disappointment), 6th house (marriage nega- 
tion), and 4th house (lack of love). 


Current Dasha - Bhukti:- 

Rahu Dasha (up to 8th November 2024) 

Rahu is in 1. Rahu is the agent of Venus, occupant of 4, lord of 1 and 6. Rahu is in the star 
of Mars, occupant of 4, lord of 7, 12, and sub of own Rahu. Dasa lord signifies marriage 
house 7, along with undesirable 1,4,6,12. 

Sun Bhukti (up to 18 April 2022) 

Sun occupied 5, lord of 4. Sun is in the star of Mars, occupant of 4, lord of 7, 12 houses, and 
sub of Moon, occupant of 12, lord of house 3. Bhukti lord signifies marriage house 7, along 
with undesirable 4,12. 


My Conclusion: 
As current Dasha lord and 7th CSL strongly signify undesirable houses to marriage, that 
marriage may be difficult to happen. If he were married, then it will be full of disappointment 


which may lead to separation and divorce.

* Whether shall I get benefit by lottery ticket or 
| not? 





BY: M. Vara Prasad Rao 


Sri Varasiddhi Jyotishyalam 
Opp. Sri Lakshmi E.M.School, N.R.Peta, Kurnool - 2, A.P. 
Mobile : 08309234634, Email: vara999@gmail.com 








After purchasing lottery ticket, my client asked me, whether he will get benefit or not. I asked 
him to give a number within 249. Immediately he gave me the number of 214 (out of 249). 


Date of judgment:- 04.05.2021, Time of judgment:- 03:19:54 pm 
Place of judgement:- Kurnool (78-02-10E/15-49-44N). 


KP Rule 

If the cuspal sublord of 11th be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 274 
(monetary gain), 6% (gain), or 11t* (success/fulfillment of desire) and also connected with 3"4 
(lottery) and does not signify 5, 8 or 12, only then one can win a lottery prize. (Reference:- 
Prashna Jyotish By Kanak Bosmia ji, page no.158) 


The lottery result announcement date is 04.06.2021. 

Let us check Moon (12-6) which is in the star of Mars (5-3, 10) and sub of Jupiter (12-2, 11). 
So the Moon signifies (2-3-5-6-10-11-12) indicating the genuineness of the querent. But 
there is no chance to win due to the negative signification of 5 &12. 


Let us check the 11t CSL Saturn (12-1, 12) which is in the star of Moon (12-6) and sub of 
Mercury (3-5, 8). 11t8 CSL is not in retrograde motion. So, the 11t CSL signifies 1-3-6-5-8- 
12. But there is No chance to win because of negative signifying (5, 8, 12) impact. 


Let us examine the 34 CSL Mars (5-3, 10) which is in the star of Rahu (4) and sub of Mercu- 
ry (3-5, 8). Rahu is conjoined with Mercury (3-5, 8) and Venus (3-4, 9). So, the 34 CSL signi- 
fies 3-4-5-8-9-10 and there is no chance to win because of negative signification (5,8). 
Astrology Prediction:- Both the 34 CSL Mars, 11t CSL Mercury and Moon are signifying 
3- (lottery), but there is no chance to win the lottery, because of signification of nega- 
tive houses- (5,8,12); so he cannot win the lottery. 


He messaged me on 04.06.2021 morning 11.30 am to my mobile, that he couldn’t win the 
lottery. 


My sincere pranaams to my KP guruji Sri VSN Murthy ji.

By: T.D. Kamalanabha Sarma 
SBI 24 colony, college road,

One of my best friends was admitted to a hospital. His wife came to my office and asked me 
about her husband’s health recovery giving his birth details below: 


Name: Sree Kantha Swamy, DOB 15/6/1969, time 4.34 AM, Adoni. 

I predicted before that his health condition would be critical up to 31.07.2021. 

My friend Sri Sree Kantha Swamy passed away on 24.06.2021 at 10.20 PM at Kurnool Hos- 
pital. 


Longevity Analysis 

Lagna or 1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) Mars (7,7,12) is in the star of Saturn (12,9,10) and sub of 
Moon (1,3), signifying 9 (Badhaka), 77 (Maraka) and 12 (Moksha), so longevity is short and the 
native died at the age of 52. 


Dasa Analysis 
At the time of his death (24.06.2021, 10:20 PM) Saturn dasa, Rahu bhukti and Saturn anta- 
ra joint dasa was running. 


Dasa and Antra lord Saturn (12,9,10) is in the star of Ketu (5), Conj. Jupiter (5,8,11) and sub 
of Mercury (1,2,5), signifying 9 (Badhaka), 2 (Maraka), 12 (Moksha), 8 (serious ailment, dan- 
ger to life) and 10 (retirement from this world). 


Bhukti lord Rahu (11) is in Pisces representing Jupiter (5,8,11) and the CSL of 2,3,6,11,12 
houses. Rahu is in the star of Jupiter (5,8,11) and sub of own Rahu, signifying death causing 
2,6 (disease),8, 12, 3 (8th from 8). 


Transit Analysis 

Dasa and Antra lord Saturn was in the star of Moon (3) and sub of Mercury (2). 

Bhukti lord Rahu was in the star of Moon (3) and sub of Jupiter (8). 

Luminary Sun was in the star of Rahu (2,12,8) and sub of Jupiter (8). 

Luminary Moon was in the star of Ketu (8) and sub of Jupiter (8). 

DBA lords and luminaries were transiting in the star and sub of the DBA lords or death 
causing significators, so transit agrees with dasa. 


May his soul rest in peace!

By: Sri. Raghavendra Rao Desai

This is continuation of my earlier article of the same topic. I am retaining all the information 
of earlier article, just for readers’ reference. 


This time my article is on 78 house. In astrology the 7th house is the house of partner or 
spouse. It is a primary house for marriage. The 7 house represents legal bondage. 


The 7th house indicates marital life, sexual pleasure, husband and wife, spouse’s wealth, di- 
vorce etc. 


If the 7t* cuspal sub lord signifies 2 or 7 or 11 and Karaka Venus, then the marriage is prom- 
ised and the same fructifies in the conjoined dasa period of the significators of 2, 7 and 11. 


If the houses 2, 7 and 11 are connected with benefic planets either association or by aspect 
denote that the partner in life will come of a respectable family, will be virtuously disposed 
and will possess good qualities to enable one to lead a happy and harmonious wedded life. 


Now the question is whether it is possible to know well before or identify to whom he/she will 
marry. Is it possible to know in advance that of which sign (rashi), which Ascendant (Lagna), 
Moon and 7t5 lord of the bride or bridegroom will marry. 

Guruji KSK has given more and more information about 7th house; they are (a) age difference 
between spouse/partner (b) spouse / partner from where (through relations or place) (c) 
whether spouse/ partner is employee (d) sexual sesires and behaviours and so on. 

The Astrology says yes to maximum extent. Then how to find it? 

In natural zodiac except Sun and Moon all five planets owns Two Sign each. (Mars: Aries and 
Scorpio; Venus: Taurus and Libra; Mercury: Gemini and Virgo; Jupiter: Sagittarius and 
Pieces; Saturn: Capricorn and Aquarius) 


Bride and bridegroom Lagna/Lagna lord and its two rashis. 7th house/ 7t+ lord and its two 
rashis. Moon/Moon lord (posited) and its two rashis play a vital role in both the horoscopes. 
These above combinations will be interlinked or will exchange or signify each other in cou- 
ple’s horoscopes. 


You can see interlinks in the chart below to understand it clearly. 
Husband: 11.03.1963 @ 06:17:00 Hrs, Bangalore, Karnataka. Longitude: 77° 38' 0" E, Lati- 
tude: 12° 58' O" N. 


Chart Analysis: 

Lagna: The lagna is Aquarius. The lagna lord is Saturn and Saturn is lord of Capricorn and 
Aquarius sign. 

Moon: Moon is posited in Virgo. The lord of Virgo is Mercury. And Mercury is lord of Gemini 
and Virgo. 

7th House: 7th house is Leo. The lord of Leo is Sun. 

Conclusion: Wife’s lagna is Virgo. The lord of Virgo is Mercury. Also the Mercury is lord of 
Gemini. So, Husband’s Moon is in Virgo sign and the same Virgo is wife’s Lagna. Fortunately 
wife’s lagna lord Mercury is in husband’s 12th house or Lagna sign (Aquarius). Husband’s 7th 
lord Sun is in wife’s Lagna sign. Here there is interlink is between husband’s Moon and 
wife’s Lagna sign and lord; husband’s 7‘ lord and wife’s Lagna sign.

Question 1: Rationale of Retrogression in Horary 
I would like to know why retrogression is considered in horary analysis while it doesn’t mat- 
ter in natal analysis. 


Answer 1: 

In horary studies, planets stay in “dynamic” motion as follows: 

1) If the question is ruled by a retrograde planet at the time of query, the condition will 
change when the planet goes direct. If the ruling planet is direct and will soon turn retro- 
grade, the event asked about may not happen. Retrograde planets in horary brings things 
and people back. (Helen Adams Garrett: More About Retrogrades, 1991) 

2) For example, if a planet retrogrades in the 7th house the querent gone out of station will 
return for the query about the return. (S. Kannan, Astr;ogicalMagazine January 1972) 

3) Retrograde planets never give all that is expected. (Charles Carter: Horary Astrology, 
1942) 

4) Retrograde is found fatal to the success of question. (Alan Leo: Horary Astrology, 2006 
Edition p 132) 

5) An angular planet going retrograde or into combustion may wreck its ability to act ina 
positive fashion. (J. Lee Lehman: The Martial Art of Horary Astrology p 264) 


Question 2: Backward Prediction 

Is it possible to predict when a person for example got married?; for example if I want to 
check a horoscope of 50 year old man and he asks “can you tell me in which dasha and 
bhukti I got married”. A range will be enough and not the exact date. 


Answer 2: 
Yes, it’s possible and had been done in different kinds of quiz in many long time ago Yahoo 
astrological discussion groups including KP of astrosage.com, http://groups.yahoo.com/ 


eroup/k_p_system. 


Question 3: Aspect in 4 Step Theory 

I have a quick question about aspects in 4 step theory. Should we consider lagna chart as- 
pects? If a strong planet is aspected by, and aspects other houses then will all those be sig- 
nificators? What about opposite house aspect? 


Answer 3: 

In 4 step theory the Hindu aspects with orb of 3deg:20min are used. The Hindu aspects are 
counted ‘from rasi to rasi’, irrespective of the positions of the planets in the rasis and the 
relative distance between the two planets i.e. not ‘from degree to degree’ like in the West- 
ern aspects. Planets aspect the entire rasis with or without any planet or cusp there, and the 
closer an aspect on any located planet or cusp is, the stronger the result would be. 


A STUDY ARTICLE ON FOUR STEP THEORY 
(by Tin Win, courtesy of KPE-zine Dec 2007) 


3. ‘Additional’ Primary Significators from the KP ‘E’ Grade Significators 

15. The special rules of upgrading the weak KP ‘EF’ grade significators to the primary 
significators in this theory are as follows: 

1) Conjunction with the Cusps, 

2) Conjunction between the Planets, 


KP Ezine August 2021 73 


3) Aspect on the Cusps, and 
4) Aspect between the Planets. 


IT.3.3. Rule 6 of Aspect on the Cusps 

21. If a planet throws the Hindu aspects on the cusps (not houses) within the 3d:20m orb, 
the planet becomes a ‘primary’ significator of these houses whose cusps are aspected, only if 
the ‘original’ planet itself is a ‘primary’ significator (as per Rule 1 and 2), ‘irrespective’ of other 
planets ‘being’ in these houses. Ketu’s 7th aspect on the ‘cusp’ within 30d:20m orb is taken 
into consideration, implying to consider Rahu’s similar aspect on the opposite cusp. 
Nevertheless, Rahu/Ketu’s aspect on each other or any other planet is not considered. Any 
aspect of Rahu/Ketu is not applicable in KP. (R 1, pages 28, 34, 70, 87, R 14) 


22. In the example chart ‘1’, Jupiter aspects the 7, 9, 11 cusps within 3d:20m. Since Jupiter 
with no planet in its star is a ‘primary’ significator by Rule 2, it becomes a ‘primary’ 
significator of the 7, 9, 11 houses by Rule 6. In the example chart ‘2’, Saturn aspects the 2nd 
cusp only within prescribed 3d:20m orb but its aspect on the 7 and 11 cusps are beyond the 
prescribed 3d:20m orb. As a ‘primary’ significator by Rule 2, Saturn with no planet in its star 
also becomes a ‘primary’ significator of the 2nd house by Rule 6 but not 7 and 11 houses. 
‘Me Asp 1, Ju Asp 9, Ve Asp 12, Ra Asp 9, Ke Asp 3’ are all the ‘7th’ aspects, and 
consequently at the same time ‘Me Cnj 7, Ju Cnj 3, Ve Cnj 6, Ra Cnj 3, Ke Cnj 9’. Thus these 
planets become the primary significators of the opposite houses, ie. ‘Me for 1 & 7 houses; 
Ju for 3 & 9; Ve for 6 & 12; Ra for 3 & 9; Ke for 9 & 3’, indicating opposite matters, such as 
sickness and cure, loss and gain. So there is a difference of opinion ‘not to consider’ the “7th’ 
aspect on the cusps or planets and to consider ‘conjunction only’. Depending on which 
option (with or without 7th aspect) is applied, the result can be entirely different in some 
cases; for instance, in the case of the actual marriage on 25-12-2005 (Me-Sa-Ve DBA dasa) 
in a male chart, 09-09-1978, 06:32 AM, Belgaum, Karnataka, India, 15N52, 74E30, New 
KPA 23:28:10, Asc Le 24:38:40, by KPAstro 3.0. Mercury Dasa and Saturn Bhukti are 
justified for marriage. But the Antara lord Venus is capable of giving marriage, if ‘Su Asp 7’ 
by 7th aspect is considered in the 4th step of Venus, otherwise marriage is denied by the 
only primary  significatior of the ‘totally negative’ houses 1, 12 for marriage in the 4th step 
of Venus as shown under. 


1) Primary Significators ‘with’ 7th Aspect (as in R1) 

Planet Ve: 

Starlord of Ve is Ra: 1; Sgl Me(12); Stl Su(12, Asp 7, Cnj 1) 
Sublord of Ve is Ra: 

Starlord of Rais Su: 12; Asp 7; Cnj 1 


2) Primary Significators ‘without’ 7th Aspect 

Planet Ve: 

Starlord of Ve is Ra: 1; Sgl Me(12); Stl Su(12, Cnj 1) 
Sublord of Ve is Ra: 

Starlord of Rais Su: 12; Cnj 1 


1.3.4. Rule 7 of Aspect between the Planets 

23. fa planet has the Hindu aspect (throwing or receiving) with another planet within the 
prescribed 3d:20m orb, the planet becomes a ‘primary’ significator of another planet, 
provided the ‘original’ planet itself is a ‘primary’ significator (as per Rule 1 and 2). Aspects on 
each other of two planets in the opposite signs are also considered. However, Rahu/Ketu’s 
aspect on each other or another planet is not applicable but its 7th aspect on the opposite 
cusp is considered. (R 1, pages 28, 30, 54, 57, 70, 75, R 14) 


24. In the example chart 1, regarding ‘Mo Asp by Ju’, on the side of receiving aspect, Moon 
with no planet in it star, a primary significator by Rule 2, will offer the results of Jupiter (3-8, 
Asp Mo[10-12], Asp 7,9,11, Cnj 3) in any step of the 4 steps, ie. 1st step of Moon. On the 
other side of throwing aspect, Jupiter with no planet in its star, a primary 


KP Ezine August 2021 74 


significator by Rule 2, will give the results of Moon(10-2) in any step, ie.1st step of Jupiter. In 
the case of ‘Ket Asp by Ju’, Ketu in its own star, a primary significator by Rule 2, will give the 
results of Ju(3-8, Asp Mo[10-12], Asp 7,9,11, Cnj 3) in 1st step of Ketu, 2nd step of Ketu and 
Saturn and 4th step of Ketu and Rahu. Since there is only ‘one way’ of giving results by Ra- 
hu/Ketu, Jupiter ‘cannot’ give the results of Ketu vice versa although Ketu is an agent of Ju- 
piter. In the example chart of a male, 09-04-1958, 04:25 AM, Indore, MP, India, 22N43, 
79ES0, New KPA 23:11:03, Asc Aq 18:41:01, the aspects of Mercury in Aries and Jupiter in 
Libra on each other by 7th aspect within the prescribed orb are to be considered, ie. Mercury 
giving the results of Jupiter(8-11) and Jupiter offering the results of Mercury(2-5), like in the 
example chart no. 14 in page 56 of R1, where Jupiter and Moon aspecting on each other by 
7th aspect, Jupiter giving the results of Moon(2, etc) and Moon offering the results of Jupiter 
(8, etc)..

Book review- 
The Outer Planets and Their Cycles: 
The Astrology of the Collective 





: TET SBE: # a } By: Tin Win 


——— ) Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








The Outer Planets and Their Cycles: The Astrology of the Collective Paperback — 
by Liz Greene 
Cres Publications; 2nd edition, 1996, 182 pages 





“The Outer Planets and Their Cycles — The Astrology of the Collective”, is a classic work on 
mundane astrology written by Liz Greene, was originally published in 1983 and revised in 
2005. The book is based on a series of lectures given by the author in 1980. Liz Greene ex- 
plores the meaning of Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, in both individual and national charts. 
This book predicted major world events such as the collapse of the Soviet Union, the for- 
mation of a united Europe, and the rise of religious fundamentalism. As Liz Greene wrote in 
the preface to the 2005 edition, this book “contains probably the first published prediction of 
the fall of the Soviet Union”. 


Lecture One: An introduction to the outer planets 

In this first part the author presents the meaning of Uranus, Neptune and Pluto. She wrote 
that the creative ideas symbolized by Uranus are taken in the world, in a conscious way, 
mostly, by people with a Saturn conjunct Uranus. 

Pluto is linked with a certain vision of the Universe and with the Hermetic world — view. 


Lecture Two: Aspects to the outer planets 

The author wrote about Pluto in Libra, Chiron, the aspects between Uranus and Pluto, Sun 
and Neptune, Saturn and Uranus, Saturn and Neptune, Saturn and Pluto, the periods when 
Uranus, Pluto, Neptune were discovered and the synchronic events. For example: 

“Neptune materializes as the alcoholic or the deceitful partner, and Uranus dresses as the 
partner who leaves you, and Pluto disguises himself as the partner who has power over you 


KP Ezine August 2021 76 


or has some pretty complicated sexual and emotional patterns. [...] A person with strong out- 
er planet contacts may have a disruptive effect in the group, because the outer planets tend 
to feel threatening to more Saturnian values.” 


Lecture Three: The outer planets in individual horoscopes 

The author writes about the chart of Adolf Hitler (Pluto — Neptune conjunction, Uranus on 
the Ascendant), Karl Marx (Uranus — Neptune conjunction square Saturn and Pluto), Lenin 
(Uranus square Neptune), Freud (Sun with Uranus), Jung (Sun with Uranus square Nep- 
tune), the Uranus — Pluto conjunction of 1960. 


Lecture Four: Outer planets rulership of signs and houses 
The author writes about Uranus, Neptune and Pluto as co-rulers of Aquarius, Pisces and 
Scorpio. Also about Saturn and Pluto in the 12th house. 


Lecture Five: The USSR and the Uranus — Neptune conjunction 
In this chapter the author wrote about the transit of Pluto on the URSS Sun and predicted 
the disintegration of the Soviet Union around 1989. 


Lecture Six: Outer planets in everyday life 

The author presents many examples of outer planets in aspects with personal planets, espe- 
cially with Venus, and of outer planets placed in angles, especially in the 7th and 10th 
house. 


Lecture Seven: The outer planets and the Astrological Ages 
The author wrote about the Piscean Age, the religions and myths associated, the transition to 
the Aquarian Age. 


The book has 2 appendixes, one is “The Generation Gap”, an interesting article about the 
astrological links between generations, the second is “The Good, the Bad and the Ugly: the 
Chiron — Pluto cycle”, an article about the cycle of Chiron and Pluto. 


This book is a good book of mundane astrology, written in 1983, when there wasn’t many 
written material on this subject. It treats different themes of mundane astrology, it’s diverse 
and interesting to read. It isn’t so detailed and comprehensive as “Mundane Astrology: The 
Astrology of Nations and States, by H. S. Green, Charles E. O. Carter, Raphael, 2005”, but 
still is one of the best books on mundane astrology, a book where the reader will meet the 
accuracy and clarity of Liz Greene’s vision of astrology.

When will US Supreme Court Justice Stephen 
Breyer retire? 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 


‘PERE HREEREREHEREREREHEEHEEEEEEEEEEEHEEEHEEHEEEEEEEEEE EE & 








Short Background 

US Supreme Court Associate Justice Stephen Breyer, 83, told CNN earlier this summer he 
has made no decisions regarding when he might step down and that any future retirement 
decisions would be based on his health and the court. He signals he'll retire before he dies by 
telling the New York Times in an interview, “I don't think I'm going to stay there till I 
die—hope not". He said during a recent interview there are “many things” that will impact 
the timing of his retirement, including who is in the Oval Office at the time he makes his 
decision. He also added that he would like to ensure that the person appointed after him 
would not “just reverse everything I’ve done for the last 25 years,” quoting late Justice 
Antonin Scalia. 


Breyer is one of three liberal Supreme Court justices who was appointed by a Democrat 
President Bill Clinton on 13 May 1994. If he retires before the 2022 November midterm 
elections while Biden is president, progressives are hopeful Biden will appoint a justice who 
would retain the court's current balance of its 63 conservative majority. Democrats 
currently hold slim majorities in both chambers of Congress, losing a majority in the Senate 
could threaten the confirmation of a Biden-nominated justice. 





KP Rule for Retirement: it happens during the joint dasa period of significators of 3, 5, 9 
or 12 houses. To be in service are houses 2, 6, 10 or 11. 

According to the AstroDatabank AA rated birth details, Stephen Breyer was born on 15 
August 1938 at 07:40 AM (- 08:000, at San Francisco, California, 37N47, 122W25. 

The current running joint dasa Jupiter- Saturn is from 22 August 2021 to 04 March 2024. 
As shown in the following table, Jupiter dasa and Saturn bhukti are conducive for 
retirement. Jupiter is not in the Ruling Planets at the time of judgment which can be 
checked in the attached chart, it doesn’t matter. Then Ketu antra is chosen since no 6 and 
10 of main houses to be in service in planet and star lord levels. Venus sooksha is left since 
10 is planet level and 6-10 in sub level. Sun and Moon sookshmas are left since 6 or/and 10 
are in sub level. Mars sookshma is chosen. 

So Breyer’s retirement is expected during Jupiter dasa- Saturn bhukti- Ketu antra- Mars 
sookshma (15-18 June 2022).

Government Job (Part - IV) 






By: Sri. Raghavendra Rao Desai

This is continuation of earlier article about Government job (Part-IIJ). It is the dream or aim 
or ambition for every person. In modern days IT, BT and Multinational companies are 
dominating the society still peoples prefer for the government job, because it gives job 
security for the native. 


For profession in Vedic astrology we will see D1 (Lagna Chart) and D10 (Dasamsa Divisional 
Chart). As per Vedic astrology if the Sun is in 10% house gives government job. But Sun 
alone is not enough for the government job, along with Sun we have to consider other plants 
also. If Sun is posited in 10th house and if that 10th house is Leo Sign then to some extent we 
can consider it for government job. 


As I wrote in my previous article the Sun is in Libra Sign (here Sun is debilitate as per Vedic 
astrology). Because as per rule Libra sign is a Male sign. So, just don’t go blindly on the 
basis of dictums. Try to think in all angles that is why it has taken place. So, analyse 
horoscope in different angles also. Because theory is different from practice. So, “Leave no 
stone unturned”. 


Now, we will see what are houses, planets and signs that are responsible or important for the 
government job. I will present all the related information in this article. 


Houses 2, 6, 10 and 11 houses are considered for employment and services because, 


2:4 House: It denotes money matters, profit and gain, one can earn, financial prosperity, 
bank position. 


6th House: It denotes job / service / day- to - day attendance. 

10*s House: It denotes profession / occupation / name & fame / power & prestige. 

11 House: It denotes desires, hopes, aspirations & their realization. 

Karaka Planets for profession is Saturn and Digbala planets for 10t house is Sun and Mars. 


KP gives rules clearly that — 11t CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or 
Sublord of 2.4 or 6t or 10th or 118 house. Or 


6th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sublord of 2"4 or 10 or 11 lord Or 


10th CSBL should be a significator through its Starlord or Sublord of 2.4 or 11 or 6t house 
lord. 


Permanent or Temporary job: If the sublord of the 6tt cusp becomes the significator of 2, 10 
and 11 houses through its Starlord or Sublord, then it shows permanent job but if it becomes 
significators along with houses of 5 or 9th house also denotes temporary job or native is not 
likely to stick to one job. 


If the 10th cusp sublord is significator of 6 house through starlord and 7t* house through 
sublord it indicates private job. Venus is planet for private job as well as for business.

"By Sanyasi it is meant that one gives up this worldly pleasures and possessions and cares 
more for paralokasadhanam. His server's connection and the family and new cycle of starts. 
In Horary Astrology, one can become a Sanyasi only when the sub lord of the Ascendant is 
connected with the houses 3, 10, 12, and it is in any manner connected with Saturn. . 


In human life some people spend their marital life with their life partner up to end of the life. 
Now human life can be categorized in three divisions. 


1. Someone live without marital life. They are not married any one they become sanyasi. 
They spend their life for spiritual, leave at Matt life SWAMI ji, Pitadhipathi. Devotional speak- 
ers up to send of life. They are Brahmachare. 


2. Someone males married and spend with life wife. Unfortunately with in span of time wife 
died, or divorce. This persons con not marriage again they depression life 


3. Someone live married after some years (3-5) with life wife. After children's birth wife died, 
or divorce. This person's con not marriage they spend life with their children's. They are be- 
come caretaker to big family up to end of life. 


The above said rule is applicable to these persons. Someone from childhood, young age, mid- 
dle age.

Spiritual Emancipation through proficiency in Sangeetha Vidya by Sri Thyagaraja 
Kakarla Bhagavathar. 


As per our Hindu scriptures spiritual emancipation can be achieved through three ways 
which are (1) the karma-marga (the path of duty) or the dispassionate discharge of ritual 
and social obligations; (2) the jnana-marga (the path of knowledge) which is the use of 
meditation with concentration preceded by a long and _ systematic ethical and 
contemplative training through yoga to gain insight into one’s identity with brahman and 
(3) the bhakti-marga (the path of devotion), adherence to a personal god. Different kinds of 
people find one of these three suitable to their karma. 

Only a few Hindus such as monks or those dedicated to the service of God seek moksha. 
But it is the goal that is relevant to all Hindus. Hierarchical values and social institutions 
are determined by moksha, as they are religious doctrines and practices. The root purpose 


KP Ezine September 2021 73 


of Indian philosophy is to understand what one must do and attain through direct experi- 
ence in order to escape from samsara (bondage) and become spiritually emancipated. 

Sri Thyagaraja Kakarla Bhagavathar an eminent Vaaggeya kara (music exponent) of 17th 
century has chosen the path of Sangeetha Vidya for his elf emancipation and attained 
moksha or siddhi on 06 January 1847.

With these basic rules of our KP system on “Music / singing’ now I would like to analyze the 
natal chart of Sri Thagaraju Bhagavathar. Kakarla here under---- 


Sri Thyagaraju is also known as Thyagayya was a renowned composer and great singer of 
Carnatic Classical music. He was named after the deity of Thiruvayur Thyagaraja. He was 
born on 04th May 1767 in the Thiruvayur to Sri Kakarla Ramabrahmamam and Sitamma 
and left his body on an auspicious day of Pushya Bahula Panchami. He had a saintly face 
and an inspiring personality. 


He was prolific and highly influential in the development of India's classical music tradition. 
Thyagayya began his musical training at an early age under the tutelage of Sri Sonti Venkata 
Ramayya, a senior music scholar of his time, after the latter heard his singing and was 
impressed by the child prodigy. Thyagaraju regarded music as a way to experience God’s 
love. 

He composed his first Keerthana “Namo Namo Raghavayya” in Desica Thodi Ragam and in- 
scribed it on the walls of his house. 


Thyagaraju saw the reigns of four kings of the Maratha dynasty — Tulaja II (1763- 
1787), Amarasimha (1787-1798), Serfoji II (1798-1832) and Sivaji II (1832-1855), although 
he served none of them 

He was a versatile, genius and a gifted composer. His compositions were a confluence of bha- 
va, raga, and tala. He was a scholar in Sanskrit and Telugu languages. 

About 700 songs remain of the 24,000 songs said to have been composed by him; however, 
scholars are sceptical about numbers like these, as there is no biographical evidence to 
support such claims. In addition to nearly ‘700 compositions (Kritis), Thyagaraju composed 
two musical plays in Telugu, the Prahalada_ Bhaktt_Vyayam and the Nauka_Chart- 
tam. Prahlada Bhakti Vyayam is in five acts with 45 Kritis set in 28 Ragas and 138 verses, in 
different metres in Telugu. Nauka Charitam is a shorter play in one act with 21 Kritis set in 
13 ragas and 43 verses. The latter is the most popular of Thyagaraju's operas, and is a 
creation of the composer's imagination and has no basis in the Bhagavata Purana. Thyaga- 
raju also composed several simple devotional pieces appropriate for choral singing. 

With these few lines of introduction on a wizard of the Indian Classical music field, now I 
would like to dwell upon the legendary astrological birth chart of Sri Kakarla Thyagaraju 
Bhagavathar of the 17th-century musician.

II) Remembrance of the great legend of Carnatic Classical Music of 17‘ century--- 


Tyagaraja <Aradhana, the commemorative music festival is held every year 
in Thiruvaiyaru in Thanjavur district of Tamil Nadu, from January to February in Tyaga- 
raju's honour. This is a week-long festival of music where various Carnatic musicians from 
all over the world converge at their resting place. On the Pushya Bahula 
Panchami, thousands of people and hundreds of Carnatic musicians sing the five Pancha- 
ratna Kritis in unison, with the accompaniment of a large bank of accompanists on veenas, 
violins, flutes, nadaswaram, mridangams and ghatams. 

A sports complex in New Delhi, Tyagaraj, was named after him. A crater on the planet 
Mercury was named after Thyagaraju. As the most famous composer of Telugu Kritis or 
(kirtans), Tyagaraju, who is fondly remembered as Tyagayya, has caught the imagination of 
filmmakers in the Telugu film industry. Apart from references to his works, using 
the kirtans as songs, two films were made on his life. Chittoor V. Nagaiah made a 
biographical epic on Tyagaraja titled Tyagayya in 1946 which is still treated as a masterpiece 
of Telugu cinema. In 1981, Bapu-Ramana made Tyagayya with J. V. Somayajulu in the lead 
role. Another attempt is being made by Singeetam Srinivasa Rao to picturise Tyagaraju's life. 
Apart from these Bombay Gnanam made a short film known as Endarao Mahanubavulu on 
ori Tyagayya.

gotiations, 3-9-12= Failure in negotiations).

Questions & Answers 


By: Tin Win 


Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Question 1: Significators 

Sir, I read your house groupings articles. Thanks a lot for those. 

Should the houses to be signified mentioned in the column be signified be only primary significators 
by 4 step theory, or even the secondary significators are considered to see if event is possible? 


Answer 1: 

In KP, in the signification of cuspal sub lords and DBAS lords, significators of rank A, B, C & D and 
their sub lords are mainly to be considered. Very weak significators of rank E of conj. and aspect are 
to be used as last resort. 


In 4 step theory only primary significators are to be considered as mentioned by the author Sunil ji. 


Question 2: Undesirable character 
What is rule of character problem of any person in KP astrology....pls clarify. 


Criminal and relentless mind 

If the cuspal sub lord of Ascendent be the significator of houses 6, 8, 12, then the native 
has the criminal and relentless mind during the joint dasa period of the significators of 
houses 6, 8, 12. 


Having illicit connection 

If the cuspal sub lord of 2nd house be the significator of 2, 5, 11, then the native has the 
illicit connection (affair) during the joint dasa period of significators of 2, 5, 11. 

Timid and coward person 

If the cuspal sub lord of 3rd house be the significator of houses 8,12, then the native be- 


comes timid and coward during the joint dasa period of significators of houses 8, 12. 


etc.

China's Evergrande debt crisis shakes global 
stock markets 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Short Background 

China's second largest property developer Evergrande has helped fuel a decades-long boom 
in the Chinese real estate market since its founding in 1996, which in turn has helped fuel 
China's growing economy. 





But much of that growth has been fueled by an unsustainable surge in debt, and fears of a 
looming default by Evergrande sent global stock markets tumbling on 21 September 2021 
when it missed interest payments due to at least two of its largest bank creditors. Chinese 
stocks have already declined as a consequence of the new restrictions this year. 


Evergrande grew to be one of China's biggest companies by borrowing more than $300 bil- 
lion. The financial fallout would be far reaching. Evergrande reportedly owes money to 
around 171 domestic banks and 121 other financial firms. That's likely due to the height- 
ened uncertainty as to whether Evergrande's debt crisis represents the first domino to fall in 
a potentially systemic contagion that leads to more busted property developers, unpaid sup- 
pliers, and financially ruined lenders and investors, similar to the US housing crash that 
sparked the Great Recession of 2008. 


Let us see how this debt crisis is reflected in the horoscopes of the Shanghai Stock Exchange 
and the People's Republic of China.

Will second treatment Intracytoplasmic 
sperm injection (ICSI) be successful? 


By: Kanakkumar B. Bosmia 
613- P.B. Parekh Tower, Nr. Diwan Ballubhai School, 
Kankariya-Ahmedabad: Pin: 380022 
Mobile : +91-9825131165: Email : kanakbosmia@yahoo.com; 

















Question: Will second treatment Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) be successful? 
Number: 41 (out of 249). 

Date of Judgment: 17-07-2019, Wednesday; Time of Judgment 10:51:03 AM IST 
Place of Judgment: Kankariya- Ahmedabad; Lat/Long: 23° N 00', 72° E 36’, 
Ayanamsha 24°.02'.23 " Dasa days: 365.25 


Hints 

If the sub lord of the 5th cusp (female) or the 11th cusp (male) is the significator (in the star 
of the occupant or owner) of 2 (increase in family), 5 (conception, child) or 11 (Sth from 7) or 
connected with 2, 5 or 11, child birth is promised. If it is the significator of 1, 4 or 10 (being 
12th from 2, 5 and 11), child birth is not promised during the joint period of significators of 
20,11, 


If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th house occupies the barren sign Aries, Gemini, Leo or Virgo 
and is in the star of the planet in the barren sign, then the woman concerned is not 
pregnant. 


No child 
If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th (pregnancy) is the significator of 1 (barrenness), 4 (12 from

Heart problem leads to surgery 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 











Whenever heart is unable to pump the blood to all parts of the body then heart is said to be 
deceased. This is due to narrowed blood vessels obstructing the free flow of blood or 
fluctuations in the supply of voltage to the heart muscle. 


In astrology, 4 and 5th houses of natural zodiac, sign Cancer and Leo, rule over the heart in 
general. Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Saturn causes cardiac troubles. Whenever the malefic such 
as Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Kethu occupied the 4 house or aspecting 4th house of natural 
zodiac or 4th house from lagna not guarded by the benefic planets it indicates heart decease. 


We will examine the heart decease in the horoscope of the native whose birth particulars are 
mentioned below: 


DOB: 3-6-1991 Time: 3-36 pm __— Place: Palakollu 


The native has borne in the star of Mars (Dhanishta) with an ascendant Libra. 

In K.P. if the 6 cuspal sub lord is connected to lagna, the native is prone to disease. The 
disease is fatal or serious if the sub lord signifies 8. 12 signification by the sub lord 
denotes hospitalization. So if the 6 CSL signifies 1, 6, 8, 12 it poses serious health 
problems. 


In the horoscope, 6t* cuspal sub lord is Sun in 8th, lord of 11 (badhaka), in the star of 
afflicted Moon and in the sub of Mercury, lord of 12. The star lord Moon is aspected by lagna 
lord Venus and 6 lord Jupiter. So Sun signifies 1, 6, 8, 12, badhaka and denotes serious 
health problems during joint period of significators of 1, 6, 8, 12. 


In the chart 4t* house of natural zodiac is sign Cancer. The sign cancer is occupied by 
Venus (lord of 1,8th), Jupiter (lord of 6t), Mars (lord of maraka houses 2, 7) afflicting the 
sign. Further Malefic Saturn conjunct with Moon is also afflicting sign Cancer by 74 aspect 
and lagna by 10th aspect denoting the heart disease as 4th house represents heart etc. 


The significators are as follows: 
Significators 

1 Venus 

6 Kethu, Jupiter 

8 Mercury, Rahu, Sun, Venus 

12 Mercury 
The native has borne in the dasa period of Mars (conjunct with 6 lord Jupiter and Venus 
lord of 1, 8) in the star of Saturn in 4 lord of 4,5, in the sub of Sun lord of badhaka in 8h 
house denotes suffering with disease of heart related problems in childhood. Because of the 
signification of life saving or cure giving 1,5, 128 to 2,6 serious impact of the disease on the 
native has not arisen during the period of Mars dasa. 
Rahu dasa followed after Mars period is over. Rahu represents Jupiter being in the sign of 
Sagittarius. Rahu posited in 3 in the star of Sun in 8 lord of 11 (badhaka) and in the sub of 
Moon, lord of Cancer sign, afflicted by Mars (maraca), Venus (1,8) and Jupiter (6 disease). 
So Rahu signifies 1, 6, 8 connected to Mars through Moon, indicates major surgery during 
its period.

My conclusion: 

As 7th cuspal sub lord Mercury is untenanted and signifies 12th house strongly and also da-

KP Rule: 

If the 5th (love) CSL be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 7 (marriage / 
legal bondage) or the 7th CSL be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 5, 
love marriage is promised. 


If the sub lord of 7 CSL be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 2,7,11 
marriage is promised. During the joint period of significators of 2, 5, 7, 11 love marriage is 
promised. (Prashna Jyotish by Kanak Bosmia ji... page no. 259) 


Let us check the Moon (2-5) which is in the star of Moon (2-5) and in the sub of Rahu (2). Ra- 
hu is conjoined with Moon (2-5). So, her desire is genuine.

oth CSL Rahu (2) is in the star of Moon (2-5). Rahu is conjoined with Moon (2-5). Rahu is in

fies 2-5-6-7. So, the event is promised. Note: Rahu has no planet in its stars and signifies 2 
and 7 strongly at sub-level. 


Let us check the 7+ CSL 
7th CSL is Venus (6-2, 7) is in the star of Moon (2-5) and in the sub of Venus (6-2, 7). Here 7th 
CSL Venus signifies 2-5-6-7, the love marriage is promised. 


Let us check the 11th CSL 
11th CSL is Rahu, already we have discussed above. Here, Rahu has no planets in his stars 
and signifies 5 & 11 strongly at sub-level. So, the marriage is promised. 


Let us check the 274 CSL 
2nd CSL is Saturn (10-11, 12) is in the star of Moon (2-5) and in the sub of Jupiter (11-9,10). 
So, 224 CSL signifies 2-5-9-10-11-12, the marriage is promised.

Marriage when? 


By: Gopall Krisshna Jha 





\ Gupta Tola , P.O -Berhait -816102

A girl asks me when she will get married. She said that her parents have seen a boy for her 
marriage but nothing is sure as of now. 


Birth Details 

Name: S. Shah 

Date of Birth : 01.09.1986.; Time of Birth : 03:37 AM. 

Place of Birth : Dhule (Gujarat).; Longitude : 74-47 E; Latitude : 20-54N 


For Marriage, houses are to be considered 2, 7 and 11 in Krishnamurti Paddhati. The 294 
house denotes 'Kutumba' - the family, all those members closely allied to the native by birth 
or by Connection. Further, 24 House also denotes ‘acquisition’ and acquisition to the family 
by marriage. 


The 7 house denotes legal bondage with another and the partner with whom one is to lead 
family life. 


The 11t* house denotes long standing love, pleasure and partnership in life, , marital bliss 
etc. That's why houses 2, 7 and 11 are considered for the marriage. 


Now let us examine whether the marriage is promised or not in the light of KP Rules. 


KP Rule: 

If the 7th (marriage, legal bondage) cuspal sub lord signifies 2 (increase in family members by 
amrriage), 7 or 11 (permanent tie of friendship, fulfillment of desire) house, then marriage is 
promised and it would take place during the conjoined period of the significators of 2, 7 and 
11. 


Cuspal analysis: 

In this Chart, 7th cusp sub lord is Venus. Venus is in the star of Mars and sub of Mercury. 
Venus signifies 3, 4 and 11 houses; Star lord Mars signifies 6, 10 and 5 houses and sub lord 
Mercury signifies 2, 3 and 12 houses. 7th cusp sub lord Venus signifies 2, 11 houses. Hence 
marriage is promised in this chart. 


Ruling planets:- 
The chart was judged on 16.06.2021, Wednesday at 16:04:03 hrs in Hyderabad (Telangana). 


Ascendant Star lord = Jupiter Ascendant Sign lord = Venus 

Moon Star lord = Ketu. Moon Sign lord = Sun. 

Day Lord = Mercury 

Ketu represent Mars as Ketu is in Scorpio. Hence Mars is also included in the list of ruling 
planets. 


Dasa-Bhukti-Anthra analysis:- 

At time of Judgment, the native was running the major Dasa of Ketu , Bhukti of Venus and 
Anthra of Rahu from 23.04.2021 to 26-.06.2021. 

Ketu and Venus are common between dasha-Bhukti and Ruling Planets. Let's check it 


whether both are promising the marriage or not.

Marriage proposal 


BY: M. Vara Prasad Rao 


Sri Varasiddhi Jyotishyalam 
Opp. Sri Lakshmi E.M.School, N.R.Peta, Kurnool — 2, A.P. 
Mobile : 08309234634, Email: vara999@gmail.com 











One of my clients asked me, “sir, one marriage proposal has come to me, whether it will be 
successful or not”. She gave me the number of 229 (out of 249). 
DOJ:- 14.08.2021, TOJ:- 07:23:00pm, POJ:- Kurnool. 


General KP rule: 

If the sub lord of the 34 cusp be the significator of 3-7-9, the native undergoes negotiations 
for marriage during the joint period of the significators of 3-7-9-11 (3-9-11 = Success in

One of my clients asked me, “When will my younger sister’s daughter get the job”. This is the time 
chart of that day. 
DOJ:- 06.08.2021, TOJ:- 06.06.11 pm, POJ:- Kurnool. 


KP rule: 

If the 6t or 10th cuspal sub lord be (in the star of the occupant or owner) the significator of 2, 6 or 10 
service or earning is promised during the joint period of the significators of 2, 6 & 10. (Ref: Prashna 
Jyotish by Shri Kanak Bosmia ji, Page No.127). 


Let us check the Moon (6-7) in the star of Jupiter (1-12, 3) and in the sub of Ketu (10). Ketu is the 
agent of Mars (7-4, 11). So, the intension about his niece was genuine. 


First, we check the 6t CSL 

6th CSL is Mercury (7-6, 9) in the star of own Mercury (7-6, 9) and in the sub of Rahu (4). Rahu is in 
Taurus sign represents Venus (8-5, 10). Here, Mercury is in own star and the CSL of 6-11-12. So, 6th 
CSL signifies 4-5-6-7-8-9-10-11-12, the event is promised, OK. 


Next, we check the 10th CSL 

10 CSL Jupiter (1-12, 3) is in the star of Mars (7-4, 11) and sub of Sun (7-8). So, the 10t# CSL Jupi- 
ter signifies 1-3-4-7-8-11-12. So, his fulfilment of desire is promised. 

(it isn’t correct as per the said rule without any of 2,6,10.) 


Next, let us check the 11th CSL 
11th CSL is also Mercury, we have already discussed above (6th cusp). 


Ruling planets follows: - 

Lagna sub lord: Venus 

Lagna star lord: Venus 

Lagna sign lord: Jupiter 

Moon sub lord: Moon 

Moon star lord: Ketu 

Moon Sign lord: Jupiter 

Day lord: Mars 

Rahu is the agent of Venus, so Rahu is taken as a Ruling Planet. 

So, the common planets between 6-fold significators and Ruling Planets: Ra/Ke/Ve/Ju/Mo 


At the time of judgment Jupiter dasa is running 15.05.2014 to 15.05.2030. Next, Bhukti lord is Ketu 
period from 21.04.2021 to 27.03.2022. Next, Antra lord Mars is not in RP’s. So, next Antra lord Rahu 
is running from 09.09.2021 to 30.10.2021. 


Astrological Prediction: - During this period of 09.09.2021 to 30.10.2021, the querent will get the 


job. He informed by phone that his niece was selected for the job on 09.09.2021. Thanks, KP system.

Gain from tuition 


BY: M. Vara Prasad Rao 


Sri Varasiddhi Jyotishyalam 
Opp. Sri Lakshmi E.M.School, N.R.Peta, Kurnool — 2, A.P. 
Mobile : 08309234634, Email: vara999@gmail.com 











One of my clients asked me “Sir, I started an independent intermediate and competitive 
Maths coaching institute in these pandemic conditions of corona virus after losing the 
private lecturer job. But it is not gainful as I expected, when it was gain to me, please tell me 
which period the growth will come”. I asked him to give the number from 1 to 249, 
immediately he said 7 (out of 249). I erected the chart with details given below. 


DOJ:-13.09.2021, TOJ:- 12.41.00 pm, POJ:- Kurnool (A.P.) 


KP rule: 

If the 10th (independent business) cuspal sub lord be the significator (in the star of occupant 
or owner) of 2 (money/wealth), 7 (business with others) or 10 (business), an independent 
business is promised during the joint period of the significators of 2, 7 & 10. (Ref: Prashna 
Jyotish by Shri Kanak Bosmia ji, Page No.153). 


If the cuspal sub lord of the 7t be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 2, 
10 or 11, gain is promised during the joint period of the significators of 2, 10 and 11. 


Let us check the Moon (8 (obstacles and struggles)- 4(education), 5) is in the star of Mercury 
(6-3, 6(daily attendance)) and in the sub of Ketu (8). Ketu is the agent of Mars (6 (opponent 
loss and competitions)-1, 8). Here, Mercury indicates the education and mathematics. So, his 
desire is genuine. 


Let us check the 10t CSL Rahu (2) in the star of Moon (8-4, 5). Rahu is the agent of Venus (7 
-2, 7) and in the sub of Mars (6-1, 8). So, the 10th CSL Rahu signifies 1-2-4-5-6-7-8. Here the 
querent’s desire is promised. 


Let us check the 78 CSL also Rahu, we have discussed above. OK 


Next, we check the 11th CSL Saturn (10-11) in the star of Moon (8-4, 5) and in the sub of 
Rahu (2), Rahu is the agent of Venus (7-2, 7). So, 11ts CSL Saturn signifies 2-4-5-7-8-10-11. 
So, the event is promised. 


Let us check the Ruling Planets, 
Lagna sublord: Saturn 

Lagna starlord: Mercury 

Lagna signlord: Mars 

Moon sublord: Ketu 

Moon starlord: Mercury 

Moon signlord: Mars 


So, the Ruling Planets are: Sa/Me/Ma/Ke 

At the time of judgement Mercury dasa/Ketu bhukti is running from 09.10.2020 to 
06.10.2021. Next Mercury dasa/Ketu bhukti/Mercury Antra is running from 16.08.2021 to 
06.10.2021 

ASTROLOGICAL PREDICTION: During the period of 16.08.2021 to 06.10.2021, he will gain 
through his tutorials. My sincere pranaams to my KP Guru Shri. VSN. Murthy ji.

Question 1: METRICS in KP Astro 4.6

Answer 1: 
As you're aware it isn’t KP and it’s introduced for academic purpose, you can use it on 
experimental basis since you found it very helpful. 


The strength of planets table is generally found to be in line with Vedic shadbala but the 
signification in strength table is found different form Vedic Bhava bala calculated by Lord’s 
bala, Dig bala, Drig bala etc. 


Question 2: Time Cahart 
Kindly let me know about the utility and application of Time Chart. Please also intimate the 
difference between Time Chart and Horary Chart. 


Transit chart is used in fixing of timing of event, for instance general transit or Ascendent, 
Moon, Sun etc transit and in checking whether dasa agrees with transit. 


Some are using transit chart in horary analysis, which doesn’t take into consideration of 
qurent’s urge. But for proper KP horary analysis, horary chart with horary no 1-249, which 
reflects the querent’s urge, should be used. The transit chart with horary no. reflects 
astrologer’s urge. In combination of urge of both querent and astrologer the accurate result 
of KP horary is supposed to get.

Former US Secretary of State Colin Powell dies of 
Covid 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Short Background 
General Colin Powell, former first black U.S. Secretary of State and Chairman of the Joint 
Chiefs of Staff, passed away early morning of 18 October 2021 due to complications from 


Covid 19. 





In the United States, Mr. Powell, son of Jamaican immigrants, was one of the most 
prominent black leaders in decades. He held high-ranking positions under three Republican 
presidents. He was American military hero for his leadership in the Gulf War in January 
1991. He was Knighted by Queen Elizabeth in 1993 for his ability in the Gulf War. 





Mr. Powell was heavily criticized in February 2003 under President George W. Bush for 
raising the issue of Iraq at the UN Security Council. Iraqi President Saddam Hussein had 
been accused of stockpiling the world's most dangerous chemical and biological weapons. 
Later he admitted that his report to the United Nations contained "wrong intelligence" and 
left a black mark on his history. 


In 2008, he split with the Republican Party and officially backed then-Democratic candidate 
Barack Obama. 


Amid tributes to Colin Powell, former President Donald Trump criticized the late Colin Powell 
for his role in launching the Iraq War and being a "classic RINO." 


Powell’s Military and Foreign Affair Significators 

1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) Mercury is in 6 lord of 11, in the star of Ketu in 8, aspected by 
Jupiter+ in 3 lord of 5 and Saturn in 4 lord of 3,4, in Taurus sign representing Venus+ in 6 
lord of 1,8,12 and the CSL of 5,11,12 having no planet in its stars. Mercury is in the sub of 
Mars in 1, lord of 2,6,7 houses. 


10 CSL Rahu is in 2 and the CSL of 2,3,8,10 having no planet in its stars, in Scorpio sign, 
conj. sign lord Mars in 1 lord of 2,6,7. Rahu is in the star of Mercury in 6 lord of 11 and sub 


of own Rahu. 


The 1st and 10th CSLs strongly signify 3 (courage), 6 (military), 7 (foreign affairs in Mundane),

KP Death Inflicting Houses Verified by 100 AA-rated Death Charts 

The KP ‘main’ death inflicting houses of badhaka, maraka and moksha houses are found 
effective in charts of around 63% and above, higher than around 56% to 61% charts of 
‘supporting houses, as shown in the above table. Thus the KP death inflicting houses are 
generally found effective by this study of 100 dead charts. 


The most commonly accepted maraka houses (2,7) and moksha house (12) of Brihat Parasha- 
ra Hora Shastra are found effective at around 63% and above level. And the badhaka houses 
(11 or 9 or 7) of Jataka Paryata and Prasna Marga are also found effective at 63% level. The 
6,8 maraka houses of Bhavartha Ratnakara are found effective as supporting death inflicting 
signifcitors only. 

The malefic 3,6,8 and 11 houses for health of Jataka Chandrika are also found effective as 
supporting death inflicting houses only, with house 11 only with significant appearance in 
62% charts, out of them only 1/3 being badhaka. 

Thus, in fixing timing of death, a proper caution should be taken in considering house 11 as 
one of life saving or cure giving houses 1,5 and 11, when it is not badhaka. 


Dasa Analysis of Powell’s Death 

At the time of Collin Powell’s death on 18 October 2021, the joint period of Ketu dasa, Sun 
bhukti, Sun Antra and Venus sookshma signifies the most deadly Badhaka at all four levels 
of DBAS and transit agrees with dasa to confirm end of his life. 


Dasa lord Ketu is in 8, aspected Jupiter+ in 3 lord of 5 and Saturn in 4 lord of 3,4. Ketu is in 
Taurus sign representing Venus+ in 6 lord of 1,8,12. No planet is in the star of Venus, and 
Venus is the CSL of 5,11,12. Ketu is in the star of Mars in 1 lord of 2,6,7 and sub of Rahu in 
2. Having no planet in its stars, Rahu is the CSL of 2,3,8,10. 


Bhukti and Antra lord Sun is in 5 lord of 10, in the star of Mercury in 6 lord of 11 and sub of 
Moon in 3 lord of 9. 


Sookshma lord Venus+ is in 6 lord of 1,8,12, in the star of Ketu in 8 and sub of Saturn in 4 
lord of 3,4. Having no planet in its stars, Venus is the CSL of 5,11,12. 


Dasa lord Rahu signifies main death inflicting houses of badhaka 11, maraka 2-7 and 
moksha 12, and also supporting death inflicting houses of 6 (disease), 8 (Serious disease, 
danger to life), 3 (8th to 8), 4 (end of everything/ death) and 10 (retirement from this world/ 
death). Bhukti and Antra lord Sun signifies death inflicting 11,6,10,3. Sookshma lord Venus 
signifies death inflicting 11,12,6,8,4,3.

KP Rule: 

If the cuspal sub lord of 5t* cusp (female) or the 11th cusp (male) be the significator (in the star of the 
occupant or owner) of 2 (increase in family), 5 (conception, child) or 11 (5t4 from 7) or connected with 
2, 59 or 11, child birth is promised. 

If it is the significator of 1, 4 or 10 (being 12th from 2, 5 & 11) child birth is not promised during the 
joint period of significators of 2,5 & 11. 

Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male planets and Moon, Venus & Rahu are female planets. Mercury and 
Ketu are neuter gender. Odd number sign indicates male and even number sign indicates female. 
However, it is most difficult to predict child gender. (Prashna Jyotish by Kanak Bosmia ji page 
no.268).

houses, so with some difficulties getting the child is promised.

Mars (11-11,6) and the agent of Venus (8-12,5). Rahu is in the star of Moon (3-2) and in the sub of 
Venus (8-12,5). So, 224 CSL Rahu signifies 2-3-5-6-8-11-12, so the child birth is promised. 


Let us observe 5th CSL Venus (8-12, 5) in the star of Rahu (12) conjoined with Mars (11-11,6) and 
the agent of Venus (8-12,5). Venus is in the sub of Jupiter (8-7, 10). Here 5t CSL Venus signifies 5- 


6-7-8-10-11-12. The 5th CSL Venus has no planet in her stars and so it indicates 5 strongly, promis-

Practicing KP astrologer. 
Phone Number: 8240934741

On 5th August 202 I was discussing with one of my close relatives Seha Ahmed Gupta whether she will 
have male child or female child. I was more inclined to female child but she wanted a male child as 
per her mother last wish on 18-Feb-2021. And she also wants to deliver the child in normal process, 
not in cesarean process. She asked me to cast a KP horary chart and gave me horary number 12, dat- 
ed 5-Aug-2021 and time 12:21:40 PM, Place Kolkata (Bonhooghly more, Opposite Indian statistical 
institute). RP at the time of judgment. 

Lagna lord: Venus, Lagna Star: Jupiter, Moon star: Rahu, Rashi: Mercury, Day lord: Jupiter. 


Whether male child or female child: 


5th cusp (Leo 03:36:01): Child/Progeny is seen from 5t* cuspal sublord Sun placed in Cancer sign 19 
degree. So at first look I found the Sun is placed in Sun hora. For every female sign the first 15 degree 
is Moon hora and next 15 degree is Sun hora (Male hora) and vice versa. So after seeing this chart I 
said it’s a baby boy. 

Next I said she will not have normal delivery, it must be cesarean baby. So she said I will make your 
prediction wrong and I will deliver in normal process at any cost. 


5th cusp (Leo 03:36:01): 5th cuspal sublord Sun is in 4th house and owner of 5th house, in the star of 
Mercury placed in 4th and owner of 34 and 6th and in the sub of Ketu placed in 7th, aspected by Mars 
in 5th bhava and owner of 1st and 8th bhava. Sun signifies 3,4,6 and is connected with 1,4,5,7,8.

pect by Saturn in Capricorn degree 15:53:28 within 3 degree orb. Hence there will be delay in delivery. 
We can also see that in KP lagna chart Mars is placed in 5h house aspecting 8t house by 4th aspect 
and 12th house by 8th aspect and Mars is in Leo sign hence connected with the Sun and 5‘ cusp. 


Mars (Natural significator of Surgery) is in 5th house owner of 1st and 8th houses in the star of Ketu 
in 7th, aspected by Mars, and sub of Sat in 10th house and owner of 10th and 11th houses. Hence Mars 
signifies 1, 5, 7, 8(surgeryand connected with 10,11. 


She was admitted in hospital on 16 August, 2021 night as per doctor’s advice and on 17th August, 
2021 at 10 PM process was initiated for normal delivery. Still 188 morning she was not able to deliver 
the baby in normal process and was exhausted. Doctor said if she tries for next 10 days, then also she 
won't be able to deliver in normal process, so we don’t have any options except to move for Cesarean 
process. The 5th cuspal sublord Sun 19:01:05 aspected by Saturn 15:53:46 (opposition aspect within 
3 degree orb) causes the delay. As Saturn is natural significator of delay.

taught so many things in KP.

Leukemia-A cancer KP case research study 


By: Achintya Karmakar 


B/402/E Baishnabghata, Patuli, Kolkata 
Phone: 6291415841 ; Email: achintyakarmakar61127@gmail.com 








I am in various astrology group in telegram and whatsapp and others social media. There are many 
interesting chart I get through astrology forum groups. Today discussion topic is leukaemia/blood 
cancer. 


Rules of leukaemia blood cancer: 

1) The 1st or 6 cuspal sub lord must be connected to Rahu/Ketu and that signify Marak/Badhak or 
negative 6, 8, 12 houses. 

2) If the 6 cuspal sub lord is connected with malefic Jupiter (abnormal growth of cell), Sun, Moon, 
Venus and that signify 4, 6, 8, 9, 12 house. 

3) Blood cancer planet Mars would be significator of Marak Badhak houses. 

4) Running DBA should be negative. 


Analysis: 

Date of birth: 28 September 2013 
Time: 18.05 pm 

Place: Hubli karnataka. 


1st cusp: Here 1st cuspal sub lord Ketu. Ketu is in 2"4 house representing Mars. Mars is lord of 9, 2 
houses occupies in 5th house. See here planet Mars signifies Maraka 2™4 house. No planet is in the star 
of Ketu, Ketu is untenanted here Ketu is the cuspal sub lord of 7+ house. Ketu is in the star and sub 
of Venus, signifying 3, 8 houses. So 1st cuspal sub lord signifies Maraka and 8 houses strongly. 


6th cusp: 6th cuspal sub lord is Venus. Venus occupies 8th house and is lord of 3™4 house. Venus is in 
constellation of Jupiter which signifies 4, 10, 1 houses. Venus in sub of Mercury signifying 7(Maraka 
house), 4t* house (end of life). 


Running dasha, bhukti present: 

Jupiter dasha: 

Jupiter signifies 4, 10, 1 houses. Jupiter is in star of Jupiter and sub of Mercury occupant of 7h 
house. 


Rahu bhukti: 
Rahu occupies at 8th house. Rahu represents Venus occupant of 8th house, lord of 3'¢ house. Rahu is 
in the star of Rahu and sub of Venus. Venus signifies 8, 3, already discussed. 


My conclusion: 
As the dasha lord signify Maraka, 4 (end of life), 10 (retirement of life) also the bhukti lord signifies 8 
house, so this time up to 23 January 2022 it is not good for her health.

Question: What will be the gender of Moumita Khan's child? 








Background: A client came for consultation, she is already pregnant and delivery will be within 10-15 
days. As an astrologer I myself had the urge to know the gender of her child to test the rules of KP. 


Rule: Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn are considered male planets. Venus, Moon, Rahu are considered 
female planets. Ketu and Mercury are neuter gender. Odd numbers indicate male. Even numbers indi- 
cate female. 

Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius are considered male signs. 

Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces are considered female signs. 


The 5th house rising sign, star and sub _ will decide the gender of the child. 
However, it's most difficult to predict the gender of a child as the chances of going wrong is very high. 


In this horary horoscope-: 
5th Cusp rising is in Gemini [03:04:42]. 


Sign is Mercury, neuter gender. Mercury in Virgo, female sign. Mercury is the occupant of 8 even 
number of female. 


Star is Mars a male planet, is conjoined with male planet Sun. Posited in Virgo, female sign and occu- 
pant of 8 even number of female. 


Sub is Venus, female planet, posited in Scorpio, female sign. Venus is occupant of 9 odd number of 
male. 
Observation: Majority of the planets are males but connected with either female signs or occupant of 


odd numbers. Thus chances of a male child is high as compared to male. 


Outcome: Male child is born. Pranam to my guru Kanak sir for support and guidance.

Will my cat return home? 
And will he be alive? 


By: Achintya Karmakar 


B/402/E Baishnabghata, Patuli, Kolkata 
Phone: 6291415841 ; Email: achintyakarmakar61127@gmail.com 











As I am a pet lover, I am very affectionately close to my pets. One of my cats suddenly 
disappeared from house 2 days ago. As I am very much tensed over the fact, I checked 
through the Horary to find out whether he will return back to me or whether he is alive or 
not. Now, I furnished the following details of the Horary Chart: 


Date-26% August 2021; Time-13:42pm 
Place:-Kolkata, West Bengal, India 
KP Horary Number-98. 


Genuineness of query 

Moon is occupant of 8th house, lord of 12, in the star of Mercury occupant of 1st house, lord 
of 11th and 24, As it signifies 1sthouse, I am very much tensed whether he is alive or not. 
And also it signifies 2, 11 houses, it is the indicator of my expectation of him returning 
home. 


Rules: 
If the first cuspal sub lord is the significator of 1, 5, 9, 11, the the cat is alive and during the 
joint DBA of significators of 2, 4, 11, the cat returns home. 


Analysis 

Here first cusp sub lord Jupiter is untenanted, and the CSL 1, 5, 7 and 11. Jupiter is in 64 
house lord of 5, 8, Shouses, in the star of Mars in 1st house lord of 4th and 9th, Jupiter is in 
sub of Ketu in 34 house, representing Mars signifying 1, 4, 9 houses. So first cuspal sub lord

oth house for adopted children

The Houses - Temples of the Sky 
by Deborah Houlding 
The Wessex Astrologer Ltd, 2006, 196 pages 


THE HOUSES 


Temples of the Sky 


DEBORAH HOULDING {0M 
fsa 9 I 2"40520' 





The astrological circle of houses is perceived as a wheel of life, covering the full spectrum of 
human experience from formation of character through to death. Why did the ancient astrol- 
ogers devise the scheme in such a way that it does not seem to follow the natural order of 
life? Houlding's clear narrative and original research into the history and development of 
house meanings explores the symbolic threads that are embedded into the philosophy of 
houses, strengthening our understanding of their use in practical application. 

There is very little written on the most contentious area of astrology and this greatly updated 
and revised edition more than adequately fills the gap. 


Contents 

Foreword by Robert Hand 

Introduction: (wheels and Signs — Theories on House Division) 
Preliminary Guide to Divisions of the Celestial Sphere 


. Introducing the Houses: An Historical Overview 

. The Angles: Significance of Egyptian Solar Philosophy 

. Aspects & Gates: The 24/8th House Axis 

. Planetary Joys: 5th/11th House Axis 

. The King & Queen: The 3'4/9th House Axis 

. Cadency & Decline: The 6t/12th House Axis 

. House Rulerships in Practice 

. Technical Basis & the Inherent Difficulties of House Division 
. Ptolemy’s Powerful Places 


MO ONAUAWNEH

Appendix B — The Planetary Houses

Five Best Football Players of All Time 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Short Background 

Mostly based on stats of the various positions and the many leagues and tournaments from 
the Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation (RSSSF), “The Best Men’s Soccer Players of All 
Time by Clint Davis in The Delite’ are as given under: 


1. Pelé; 2. Lionel Messi; 3. Cristiano Ronaldo; 4. Ronaldo; 5. Diego Maradona; 6. Romario; 7. 
Gerd Muller; 8. Johan Cruyff; 9. Josef Bican; 10. Michel Platini; 11. Lev Yashin; 12. Zinedine 
Zidane; 13. Marco Van Basten; 14. Gianluigi Buffon; 15. Ronaldinho; 16. Franz 
Beckenbauer; 

17. Gordon Banks; 18. Alfredo Di Stéfano; 19. Ferenc Puskas; 20. Zarra; 21. Jimmy 
Greaves; 22. Neymar; 23. Wayne Rooney; 24. Miroslav Klose; 25. Petr Cech; 26. Zlatan 
Ibrahimovic; 27. Alan Shearer; 28. Hugo Sanchez; 9. Ryan Giggs; 30. Ruud Van Nistelrooy. 





A short note about the top five best football players are as follows: 


1. Pelé 

Pelé’s first World Cup goal at the 1958 tournament came when he was just 17 years old, 
making him still the youngest goal scorer in the event’s long history. He is still the only 
player to win three World Cups, leading his country to titles in 1958, 1962 and 1970. His 
most impressive record might be his 1,279 career goals at soccer’s top level, which Guinness 
World Records recognizes as the most in history. 


2. Lionel Messi 

Messi has been nominated for the Ballon d’Or a record 12 times and has won it an incredible 
six times, which is also a record. Messi’s greatness as a goalscorer is undisputed, as his 627 
goals for Barcelona alone are the second most by any player for a single club in soccer 
history and he’s led that club to an amazing 10 La Liga crowns in 16 seasons with them. 
Messi cemented his status as the best contemporary player by scoring 91 goals in 2012, 
which is recognized as the single greatest year for goalscoring by any player in history.

3. Cristiano Ronaldo 

The Portuguese Cristiano Ronaldo sits at second in the long history of La Liga with 311 goals 
scored in league play but he earned that tally in just 292 appearances, giving him the 
best-ever ratio of 1.07 goals per game. He’s the most prolific scorer in UEFA Champions 
League history and also has the most assists in the history of that event, showing his 
greatness as a leader and teammate. He’s Portugal’s most-capped player and has played in 
four World Cups but that championship has been about the only one to elude him. 

4. Ronaldo 

The Brazilian Ronaldo remains one of the most feared strikers in history. His 62 career goals 
with the Brazil national team rank him at second in the unmatched history of that 
international squad, and his 15 career goals at the World Cup also rank him second in 
history. The two-time Ballon d’Or winner and three-time FIFA World Player of the Year 
helped lead Brazil to World Cup wins in 1994 and 2002, as well as a runner-up finish in 
1998. 


5. Diego Maradona 

The Argentine Diego Maradona played in four World Cups, carrying his native country to the 
title in 1986. His performances on the game’s biggest stage led Daily Mail to call him the 
second-best player in World Cup history on a list that was filled with brilliant players.

HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018.

A person has approached me for study of his horoscope. For verification of correctness of his chart he 
was asked to furnish an important incident in his life. Thereupon he says that his mother died of 
cancer disease on 234 June 2010. His birth particulars are as under: 

DOB: 8-7-1970 Time: 4-20 pm _ Place: Vijayawada 
His chart was erected duly rectifying the birth time as 418-4 pm. He was borne in Venus star (Purva 
phalguni) with an ascendant of Scorpio. 


We will examine the disease of the mother of the native in his chart duly rotating the chart to 4h 
house Aquarius because 4th house represents the mother of the native. Venus is the badhaka lord 
and Jupiter, Sun are the maraka lords for Aquarius sign. 


In K.P. if the lagna sublord signifies 6th house or vice versa, the native will suffer with disease. If the 
cuspal sub lord is connected to 8 house, the disease will be fatal and incurable. If the cuspal sub 
lord is connected to badhaka and maraka the native will face life threat. 


In the rotated chart, the lagna sublord is Mercury. Mercury is a lord of 85 conjunct with Sun 
(Maraka) and posited in the star of Jupiter (maraka). Mercury having positional status, is also 9th CSL 
(badhaka), 7 (maraka) and aspected by lagna lord Saturn. Thus lagna cusp sub lord Mercury 
indicates life threat due to signification of 8th house, badhaka and maraka . 


In the rotated chart the 6t8 cuspal sub lord is Venus. Venus (badhaka) together with its star lord 
Kethu is posited in 66 house in its own sub. 


12th CSL is also Venus conjunct with 6 lord Moon. Kethu represents Sun. Sun and Mercury in 8th 
house are aspected by lagna lord Saturn. Thus Venus signifies 1, 8, 6,12 + badhaka denotes health 
problems of serious nature with life threat. 


The 8th cuspal sublord is Rahu posited in 12t house in Aquarius sign. Rahu represents Saturn, lagna 
lord. Saturn is aspecting Mercury (8), sun (7). Rahu is aspected by Jupiter (maraka), Venus 
(badhaka) and 6th lord Moon. So Rahu signifies 1, 6, 9, 2, 12 indicating chronic and incurable 
disease. 


The above position reveals that the cuspal sublords of 6,8,12, lagna CSL indicates chronic and 
incurable disease with life threat to the native’s mother during their joint period. 


Moon and Saturn are posited in the star of badhaka lord venus; Sun, Mars and Mercury are posited in 
the star of maraka lord Jupiter. Hence Moon, Saturn and Venus are significators of badhakasthana 
and Sun, Mars, Mercury are significators of marakasthana. 


The native is running the joint period of Mars-Mon-Ven-Sun who are the significators of maraka and 
badhaka on the date of his mother’s death. 

Dasa lord Mars is in 5 lord of 3,10 posited in the star of Jupiter in 8 lord of 2,11 and in the sub of 
Moon in 6 lord of 6. Jupiter is aspected by Saturn lagna lord. As Mars signifies 1,2,6,8 the native’s 
mother faces serious chronic ailments during the period of Mars. 


Bhukthi lord Moon is in 6, lord of 6 in the star and sub of Venus in 6 lord of 4,9. Moon is conjoined 
with Kethu in the sign Leo. Kethu represents Sun which is aspected by lagna lord Saturn. Sun is 
conjunct with 8th lord Mercury. Moon signifies 1,6,8,9 indicating chronic and incurable health 
problems. 


Anthara lord Venus is in 6, lord of 4,9 conjoined and posited in the star of Kethu in its own sub. 


Kethu is connected to lagna lord through Sun by the aspect of Saturn. Sun is conjunct with & lord 
Mercury. Venus also signifies 1,4,6,8,9 indicating chronic and incurable disease.

One of my clients asked me “sir, I joined in law course of 3 yrs and my goal is to get the 
judge job. Is it possible to achieve my goal?” I asked him to give a number from 1 to 249, 
immediately he said 111 (out of 249). I erected the chart and its details are given below. 


DOJ:-24.10.2021(Sunday), TOJ:- 12.28.00 pm, POJ:- Kurnool (A.P.) 
Let us check the Moon (9-11) is in the star of own and in the sub of Saturn (5-5,6). The Moon 
signifies 5-6-9-11. So, the querent’s desire was genuine. 


KP Rule 

If the cuspal sub lord of 10 (profession) or 6t (service job) be the significator (in the star of 
occupant or owner) of 2-6-10, service or earning is promised during the joint period of 
significators of 2, 6 & 10 (Ref: Prashna Jyotish by Shri Kanak Bosmia ji, Page No.236). 


Let us examine the 10th CSL Rahu (9). Rahu is conjoined with the Moon (9-11). Rahu is 
aspected by the Jupiter (5-4, 77) and Mars (1-3, 8). Rahu is in the star of Sun (1-12) and sub 
of Venus (3-2, 9). No planet is in the stars of Venus and Venus is the CSL of 1-9. So, the 10% 
CSL Rahu indicates 1-2-3-4-5-7-8-9-11-12. Here Rahu signifies 2-11 houses, along with 1-3- 
9-9 houses. So earning is promised. 


Let us observe the 6th CSL Rahu, we have already discussed above. 


Let us observe the 11th CSL Ketu (3) in the star of Saturn (5-5,6) and in the sub of Venus 
(3-2,9). No planet is in the stars of Venus and Venus is the CSL of 1-9.. Ketu is conjoined 
with the Venus (3-2,9) and posited in Scorpio sign representing Mars (1-3,8). No planet is in 
the stars of Ketu and Ketu is the CSL of 3-7-11. Here, the 11th CSL Ketu indicates 1-2-3-5-6- 
7-8-9-11. So, Ketu promises the job. But Ketu also signifies negative houses of profession 
also. 


Note: But the prestigious position of judge must indicate 10t* house and connection with the 
Jupiter and Saturn. Here, no indication of getting the higher position of judge.

One day one of my mauritian friends asked me on WhatsApp about tenant. She said that the last ten- 
ant that had been staying since last 2 years had decided to vacant his house. Now he is in search of a 
new tenant. So he would like to know when he will get a new tenant. 

For this query I decided to take horary chart and Aaked a number from 1 to 249 which is mentioned 
all these details in below. 


Query: When will I get a new tenant? 

Date of Judgement: 27/10/2021 

Time of Judgement: 22:35:10 PM 

Place of Judgement: Hyderabad (LAT 17 N 44’ 10”, LON 78 E 44’53’) 
Horary No: 25 (out of 249) 


Hint 

In cases of tenant if the cuspal sub lord of the 6‘ (tenant) signifies through the star lord 11 (fulfilment 
of desire) or 4 (own building or home) or 6 (tenant) or 2 (money or income), then native will get a new 
tenant. 


Geniuses of the query: 

Before proceeding to analyse any horary chart one must check whether the Moon supports the query 
or not? Let us check Moon first. Moon is placed in 34 house and lord of 4th house, in the star of Jupi- 
ter in 10 and lord of 8, 9 and 12. Moon is signifying the 4th house, so the query is genuine. 


Let’s check it out for tenant 

6th Cusp (Virgo 27°40): The sub lord of 6t cusp is Jupiter. Jupiter occupies in 10 and lord of 8, 9, 12, 
in the star of Mars (karaka of own property or building) in 6 and lord of 7, and sub of Saturn in 9 and 
lord of 11 and 10. Hence 6th CSL Jupiter signifies 6, 11 for promise of new tenant. 


Ruling planets 

The chart was judged on 27 Oct 2021, Wednesday at 22:35:10 hrs in Hyderabad (Telangana). 
Ascendant Star lord Jupiter 

Ascendant Sign lord Mercury 

Ascendant Sub lord Saturn 

Moon Star Lord Jupiter 

Jupiter Sign Lord Mercury 

Moon Sub Lord Venus 

Here Venus is conjunct with Ketu and aspecting the Rahu. So Rahu and Ketu are also added to the 
Ruling Planets. 


D-B-A-S Analysis:

KP Rule 

If the sub lord of the 6t or 8th or 12thor 11% cusp be the significator (in the star of the 
occupant or owner) of 1 or 5 or 11, disease is cured or the native is saved from any danger 
during the joint period of the significators of 1, 5 and 11. 


6-sickness, 8-danger to life, 12-hospitalization. 1-5-11 these three houses indicate recovery 
from the disease. (Ref. Prashna Jyotish by Shri. Chadrakant R. Bhatt, translated by Shri. 
Kanak Bosmia ji, page no.83) 


If the sub lord of the Ascendant cusp be the significator of 1-5-11, the native may recover 
after accident or escape from the accident during the joint period of significators of 1-5-11. 
(in char lagna consider 9t instead of 11). During the joint period of the significator of 2-4-11 
discharge from the hospital. (Ref: Easy way to learn KP-Horary Astrology by Shri. Kanak 
Kumar Bosmia ji., page no 52)

11). So, the Moon signifies 1-3-4-6-8-9-11-12. The querent’s genuineness is reflected by the 
Moon.

and posited in Taurus sign representing Venus (8-1, 6). Rahu is in the star of Sun (6-4) and 
in the sub of Venus (8-1, 6). No planet is in the stars of Venus which is the CS of 4-6-11. So, 
the Ascendant cusp sub lord signifies 1-4-6-8-11-12. Here, the Ascendant cusp sub lord 
shows cure by signification of good houses of 1-11, along with bad houses of 6 (sick)- 8 
(surgery)-12 (hospitalization).
