Shall I purchase land? 


BY: M. Vara Prasad Rao 
Sri Varasiddhi Jyotishyalam 
Opp. Sri Lakshmi E.M.School, N.R.Peta, Kurnool — 2, A.P. 
Mobile : 08309234634, Email: vara999@gmail.com 











One of my clients asked me “Sir, I want to buy a land, which time is good for me to 
purchase”. She gave me the number of 225 (out of 249). Immediately I erected the chart, the 
details are given below. 

DOJ:- 02.09.2021, TOJ:-07.36.00pm, POJ:-Kurnool. 


KP Rule: If the cuspal sub lord of 4th (land/house/building) be the significator (in the star of 
occupant or owner) of 11 (gain, fulfilment of desire, 12 (investment), one will have his own 
land or building (immovable property) during the joint period of significators of 4, 11 & 12 
houses. (Ref: Prashna Jyotish by Shri Chandrakant R. Bhatt, translated by Kanak Bosmia 
ji.. page no.224). 


Let us check the Moon (4-6) in the star of Jupiter (12-11) and sub of Saturn (11-1,12). So, 
the Moon reflects the genuineness of the querent by signification of 411-12. 


Let us observe the 4th CSL Saturn (11-1, 12) in the star of Moon (4-6) and in the sub of 
Jupiter (12-11). Here 4th CSL Saturn indicates 1-4-6-11-12. So, the event of land buying is 
promised. 


Next, we examine the 11th CSL Mercury (7-5) in the star and sub of Moon (4-6). Here, 11th 
CSL Mercury signifies 4-5-6 (loss of money to opponent-12t to 7t)-7 (seller). So, the event is 
promised. 


Let us also check the 12th cusp for clarity as it is the investment house for querent. 12th CSL 
Venus (7-3, 4, 8) is in the star of Mars (7-2, 9, 10) and in the sub of Jupiter (12-11). Here, 
12th CSL Venus signifies 2-3-4-7-8-9 (luck)-10-11-12. So, the event of land purchasing is 
promised. 


Let us check the Ruling Planets as follows: 

Lagna sublord: Ketu 

Lagna starlord: Saturn 

Lagna signlord: Jupiter 

Moon sublord: Saturn 

Moon starlord: Jupiter 

Moon signlord: Mercury 

Day lord: Jupiter 

So, the final Ruling Planets are:-Jupiter/Saturn/Mercury/Ketu. 


At the time of judgement Jupiter dasa is running from 15.09.2018 to 15.09.2034. 

Jupiter dasa-Saturn Bhukti is running from 03.11.2020 to 17.05.2023. 
Jupiter/Saturn/Venus is running from 03.09.2021 to 04.03.2022. Venus is not appeared in 
ruling planets. So, in Venus anthra this event will not happen. 


Outcome: The client informed me to my mobile the this event of land purchasing doesn’t 
happen as the owner of the land disagrees with the discussion of price. 


My sincere pranaams to my KP Guru Shri. VSN. Murthy ji.

Will marriage proposal be successful or 
not? 


BY: M. Vara Prasad Rao 
Sri Varasiddhi Jyotishyalam 
Opp. Sri Lakshmi E.M.School, N.R.Peta, Kurnool — 2, A.P.

One of my clients asked me, “sir, one marriage proposal came to me, whether it will be suc- 
cessful or not”. He gave me the number of 22(out of 249). 
DOJ:- 02.10.2021 (Saturday), TOJ:- 02:03:1'7 AM, POJ:- Kurnool. 


KP Rule: 

If the sub lord of the 34 cusp be the significator of 3-7-9, the native undergoes negotiations 
for marriage during the joint period of the significators of 3-7-9-11 (8-9-11= success in nego- 
tiations, 3-9-12= failure in negotiations). 


Let us check the Moon status for the mind of query. Moon (3-4) is in the star of Saturn (9- 
10,11) and in the sub of Jupiter (10-9,12). So, the Moon signifies 3-4-9-10-11-12. The moon 
indicates the genuineness of the query. 


First of all, we check 34 CSL Saturn (9-10,11) in the star of Moon (3-4) and in the sub of Ra- 
hu (1). Rahu is aspected by the Jupiter (10-9,12) and is in Taurus sign, acting as agent of 
Venus (7-2,7). Having no planet in its stars, Rahu is the CSL of 1-5-6-12. Thus 3'4 CSL Sat- 
urn signifies 1-2-3-5-7-9-10-11-12. So, the event of negotiations is promised, but not fruitful 
due to the impact of 12t signification. 


Next, let us examine the 9th CSL Saturn, we have already discussed above. 

Next, we observe 11t8 CSL Mars (5-1,8) in the star of Moon (3-4) and in the sub of Saturn (9- 
10,11). 11 CSL Mars signifies 1-3-4-5-8-9-10-11. So, negotiations for the marriage proposal 
are promised. 


Finally, we examine the primary house of marriage 7th CSL. 7th CSL Sun (5-5) is in the star of 
Moon (3-4) and in the sub of Jupiter (10-9,12). 7*» CSL Sun indicates 3-4-5-9-10-12. So, the 
negotiations are promised. But, due to the negative house of 12 chances are less to the que- 
ry. Marriage significators of 2-7-11 are also not appeared in the 7 CSL signification. 


Let us check the Ruling Planets at the time of judgment which are as follows: 

Lagna sub lord:- Jupiter 

Lagna star lord:- Saturn 

Lagna sign lord:- Moon 

Moon sub lord:- Jupiter 

Moon star lord:- Saturn 

Moon sign lord :-Moon 

Day lord :- Saturn 

Rahu is aspected 5th by the Jupiter, so Rahu is considered as a Ruling Planet. 

Common planets among the significators of 3-7-9-11 and Ruling Planets:- Ju/Sa/Mo/Ra 


At the time of judgement Saturn Dasa is running from 23.04.2003 to 23.04.2023. 
Next, Bhukti Jupiter is running from 11.10.2019 to 23.04.2022. 

Next, Antra Rahu is running from 06.12.2021 to 23.04.2022. 

Next, Sookshma Rahu is running from 06.12.2021 to 27.12.2021. 


Note: Dasa lord Saturn, Bhukti lord Jupiter, Antra and Sookshma lord Rahu, all these DBAS 
lords have appeared in common planets.

Will Australia be winner of T20 world cup 2021? 


By: Gopall Krisshna Jha 





‘ Gupta Tola , P.O -Berhait -816102 
") &. q Dist-Sahibganj (Jharkhand).

One of the dear friends of mine just asked me about the ICC T20 World Cup 2021 match be- 
tween Australia and New Zealand and chance of winning T20 World Cup by Australia. Then 
I asked him a number from 1 to 249. No 239 was mentioned and all the horary chart details 
are given below : 


Query: Will Australia be winner of T20 world cup 2021? 

Date of Judgment: 14/11/2021 

Time of Judgment: 6:44:44 PM 

Place: Hyderabad (Telangana) LAT -17 N 44’10” LON 78 E 44' 53” 
Horary No: 231 out of 249 


Hints: In cases of competition and contest between two rival teams in cricket match etc., if 
the cuspal sub lord of the 11th (success) and that of the 6th (defeat to the rival) be the sig- 
nificator of houses 1, 2, 3, 6, 10 or 11, the team under query can win the match during the 
joint dasa period of significators of 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, 11. 


Genuineness of the query: 

In this horary map Moon occupies 1 (team Aus) and owns 6 (12th from 7th loss of opponent 
and win for self). Star lord and sub lord is Saturn posited in 11th house (success, fulfillment 
of desire). Thus Moon indicates the question related to sports match competition. 


AUSTRALIA 

11th Cusp (Sagittarius 28° 05’): The sub lord of 11th Cusp is Moon. Moon is in the star and 
sub of Saturn . Moon occupies in 1 and lord of 6. Star and sun lord Saturn is posited in 11 
and lord of 12. So Australia's 11t CSL Moon is the significator of 11, 6, 12. Hence it is fa- 
vourable to the Australia. 


6th Cusp (Cancer 26° 43’): The sub lord of the 6th cusp is Jupiter posited in 12 and lord of 
10, in the star of Mars and sub of Saturn. Star lord Mars is posited in 8 and lord of 2. Sub 
lord Saturn is posited in 11. So, Ausralia’s 6* CSL Jupiter is the significator of 11,10, 8,12. 
Hence It is advantageous to the Australia. 


Let us rotate the chart with 74 cusp for New Zealand 

11th Cusp (Gemini 28° 05’): The sub lord of 11t* cusp Venus is in the star and sub of own. 
Venus occupies 4 and is lord of 9 and 2. So, New Zealand’s 11th CSL Venus is the significa- 
tor of 2,4,9. Hence it is unfavorable to the New Zealand. 

6th Cusp (Capricorn 26°43’): The sub lord of 6t* cusp is Moon. Moon is in the star and sub 
of Saturn. Moon occupies 7 and is lord of 12. Star and sub of Saturn occupies in 5 and lord 
of 6. So New Zealand’s 6th CSL is the significator of 5, 6, 7 and 12. Hence it is disadvanta- 


geous to the New Zealand. 


The above position of both team teams’ results indicates that Australia team is much strong- 
er than New Zealand. Therefore Australia should win the match against New Zealand. 


Actual Outcome: In fact, Australia won the match easily by 8 wickets.

Why India lost the match? 


BY: M. Vara Prasad Rao 
Sri Varasiddhi Jyotishyalam 
Opp. Sri Lakshmi E.M.School, N.R.Peta, Kurnool — 2, A.P. 
Mobile : 08309234634, Email: vara999@gmail.com 











Myself, like every Indian I am also waiting for the most awaited cricket match between India 
and Pakistan in T-20 World cup tournament. Randomly I choose the number 216 (out of 
249) for India, the chart erected and details given below. 

DOJ: 24.10.2021(Sunday), TOJ: 07.19.55 PM, POJ: Kurnool. Horary no.216 


Let us check the Moon for the genuineness of mine. Moon (4-6) is in the star of own (4-6) and 
in the sub of Venus (10-4, 9). So, the Moon signifies 4-6 (victory over the enemy)-9-10 (one’s 
position, status by winning in the match’s name and fame) and so my excitement was genu- 
ine. 


Here one epic rule for the competition of sports: For any competitive sport of which two 
parties are involved, we consider the cuspal sub lords of 1-6-11 houses for the favoured par- 
ty and their opposite houses of 7-12-5 are for its opponent party. Cuspal sub lords of 1-6-11 
must be significators of houses of 1-2-3-6-10-11 (upachaya or improving houses so far as 
competition is concerned) to predict the win for team in question. Similarly the sub lords of 7 
-12-5 must be strong significators of houses 4-5-7-8-9-12 for the win of opponent. [Ref: KP 
Reader III: Transit, p 222, new edition 249) 


Let us check the 6t CSL Sun (8-7) in the star and sub of Rahu (3). Rahu is conjoined with 
the Moon (4-6) and aspected by the Jupiter (12-2, 11). Rahu is in Taurus sign representing 
Venus (10-4, 9). Rahu is also aspected by the Mars (8-3, 10). So, the 6th CSL Sun indicates 
for India positive houses of 2-3 (2 times)-6-10-11, total 6 houses and Pakistan winning hous- 
es of 4 (2 times)-7-8 (2 times)-9-12, total 7 houses. 


Let us check the 11th CSL Venus (10-4, 9) in the star of the Mercury (8-5, 8) and in the sub 
of Rahu (3). Rahu is aspected by the Jupiter (12-2, 11). Rahu is conjoined with the Moon (4- 
6). Rahu is in Taurus sign representing Venus (10-4, 9). Rahu is also aspected by Mars (8-3, 
10). No planet is in the stars of Venus and Venus is the CSL of 11t house. So, the winning 
houses of India, 2-3-6-10 (3 times)-11 (2times), total 8 houses and Pakistan winning houses 
4 (Stimes)-5-8 (Stimes)-9 (2times)-12, total 10 houses. 


Let us examine the Ascendant cusp sub lord Mercury (8-5,8) in the star of Moon (4-6) and 
sub of own. Mercury is aspected by the Jupiter (12-2, 11). So, the winning houses for India 2 
-6-11, total 3 houses and Pakistan winning houses 4-5-8 (2times)-12, total 5 houses. 


Total positive houses of India are 17 (6+8+3) and Pakistan 22 (7+10+5). So, by the compara- 
tive houses counting the Pakistan wins the match. 


Note: Jupiter is the significator of 12 (loss of self) for India in significator table A, C and D. 
Jupiter is the significator of 6 (victory over enemy) for Pakistan in significator table A, C and 
D. 


Shri. Kanak Kumar Bosmia ji is Editor of K.P. E-Zine (World’s First E-Magazine on 
Krishnamurthy system) framed a rule regarding this type of competitions. It is as follows- 
Shri. Kanakji’s Rule:- If the 10 (one’s position, status by winning in the match name and 
fame) cusp sublord signifies 10 (one’s reputation)- 3 (one’s ability and dareness to 
participate), 11 (one’s reputation as a winner) in the D/B/A of the significators of 3-10-11, 
then success is assured.

Astro Equations For Specific Professions 

by MRIDULA TRIVEDI, T. P. TRIVEDI AND R. ASTHANA 
MOTILAL BANARSIDASS PUBLISHERS PVT. LTD. 
2016, 532 pages 





This book is an effort to refine the choice of career using principles of Astrology. 'Pointers to 
Profession: An Astrological Exposition’ deals with the combinations, constellations and hous- 
es for the judgment of professional aspects and prospects of the native. This work includes 
dictums and sutras of yore, supplemented by observations from our experience and support- 
ed by more than hundred case studies. 


Different houses, signs and planets as also the role of Jaimini Atmakaraka have been exten- 
sively dealt with reference to specific vocations. Yogas such as Sakata, Kemadruma and oth- 
ers have been critically examined and their powers to create setbacks and impediments in 
one’s vocational life have been lucidly explained. 


Based on combinations given in classical works and suitably adapted to present time options, 
the authors deal in some detail with the clues needed to identify specific professional lines 
such as of doctors, lawyers, engineers, teachers, bureaucrats, as also businessmen, sports 
persons, film stars, politicians and other vocations. 


It is a general belief that the tenth house deals with profession. The tenth house, its lord and 
the navamsa of the lord of the tenth house are most important in finding out a suitable occu- 


KP Ezine December 2021 51 


pation. Anyway, in addition to the tenth house, the lords of the second and eleventh house 
should also be taken into account. These two houses indicate the means of livelihood. Thus, 
indirectly second and eleventh houses too play a vital role in the judgement of the native's 
occupation. The effect of these two houses has been demonstrated in the discussions for var- 
ious professions in "Astro Equations For Specific Professions", which will help to pin-point 
the most probable and suitable job for the native.Equally important are the roles of sixth and 
eighth houses in predicting career progression of individuals. The sixth and eighth houses 
are most misunderstood houses with regard to profession, though both have a lot of influ- 
ence on the native's career progression. The sixth house governs the professional fortune 
that is promotion, demotion, termination and the like. The eighth house is tenth from the 
eleventh house and eleventh from the tenth house. Eleventh house rules over accomplish- 
ment of ambitions.
